creators.bio: Startup that released Mirage (July 2025) and Mirage 2 (August 2025), browser-playable generative world engines; its website and launch posts were offline when checked in October 2026.
creators.why: One of the first teams to put a real-time, image-to-world engine in front of the public.
creators.role_zh: 生成式游戏引擎初创公司
creators.bio_zh: 推出 Mirage（2025 年 7 月）与 Mirage 2（2025 年 8 月）这两款可在浏览器中游玩的生成式世界引擎的初创公司；2026 年 10 月核查时，其网站与发布帖均已下线。
creators.why_zh: 最早把实时“图像变世界”引擎开放给公众的团队之一。

creators.name: Odyssey
creators.bio: AI lab founded in 2023 by Oliver Cameron and Jeff Hawke to build general-purpose world models; it released Odyssey-1, -2 and -3, the multi-agent Agora models and an API.
creators.why: It ships interactive world models publicly and fast, and is pushing them toward shared multi-agent worlds and robot control.
creators.role_zh: 世界模型 AI 实验室
creators.bio_zh: 由 Oliver Cameron 与 Jeff Hawke 于 2023 年创立的 AI 实验室，致力于通用世界模型，先后发布 Odyssey-1、-2、-3、多智能体 Agora 系列模型及 API。
creators.why_zh: 它以很快的节奏公开发布交互式世界模型，并把它们推向多人共享世界与机器人控制。

creators.name: Tencent
creators.bio: Shenzhen-based internet and games company; several of its research teams, besides Hunyuan, publish interactive video work.
creators.why: Its 'Yan Team' showed 1080p, 60 fps game simulation with text-editable worlds.
creators.role_zh: 中国科技与游戏公司
creators.bio_zh: 总部位于深圳的互联网与游戏公司；除混元外，其多个研究团队也发表交互式视频方面的工作。
creators.why_zh: 其“Yan 团队”展示了 1080p、60 fps 的游戏模拟，以及可用文字编辑的世界。

creators.name: PixVerse
creators.bio: Beijing-based maker of the PixVerse video generator and app, developed by AIsphere; in 2026 it added the real-time R1 and R2 world models.
creators.why: It is the first consumer video app to turn its generator into a real-time, steerable world with sound.
creators.role_zh: AI 视频公司（爱诗科技）
creators.bio_zh: 总部位于北京的 PixVerse 视频生成器与应用的开发者，由爱诗科技打造；2026 年推出实时世界模型 R1 与 R2。
creators.why_zh: 它是首个把视频生成器变成可实时操控、带声音的世界的消费级视频应用。

creators.name: Overworld
creators.bio: Startup releasing open-weight, real-time diffusion world models (Waypoint) that run locally on consumer GPUs, plus the open-source Biome client.
creators.why: It targets the latency and hardware gap: world models people can run at home.
creators.role_zh: 开源世界模型初创公司
creators.bio_zh: 发布可在消费级显卡本地运行的开源实时扩散世界模型（Waypoint）及开源客户端 Biome 的初创公司。
creators.why_zh: 它瞄准延迟与硬件门槛：做人们在家里就能运行的世界模型。

creators.name: Etched
creators.bio: Startup designing Sohu, a transformer-specific inference chip; co-developed Oasis with Decart.
creators.why: Its Oasis collaboration framed real-time world models as an inference-hardware problem.
creators.role_zh: AI 芯片公司
creators.bio_zh: 设计 Transformer 专用推理芯片 Sohu 的初创公司，与 Decart 合作开发了 Oasis。
creators.why_zh: 它与 Decart 合作的 Oasis 把实时世界模型定位为推理硬件问题。

creators.name: Wayve
creators.bio: London company building end-to-end driving models, and the GAIA line of generative driving world models since 2023.
creators.why: GAIA tracks the move from generating driving video to closed-loop simulation with the driver in the loop.
creators.role_zh: 具身智能自动驾驶公司
creators.bio_zh: 总部位于伦敦的公司，开发端到端驾驶模型，并自 2023 年起推出 GAIA 系列生成式驾驶世界模型。
creators.why_zh: GAIA 记录了从生成驾驶视频到让驾驶模型参与闭环仿真的转变。

creators.name: 1X Technologies
creators.bio: Norwegian-American maker of the EVE and NEO humanoid robots.
creators.why: Its 1X World Model (2024) was an early action-conditioned simulator for evaluating humanoid policies.
creators.role_zh: 人形机器人公司
creators.bio_zh: 挪威与美国背景的人形机器人公司，产品包括 EVE 与 NEO。
creators.why_zh: 其 1X 世界模型（2024）是较早用于评估人形机器人策略的、以动作为条件的模拟器。
creators.based_zh: 美国帕洛阿尔托 / 挪威莫斯

creators.name: General Intuition
creators.role: AI lab for agents acting in space and time
creators.bio: AI lab spun out of the game-clip platform Medal that trains agents and world models on large archives of gameplay video.
creators.why: Co-developed MIRA, an open multiplayer world model, with Kyutai.
creators.role_zh: 研究在时空中行动的智能体的 AI 实验室
creators.bio_zh: 从游戏片段平台 Medal 分拆出来的 AI 实验室，利用大规模游戏视频档案训练智能体与世界模型。
creators.why_zh: 与 Kyutai 合作开发了开源多人世界模型 MIRA。

creators.name: David Ha
creators.role: Researcher, first author of World Models (2018)
creators.bio: Machine-learning researcher, then at Google Brain, later co-founder of Sakana AI; co-wrote World Models with Jürgen Schmidhuber.
creators.why: World Models popularised the idea of an agent learning inside its own generated 'dream'.
creators.role_zh: 研究者，《World Models》（2018）第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 机器学习研究者，时任职于 Google Brain，后联合创立 Sakana AI；与 Jürgen Schmidhuber 合著《World Models》。
creators.why_zh: 《World Models》让“智能体在自己生成的梦境中学习”这一想法广为人知。

creators.name: Seung Wook Kim
creators.role: Researcher at NVIDIA, first author of GameGAN
creators.bio: Researcher at NVIDIA's Toronto AI lab working on neural simulation of games and driving.
creators.why: GameGAN (2020) was the first widely shown neural re-creation of a playable game.
creators.role_zh: 英伟达研究员，GameGAN 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 英伟达多伦多 AI 实验室研究员，研究游戏与驾驶的神经模拟。
creators.why_zh: GameGAN（2020）是第一个被广泛展示的、用神经网络重建的可玩游戏。

creators.name: Eloi Alonso
creators.bio: Machine-learning researcher (University of Geneva) working on diffusion world models for reinforcement learning.
creators.why: DIAMOND showed that a small diffusion model can become a playable Counter-Strike world on one consumer GPU.
creators.role_zh: 研究者，DIAMOND 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 日内瓦大学的机器学习研究者，研究用于强化学习的扩散世界模型。
creators.why_zh: DIAMOND 证明了一个小型扩散模型就能在单张消费级显卡上变成可玩的《反恐精英》世界。

creators.name: Danijar Hafner
creators.role: Research scientist, author of the Dreamer agents
creators.bio: Research scientist at Google DeepMind known for the Dreamer line of world-model agents.
creators.why: Dreamer 4 trains agents entirely inside a learned, real-time world model.
creators.role_zh: 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列智能体作者
creators.bio_zh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，以 Dreamer 系列世界模型智能体闻名。
creators.why_zh: Dreamer 4 让智能体完全在学到的实时世界模型里完成训练。

creators.name: Sherry Yang
creators.bio: Researcher (Google DeepMind and UC Berkeley at the time of UniSim) working on video models as real-world simulators.
creators.why: UniSim framed video generation as a universal interactive simulator for agents.
creators.role_zh: 研究者，UniSim 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 研究者（发表 UniSim 时任职于 Google DeepMind 与加州大学伯克利分校），研究把视频模型用作真实世界模拟器。
creators.why_zh: UniSim 把视频生成定位为面向智能体的通用交互式模拟器。

creators.name: Amir Bar
creators.role: Researcher at Meta FAIR, first author of Navigation World Models
creators.bio: Computer-vision researcher (Meta FAIR, Tel Aviv University) working on visual prediction and world models.
creators.why: Navigation World Models showed that a video world model can be used to plan routes, not just to render.
creators.role_zh: Meta FAIR 研究员，导航世界模型第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 计算机视觉研究者（Meta FAIR、特拉维夫大学），研究视觉预测与世界模型。
creators.why_zh: 导航世界模型表明，视频世界模型不仅能渲染，还能用来规划路径。

creators.name: Boyuan Chen
creators.role: Researcher at MIT, first author of Diffusion Forcing
creators.bio: PhD researcher at MIT working on video world models and robot learning.
creators.why: Diffusion Forcing is the training recipe behind many stable, long autoregressive world models.
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院研究者，Diffusion Forcing 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 麻省理工学院的博士研究者，研究视频世界模型与机器人学习。
creators.why_zh: Diffusion Forcing 是许多稳定、长时自回归世界模型背后的训练方法。

creators.name: Zeqi Xiao
creators.bio: Researcher at Nanyang Technological University (S-Lab) working on consistent video world simulation.
creators.why: WorldMem made explicit memory banks a standard tool for keeping generated worlds consistent.
creators.role_zh: 研究者，WorldMem 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 南洋理工大学 S-Lab 研究者，研究一致的视频世界模拟。
creators.why_zh: WorldMem 让显式记忆库成为保持生成世界一致性的常用工具。

creators.name: Jiwen Yu
creators.role: Researcher at the University of Hong Kong
creators.bio: PhD researcher at the University of Hong Kong working with Kuaishou's Kling team on interactive video generation.
creators.why: First author of GameFactory and Context-as-Memory, two reference works on controllable and consistent game video.
creators.role_zh: 香港大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 香港大学博士研究者，与快手可灵团队合作研究交互式视频生成。
creators.why_zh: GameFactory 与 Context-as-Memory 的第一作者，这两项工作是可控、一致的游戏视频的参考之作。

creators.name: Tong Wu
creators.bio: Researcher in Gordon Wetzstein's group at Stanford working on 3D-aware video generation.
creators.why: First author of the long-term spatial-memory world model that stores the scene as a point cloud.
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 斯坦福大学 Gordon Wetzstein 组的研究者，研究具备三维感知的视频生成。
creators.why_zh: 以点云保存场景的长期空间记忆世界模型的第一作者。

creators.name: Xindi Wu
creators.bio: PhD researcher at Princeton University who worked with NVIDIA on memory for video world models.
creators.why: First author of WorldTrace, which keeps a world model's memory addressable beyond its training horizon.
creators.role_zh: 普林斯顿大学与英伟达研究者
creators.bio_zh: 普林斯顿大学博士研究者，与英伟达合作研究视频世界模型的记忆机制。
creators.why_zh: WorldTrace 的第一作者，这项工作让世界模型在超出训练时长后仍能准确调取记忆。

creators.name: Blockade Labs
creators.role_zh: Skybox AI 的开发者
creators.bio: Startup that makes Skybox AI, a web tool and API for generating 360° equirectangular skyboxes and environments.
creators.bio_zh: 开发 Skybox AI 的初创公司：一个生成 360° 等距柱状天空盒与环境的网页工具和 API。
creators.why: Skybox AI was one of the first generators that let creators make a VR-ready 360° backdrop from a prompt.
creators.why_zh: Skybox AI 是最早让创作者用一句提示词做出可直接用于 VR 的 360° 背景的生成工具之一。

creators.name: SpAItial
creators.role_zh: 三维世界模型初创公司（Echo）
creators.bio: Startup co-founded by TUM professor Matthias Niessner that builds spatial foundation models; it raised a $13 million seed round in 2025 and released Echo (Dec 2025) and Echo-2 (Apr 2026).
creators.bio_zh: 由慕尼黑工业大学教授 Matthias Niessner 联合创立的初创公司，研发空间基础模型；2025 年获 1300 万美元种子轮融资，先后发布 Echo（2025 年 12 月）和 Echo-2（2026 年 4 月）。
creators.why: It is one of the few companies besides World Labs selling persistent 3D-splat world generation.
creators.why_zh: 它是除 World Labs 之外少数提供持久三维泼溅世界生成服务的公司之一。

creators.name: Xinyang Li
creators.role: PhD researcher, MAC Lab, Xiamen University
creators.role_zh: 厦门大学 MAC 实验室博士研究者
creators.bio: First author of FlashWorld, developed with Tencent Hunyuan.
creators.bio_zh: FlashWorld 的第一作者，该工作与腾讯混元合作完成。
creators.why: FlashWorld cut single-image-to-3D-world generation to seconds on one GPU.
creators.why_zh: FlashWorld 把单图生成三维世界的时间缩短到单卡几秒。

creators.name: Hong-Xing (Koven) Yu
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福大学研究者
creators.bio: Computer-vision researcher in Jiajun Wu's group at Stanford, first author of WonderJourney and WonderWorld.
creators.bio_zh: 斯坦福大学吴佳俊组的计算机视觉研究者，WonderJourney 与 WonderWorld 的第一作者。
creators.why: His work moved scene generation from one fixed view to open-ended, user-steered journeys.
creators.why_zh: 他的工作把场景生成从单一固定视角推进到由用户引导、无限延伸的旅程。

creators.name: Jaeyoung Chung
creators.role: Researcher, Computer Vision Lab, Seoul National University
creators.role_zh: 首尔国立大学计算机视觉实验室研究者
creators.bio: Co-first author of LucidDreamer in Kyoung Mu Lee's lab at Seoul National University.
creators.bio_zh: 首尔国立大学 Kyoung Mu Lee 实验室的研究者，LucidDreamer 的共同第一作者。
creators.why: LucidDreamer was among the first to generate whole Gaussian-splat scenes from a prompt or photo.
creators.why_zh: LucidDreamer 是最早从提示词或照片生成整片高斯泼溅场景的工作之一。

creators.name: Lukas Höllein
creators.role_zh: 慕尼黑工业大学研究者
creators.bio: PhD researcher in Matthias Niessner's Visual Computing & AI lab at TUM, first author of Text2Room.
creators.bio_zh: 慕尼黑工业大学 Matthias Niessner 视觉计算与 AI 实验室的博士研究者，Text2Room 的第一作者。
creators.why: Text2Room showed that a 2D image model plus depth can build a complete textured room mesh.
creators.why_zh: Text2Room 证明二维图像模型加上深度估计就能拼出完整的带纹理房间网格。

creators.name: Andrew Liu
creators.role_zh: Google Research 研究者
creators.bio: First author of Infinite Nature (ICCV 2021) with Noah Snavely and Angjoo Kanazawa at Google Research.
creators.bio_zh: Infinite Nature（ICCV 2021）的第一作者，与 Noah Snavely、Angjoo Kanazawa 等在 Google Research 合作。
creators.why: Infinite Nature defined perpetual view generation, the ancestor of today's explorable-world models.
creators.why_zh: Infinite Nature 提出了“无限视图生成”，是今天可探索世界模型的前身。

creators.name: Haozhe Xie
creators.role_zh: 南洋理工大学 S-Lab 研究者
creators.bio: Researcher in Ziwei Liu's S-Lab at NTU, first author of CityDreamer and CityDreamer4D.
creators.bio_zh: 南洋理工大学刘子纬 S-Lab 的研究者，CityDreamer 与 CityDreamer4D 的第一作者。
creators.why: CityDreamer generates unbounded cities, a scale that room- and object-level methods do not reach.
creators.why_zh: CityDreamer 能生成无边界的城市，这是房间级、物体级方法达不到的尺度。

creators.name: Shitao Tang
creators.role_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学研究者
creators.bio: PhD researcher in Yasutaka Furukawa's group at Simon Fraser University, first author of MVDiffusion.
creators.bio_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学 Yasutaka Furukawa 组的博士研究者，MVDiffusion 的第一作者。
creators.why: MVDiffusion made panorama generation a multi-view consistency problem.
creators.why_zh: MVDiffusion 把全景图生成转化为多视角一致性问题。

creators.name: Shijie Zhou
creators.role: Researcher, University of California, Los Angeles
creators.role_zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校研究者
creators.bio: PhD researcher in Achuta Kadambi's lab at UCLA, first author of DreamScene360.
creators.bio_zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校 Achuta Kadambi 实验室的博士研究者，DreamScene360 的第一作者。
creators.why: DreamScene360 lifted a generated panorama into a 360° Gaussian-splat scene.
creators.why_zh: DreamScene360 把生成的全景图提升为 360° 高斯泼溅场景。

creators.name: Shuai Yang
creators.role: Researcher, Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Shanghai AI Laboratory
creators.role_zh: 上海交通大学与上海人工智能实验室研究者
creators.bio: First author of LayerPano3D (SIGGRAPH 2025), written with CUHK, Stanford and NTU collaborators.
creators.bio_zh: LayerPano3D（SIGGRAPH 2025）的第一作者，合作者来自香港中文大学、斯坦福与南洋理工。
creators.why: LayerPano3D separates a panorama into depth layers so that a viewer can move inside it.
creators.why_zh: LayerPano3D 把全景图拆成按深度分层的图层，让观看者可以在其中移动。

creators.name: Yue Yang
creators.role_zh: 宾夕法尼亚大学研究者
creators.bio: PhD researcher at the University of Pennsylvania who led Holodeck with the Allen Institute for AI.
creators.bio_zh: 宾夕法尼亚大学的博士研究者，与艾伦人工智能研究所合作主导了 Holodeck。
creators.why: Holodeck showed that a language model can lay out full, interactive multi-room environments.
creators.why_zh: Holodeck 证明语言模型可以布置完整的、可交互的多房间环境。

creators.name: Allen Institute for AI (Ai2)
creators.role_zh: 非营利 AI 研究机构
creators.bio: Non-profit research institute behind AI2-THOR, ProcTHOR, Objaverse and Holodeck.
creators.bio_zh: 非营利研究机构，开发了 AI2-THOR、ProcTHOR、Objaverse 与 Holodeck。
creators.why: Its simulators and asset libraries are the testbeds where generated houses meet embodied agents.
creators.why_zh: 它的模拟器和资产库是生成房屋与具身智能体相遇的试验场。

creators.name: Alexander Raistrick
creators.role_zh: 普林斯顿视觉与学习实验室研究者
creators.bio: PhD researcher with Jia Deng at Princeton, first author of Infinigen, Infinigen Indoors and ProcFunc.
creators.bio_zh: 普林斯顿大学邓嘉组的博士研究者，Infinigen、Infinigen Indoors 与 ProcFunc 的第一作者。
creators.why: Infinigen generates unlimited photoreal worlds from code alone, with exact ground truth.
creators.why_zh: Infinigen 仅靠代码就能生成无限多的照片级世界，并附带精确的真值标注。

creators.name: Princeton Vision & Learning Lab
creators.role: Jia Deng's computer-vision lab at Princeton University
creators.role_zh: 普林斯顿大学邓嘉的计算机视觉实验室
creators.bio: Academic lab led by Jia Deng that develops the Infinigen procedural world generator.
creators.bio_zh: 由邓嘉领导的高校实验室，开发了 Infinigen 程序化世界生成器。
creators.why: It maintains the main open procedural generator for natural and indoor 3D worlds.
creators.why_zh: 它维护着自然与室内三维世界最主要的开源程序化生成器。

creators.name: Weixi Feng
creators.role_zh: 加州大学圣巴巴拉分校研究者
creators.bio: PhD researcher in William Wang's group at UCSB, first author of LayoutGPT.
creators.bio_zh: 加州大学圣巴巴拉分校王威廉组的博士研究者，LayoutGPT 的第一作者。
creators.why: LayoutGPT showed that a text-only language model can write numeric 3D room layouts.
creators.why_zh: LayoutGPT 证明只懂文字的语言模型也能写出带数值的三维房间布局。

creators.name: Siddharth Ahuja
creators.role_zh: BlenderMCP 开发者
creators.bio: Independent developer who released BlenderMCP, an open-source Model Context Protocol bridge between language models and Blender.
creators.bio_zh: 独立开发者，发布了开源的 BlenderMCP：连接语言模型与 Blender 的 Model Context Protocol 桥接工具。
creators.why: BlenderMCP made chat-driven scene building in a full 3D tool something anyone could install.
creators.why_zh: BlenderMCP 让任何人都能安装并用对话在完整的三维软件里搭建场景。

creators.name: Lihe Yang
creators.role: Researcher, The University of Hong Kong
creators.role_zh: 香港大学研究者
creators.bio: PhD researcher with Hengshuang Zhao at HKU, first author of Depth Anything and Depth Anything V2 (with ByteDance/TikTok).
creators.bio_zh: 香港大学赵恒爽组的博士研究者，与字节跳动（TikTok）合作的 Depth Anything 与 Depth Anything V2 的第一作者。
creators.why: Depth Anything is the default monocular depth model in many photo-to-3D tools.
creators.why_zh: Depth Anything 是许多照片转三维工具默认使用的单目深度模型。

creators.name: Meng-Li Shih
creators.role: Researcher (Virginia Tech, then University of Washington)
creators.role_zh: 研究者（弗吉尼亚理工，后至华盛顿大学）
creators.bio: First author of 3D Photography using Context-aware Layered Depth Inpainting (CVPR 2020), with Jia-Bin Huang and Johannes Kopf.
creators.bio_zh: 《3D Photography using Context-aware Layered Depth Inpainting》（CVPR 2020）的第一作者，合作者包括黄嘉斌与 Johannes Kopf。
creators.why: The method is the direct ancestor of one-photo parallax features such as spatial scenes.
creators.why_zh: 该方法是“空间场景”等单照片视差功能的直接前身。

creators.name: Ruiqi Gao
creators.role_zh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
creators.bio: Generative-model researcher at Google DeepMind and co-first author of CAT3D and CAT4D.
creators.bio_zh: Google DeepMind 的生成模型研究者，CAT3D 与 CAT4D 的共同第一作者。
creators.why: CAT3D made multi-view diffusion the standard way to fill in unseen parts of a scene.
creators.why_zh: CAT3D 让多视角扩散成为补全场景未见部分的标准做法。

creators.name: Stanislaw Szymanowicz
creators.role_zh: 牛津大学视觉几何组研究者
creators.bio: PhD researcher in Oxford's Visual Geometry Group (Splatter Image, Flash3D) and first author of Bolt3D, done with Google.
creators.bio_zh: 牛津大学视觉几何组的博士研究者（Splatter Image、Flash3D），与 Google 合作完成 Bolt3D 并任第一作者。
creators.why: His work drives the shift to feed-forward splat generation in seconds.
creators.why_zh: 他的工作推动了几秒内前馈生成泼溅的转变。

creators.name: Hanwen Liang
creators.role_zh: 多伦多大学研究者
creators.bio: PhD researcher at the University of Toronto and first author of Wonderland, done with Snap Research.
creators.bio_zh: 多伦多大学的博士研究者，与 Snap Research 合作完成 Wonderland 并任第一作者。
creators.why: Wonderland reads 3D splats directly out of a video model's latent space.
creators.why_zh: Wonderland 直接从视频模型的潜空间读出三维泼溅。

creators.name: Xuanchi Ren
creators.role_zh: NVIDIA 研究科学家
creators.bio: Researcher at NVIDIA's Toronto AI Lab, first author of GEN3C and co-author of Lyra.
creators.bio_zh: NVIDIA 多伦多 AI 实验室研究者，GEN3C 的第一作者，Lyra 的合作者。
creators.why: GEN3C adds an explicit 3D cache to video generation for exact camera control.
creators.why_zh: GEN3C 在视频生成中加入显式三维缓存，实现精确的镜头控制。

creators.name: Kaixin Yao
creators.role_zh: 上海科技大学与影眸科技研究者
creators.bio: First author of CAST (SIGGRAPH 2025 Best Paper), developed at ShanghaiTech University and Deemos.
creators.bio_zh: CAST（SIGGRAPH 2025 最佳论文）的第一作者，该工作由上海科技大学与影眸科技完成。
creators.why: CAST rebuilds a photo as separate, physically consistent objects rather than one fused surface.
creators.why_zh: CAST 把一张照片重建为彼此独立、物理关系一致的物体，而不是一整块融合的表面。

works.title: Generative Enactments
works.description: Participants act inside a scenario and receive AI-generated first-person video of the consequences, either after a short wait or streamed reactively, so they can watch a situation unfold in response to what they do.
works.description_zh: 参与者在一个情境中行动，并收到由 AI 生成的第一人称后果视频（短暂等待后返回，或实时流式反应），从而看到情境随自己的行为展开。
works.idea_en: Uses fast, cheap video generation to let people rehearse situations that are unsafe, unethical or not yet possible to stage, with a configuration that researchers can specify and compare.
works.idea_zh: 借助快速、廉价的视频生成，让人预演那些不安全、不合伦理或尚无法布置的情境，并提供研究者可以设定和比较的配置。
works.method: A configuration form specifies how researchers, participants and AI systems propose, generate, contest and revise pathways; illustrated with domestic-robot attention (adversarial, turn-based), bystander intervention (choice-based) and trainee-teacher rehearsal (reactive streaming), with implementation and pilot evidence.
works.method_zh: 用一张配置表规定研究者、参与者与 AI 系统如何提出、生成、质疑和修改不同路径；以家用机器人的注意分配（对抗式、回合制）、旁观者干预（选择式）和实习教师后果预演（实时流式）三个案例说明，并报告实现与试用证据。
works.title_zh: 生成式演绎

works.title: When Generative Artificial Intelligence Meets Extended Reality: A Systematic Review
works.description: PRISMA systematic review of 26 articles from 2023 to 2025 that combine generative AI with XR, summarizing the application areas and key technical implementations and pointing out research gaps.
works.description_zh: 按 PRISMA 流程筛选出 26 篇 2023–2025 年将生成式 AI 与 XR 结合的文章，总结其应用领域与关键技术实现，并指出研究空白。
works.idea_en: The field is young and small: three years of work fit in 26 papers, so methods for generative immersive research are still open territory.
works.idea_zh: 这一领域年轻且规模不大：三年的工作只有 26 篇论文——生成式沉浸研究的方法论仍是一片有待开拓的领域。
works.method: Systematic review following PRISMA with database search, screening and thematic analysis of the included articles.
works.method_zh: 遵循 PRISMA 的系统综述，包括数据库检索、筛选与对纳入文章的主题分析。

paper.venue: International Journal of Human-Computer Interaction (2026; online 2025-09-30)
paper.title: When Generative Artificial Intelligence Meets Extended Reality: A Systematic Review

works.title_zh: 当生成式人工智能遇上扩展现实：一项系统综述

works.title: Matrix-Game 4.0
works.description: An open release that keeps the game logic, physics and player input in a real game engine and uses a causal video model only to turn the engine's low-poly frames into detailed visuals; it ships three playable games (medieval castle, ancient Egypt, city racing) with weights and source.
works.description_zh: 一次开源发布：游戏逻辑、物理与玩家输入都留在真正的游戏引擎中，因果视频模型只负责把引擎输出的低多边形画面变成精细画面；附带三款可玩游戏（中世纪城堡、古埃及、城市赛车）的权重与源代码。
works.idea_en: Hands state and rules back to an engine and leaves only appearance to the model, which restores persistence and experimental control.
works.idea_zh: 把状态与规则交还给引擎，只让模型负责外观，从而找回持久性与实验控制。
works.method: Streaming neural rendering: a few-step causal video model renders successive chunks conditioned on low-poly RGB frames and text prompts from an executable engine.
works.method_zh: 流式神经渲染：少步因果视频模型以可执行引擎输出的低多边形 RGB 画面和文字提示为条件，逐段渲染后续画面。
works.title_zh: Matrix-Game 4.0（昆仑万维）

works.title: Griffin
works.description: Griffin is a full-duplex video-to-video model for live video calls: it watches and hears the person, decides moment by moment whether to speak, hold, back-channel or yield, and generates the speech and every pixel of a 720p person in real time from one reference image. Tavus reports that 48% of people in one-minute calls thought it was a real person; Griffin-Lite is a research preview for selected testers as of October 2026.
works.description_zh: Griffin 是一个面向视频通话的全双工视频到视频模型：它同时看和听对方，每隔不到一秒判断该说话、停顿、附和还是让出话轮，并从一张参考图像实时生成语音和 720p 画面中人物的每一个像素。Tavus 报告称，在一分钟的通话中有 48% 的参与者认为对方是真人；截至 2026 年 10 月，Griffin-Lite 仅以研究预览形式向部分测试者开放。
works.idea_en: The first commercial virtual human that listens while it talks, can be interrupted and nods mid-sentence, so face-to-face timing becomes a generated, studyable variable.
works.idea_zh: 第一个边说边听、可被打断、会在对方说话时点头的商用虚拟人，让面对面的时机本身成为可生成、可研究的变量。
works.method: A continuous conversational model reads incoming audio and video at sub-second intervals and emits text plus control signals; a streaming autoregressive diffusion speech generator (on a 48 kHz continuous codec) and a few-step causal video DiT distilled with DMD2, teacher forcing and Self-Forcing render the reply.
works.method_zh: 一个连续对话模型以亚秒间隔读取输入的音视频并输出文本和控制信号；随后由流式自回归扩散语音生成器（基于 48 kHz 连续编解码器）和经 DMD2、teacher forcing 与 Self-Forcing 蒸馏的少步因果视频 DiT 渲染回应。
works.specs: 720p · real time · 0.43 s avg audio-to-video latency (H100) · 48% judged human in 1-min calls · VideoFDB generation 3.83 (human 3.92)
works.title_zh: Griffin 人类交互模型

works.title: Sessions (Interactive Avatars)
works.description: Sessions is Synthesia's platform for two-way conversations with real-time avatars: Roleplay Sessions (first released in July 2026) let employees rehearse sales, coaching or support conversations with an avatar that pushes back, followed by AI scoring and feedback, and Survey Sessions turn a form into a spoken interview. An Interactive Avatars API exposes the same avatars to developers.
works.description_zh: Sessions 是 Synthesia 用于与实时虚拟人双向对话的平台：Roleplay Sessions（2026 年 7 月首发）让员工与会“反驳”的虚拟人演练销售、辅导或客服对话，结束后由 AI 打分并反馈；Survey Sessions 把问卷变成口头访谈。Interactive Avatars API 向开发者开放同一套虚拟人。
works.idea_en: A mainstream training vendor now sells scored roleplay with a responsive avatar, which is the deliberate-practice loop of simulation training at enterprise scale.
works.idea_zh: 主流培训厂商开始销售与会回应的虚拟人进行可打分的角色扮演，这正是模拟训练中“刻意练习”循环的企业级版本。
works.method: Likely a cascaded stack (speech recognition, an LLM scenario prompt, TTS and Synthesia's real-time avatar renderer) with a separate LLM coach that grades transcripts.
works.method_zh: 很可能是级联方案（语音识别、大模型情境提示、语音合成和 Synthesia 的实时虚拟人渲染器），另有一个大模型教练对对话记录评分。
works.title_zh: Sessions 交互虚拟人会话

works.title: Agora-2
works.description: A playable research preview of a multi-agent world model in which up to 20 humans and AI agents share one generated world in real time, each participant's actions changing what the others see; it was trained on Diablo II gameplay captures.
works.description_zh: 一个可游玩的多智能体世界模型研究预览：最多 20 名人类与 AI 智能体实时共处于同一个生成世界，每个人的动作都会改变其他人看到的画面；训练数据来自《暗黑破坏神 II》的游戏录像。
works.idea_en: A shared generated world is the precondition for social situations; Agora-2 shows it working, but in one game's visual world.
works.idea_zh: 共享的生成世界是社会情境的前提；Agora-2 展示了它的可行性，但目前局限于一款游戏的画面世界。
works.method: A world model trained on Diablo II captures that pair observations with actions and game state, predicting a shared state from many participants' simultaneous actions; it extends Agora-1 (May 2026) to 5× more participants and multiple environments.
works.method_zh: 以配对了观察、动作与游戏状态的《暗黑破坏神 II》录像训练的世界模型，根据多名参与者的同时动作预测共享状态；相较 Agora-1（2026 年 5 月）参与人数增加 5 倍，并支持多个环境。
works.title_zh: Agora-2：多智能体世界模型

works.title: Eleven v4
works.description: ElevenLabs' 2026 text-to-speech generation, with a new architecture, a Turbo variant for low-latency agents, one voice across many languages and more consistent voice cloning. ElevenLabs says it follows inline direction such as [laughs], [said angrily in French accent] or sound cues like [light rain] more accurately than v3.
works.description_zh: ElevenLabs 2026 年的新一代语音合成：新架构、面向低延迟智能体的 Turbo 版本、同一声音跨多种语言，以及更稳定的声音克隆。ElevenLabs 表示，它比 v3 更准确地遵循 [laughs]、[said angrily in French accent] 这类行内指示，甚至 [light rain] 这样的声音提示。
works.idea_en: Acting direction and inline sound cues in one pass blur the line between a voice line and a small sound scene.
works.idea_zh: 一次生成里同时包含表演指示和行内声音提示，模糊了“一句台词”和“一个小型声音场景”之间的界线。
works.method: New TTS architecture (unpublished) with a separate Turbo model for real-time use; follows audio tags and direction prompts.
works.method_zh: 新的语音合成架构（未公开），另有用于实时场景的 Turbo 模型；遵循音频标签与表演指示提示。

works.title: Kling 4.0
works.description: Kling 4.0, introduced on 2026-09-28 (a Flash version went first to top-tier subscribers), extends single generations to about 30 seconds with keyframe control and stereo sound; broader rollout was reported for 2026-10-16, and it is live on kling.ai as of mid-October 2026.
works.description_zh: 可灵 4.0 于 2026-09-28 推出（Flash 版先向高阶订阅用户开放），单次生成延长到约 30 秒，支持关键帧控制和立体声；据报道于 2026-10-16 全面推出，截至 2026 年 10 月中旬已在 kling.ai 上线。
works.idea_en: Thirty-second takes can hold a whole short interaction (approach, exchange, reaction) in one continuous shot.
works.idea_zh: 30 秒的长镜头可以在一个连续镜头里容纳一段完整的短互动（接近、交流、反应）。
works.method: Next Kling generation; reported to accept up to 10 keyframe images per clip and to output up to 4K; architecture not published.
works.method_zh: 可灵新一代模型；据报道每段最多可用 10 张关键帧图像并输出最高 4K；架构未公开。
works.specs: ~30 s per generation · up to 10 keyframes · up to 4K (reported)
works.title_zh: 可灵 4.0

works.title: Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar
works.description: Live Avatar couples Google's Gemini 3.8 Live dialogue model with near-real-time video generation, so an enterprise agent appears as a talking character that sees and hears the user, lip-syncs across 97 languages (switching mid-conversation) and keeps talking while tools run in the background. It is available in Gemini Enterprise with preset avatars; custom avatars from a reference image are allowlist-only, and all audio and video carry SynthID watermarks.
works.description_zh: Live Avatar 把 Google 的 Gemini 3.8 Live 对话模型与近实时视频生成结合起来，让企业智能体以一个会说话的角色出现：它能看到和听到用户，在 97 种语言间（可在对话中途切换）保持口型同步，并在后台调用工具时继续对话。它已在 Gemini Enterprise 中提供预设虚拟人；用参考图像定制虚拟人仅向白名单企业开放，所有音频和视频都带有 SynthID 水印。
works.idea_en: A frontier-lab virtual human ships with provenance built in: every generated frame and word is watermarked, which matters for studies that must disclose synthetic interlocutors.
works.idea_zh: 前沿实验室的虚拟人在发布时就内置了溯源标识：生成的每一帧画面和每一句话都带水印，这对需要披露“对话者是合成的”研究很重要。
works.method: Gemini 3.8 Live native audio dialogue (audio and video in, speech out) natively coupled with a low-latency streaming video generator; turn-taking is handled by the Live model, with interruption support as in the Live API (Google describes 'fluid turn-taking', not overlapping speech).
works.method_zh: Gemini 3.8 Live 原生音频对话（音视频输入、语音输出）与低延迟流式视频生成器原生耦合；轮流发言由 Live 模型处理，像 Live API 一样支持打断（Google 的描述是“流畅的轮流发言”，而非重叠说话）。
works.specs: 97 languages · near-real-time streaming video · SynthID in audio and video
works.title_zh: Gemini 3.8 Live 实时虚拟人（Live Avatar）

works.title: Character World Model-1 (CWM-1)
works.description: CWM-1 generates an entire live video-call scene from one image of any character (person, anime, animal): face, body, hands, hair and surroundings, with an emotion engine that triggers actions such as shrugging, leaning in or picking up a phone. It follows LemonSlice-2 (December 2025), a 20B causal model that ran at 20 fps on one GPU.
works.description_zh: CWM-1 只需任意角色（真人、动漫、动物）的一张图像，就能生成整个实时视频通话画面：脸、身体、手、头发和周围环境；其情绪引擎会触发耸肩、前倾、拿起手机等动作。它接替了 2025 年 12 月发布的 LemonSlice-2（一个在单 GPU 上以 20 fps 运行的 20B 因果模型）。
works.idea_en: Treats the avatar as a small world model centred on a character, so body language and object interaction are generated rather than rigged.
works.idea_zh: 把虚拟人看作以角色为中心的小型世界模型，肢体语言和与物体的互动都是生成出来的，而不是靠绑定动画。
works.method: A causal, few-step video diffusion transformer conditioned on audio, a prompt and action/emotion states predicted by a separate emotion engine that reads the conversation.
works.method_zh: 一个因果、少步的视频扩散 Transformer，以音频、提示词以及独立情绪引擎（读取对话内容）预测的动作/情绪状态为条件。
works.specs: LemonSlice-2: 20B params · 20 fps on 1 GPU · 471 ms p99 latency (platform)
works.title_zh: 角色世界模型 CWM-1

works.title: PixVerse R2
works.description: A real-time world model for continuous audiovisual play: users move with WASD, change weather or call in a vehicle by prompt, speak or add references, and the consequences carry forward; PixVerse's own demos include questioning an AI suspect in real time.
works.description_zh: 一个用于连续音视频交互的实时世界模型：用户用 WASD 移动，用提示改变天气或召来车辆，也可以说话或添加参考素材，而这些改变的后果会延续下去；PixVerse 自己的演示中包括实时审问一名 AI 嫌疑人。
works.idea_en: Consequences that persist inside a running world, plus spoken input, move world models toward interactive scenarios such as interviews.
works.idea_zh: 让后果在运行中的世界里延续，再加上语音输入，使世界模型向审讯、访谈这类交互情境靠近。
works.method: Movement, prompt, audio and reference inputs at different rates are merged into one continuous generation loop on top of PixVerse's audio-video model.
works.method_zh: 在 PixVerse 音视频模型之上，把不同速率的移动、提示、音频与参考输入融合进同一个连续生成循环。
works.title_zh: PixVerse R2（爱诗科技）

works.title: AVTR-1
works.description: AVTR-1 is an open stack for real-time avatar conversations: a small motion generator listens to both the user's and the voice agent's audio, and a renderer and serving backend turn it into a synchronized audio-video stream that handles interruptions. Weights, renderer and backend are released under component-specific licenses.
works.description_zh: AVTR-1 是一个开源的实时虚拟人对话方案：一个小型动作生成器同时听用户和语音智能体的声音，再由渲染器和服务后端把结果变成同步的音视频流，并能处理打断。模型权重、渲染器和后端均按各组件的许可证发布。
works.idea_en: An open, measurable reference for the plumbing of live avatars, including a test (R-DGG) of whether the listener's motion actually depends on the other speaker.
works.idea_zh: 为实时虚拟人的底层管线提供开放、可测量的参照，还给出一个检验倾听者动作是否真的依赖对方说话的指标（R-DGG）。
works.method: A 153M-parameter autoregressive flow-matching motion generator conditioned on both participants' audio, with a self-distilled streaming audio encoder and analytically bounded user-facing latency.
works.method_zh: 一个 1.53 亿参数的自回归流匹配动作生成器，以双方音频为条件，配合自蒸馏的流式音频编码器，并对用户可感知的延迟给出解析上界。
works.specs: 153M-param motion model · real time on data-center and consumer GPUs

paper.title: AVTR-1: Open Stack for Real-Time Interactive Avatars

works.title_zh: AVTR-1：实时交互虚拟人开源方案

works.title: Gemini 3.8 Live
works.description: Two audio-to-audio models for the Live API, generally available since 15 September 2026: Gemini 3.8 Live for low-latency dialogue and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking, which reasons in the background during the conversation. Google highlights asynchronous function calls and proactive audio, where the agent speaks only when relevant.
works.description_zh: 两款用于 Live API 的音频到音频模型，自 2026 年 9 月 15 日起正式可用：Gemini 3.8 Live 面向低延迟对话，Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking 能在对话进行中于后台推理。谷歌重点介绍了异步函数调用与主动音频，即智能体只在相关时才开口。
works.idea_en: Background reasoning during speech closes the gap between a fast voice and a smart one, useful for characters that must stay responsive while working through complex scenario logic.
works.idea_zh: 说话时在后台推理，缩小了“反应快”和“想得深”之间的差距，适合需要一边保持回应、一边处理复杂情境逻辑的角色。
works.method: Audio-to-audio Gemini models with interleaved reasoning and default asynchronous function calling, succeeding gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview (March 2026).
works.method_zh: 音频到音频的 Gemini 模型，支持交错推理与默认异步函数调用，接替 2026 年 3 月的 gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview。

works.title: Odyssey-3
works.description: Odyssey's third foundation world model, which the company says can both generate interactive worlds and, with small action decoders trained on hours of data, control robot arms, humanoids, cars, drones and video-game characters.
works.description_zh: Odyssey 的第三代基础世界模型；公司称，它既能生成交互世界，也能借助用数小时数据训练的小型动作解码器，控制机械臂、人形机器人、汽车、无人机和游戏角色。
works.idea_en: One world model as both simulator and controller, which would let the same model play the environment and the agents in it.
works.idea_zh: 同一个世界模型既是模拟器又是控制器，这意味着同一个模型可以同时扮演环境和其中的智能体。
works.method: An autoregressive diffusion transformer trained on a large collection of visual observations; task-specific action decoders translate its internal representations into control signals.
works.method_zh: 在大量视觉观察数据上训练的自回归扩散 Transformer；针对具体任务的动作解码器把其内部表征转换为控制信号。
works.specs: few to tens of hours of task data per embodiment (developer-reported)

works.title: Roblox Build and AI creation tools
works.description: At RDC 2026 (2026-09-11) Roblox described an 'AI creation layer' on its engine: Build, a tab in the Roblox app where anyone makes a game from prompts (about 9,000 games published in its New Zealand alpha, now expanding to Serbia and Singapore), and Scene Generator, due later in 2026, which turns a text prompt plus a reference image into a functional layout editable in Studio. These sit alongside Studio's Assistant and the open Cube 3D model.
works.description_zh: 在 RDC 2026（2026-09-11）上，Roblox 介绍了建在引擎之上的“AI 创作层”：Build 是 Roblox 应用里的一个标签页，任何人都能用提示词做游戏（新西兰内测期间已发布约 9,000 款，现扩展到塞尔维亚和新加坡）；Scene Generator 将于 2026 年晚些时候推出，可把文字提示加参考图变成可在 Studio 中继续编辑的功能性布局。它们与 Studio 的 Assistant 以及开源的 Cube 3D 模型并列。
works.idea_en: Prompt-to-game on a platform with 29 billion play-hours a quarter means generated situations reach players at scale, a recruitment and ecological-validity channel as much as a tool.
works.idea_zh: 在一个每季度 290 亿小时游玩时长的平台上用提示词做游戏，意味着生成的情境能大规模触达玩家：它既是工具，也是招募被试、提升生态效度的渠道。
works.method: LLM agents and generative 3D models (Cube) likely produce Luau scripts, assets and layouts inside Roblox's engine and cloud services; games publish instantly to Roblox's multiplayer infrastructure.
works.method_zh: 大语言模型智能体与生成式三维模型（Cube）很可能在 Roblox 引擎与云服务中生成 Luau 脚本、资源与布局；游戏可即时发布到 Roblox 的多人在线基础设施上。
works.specs: Build alpha: ~9,000 games by 2026-09-01; 71% of Build creators had never used Studio · Scene Generator: later 2026
works.title_zh: Roblox Build 与 AI 创作工具

works.title: Hyper3D WorldGen
works.description: Hyper3D's scene generator turns a single photo into a 3D scene of independent, editable objects (generated as Rodin meshes with estimated collision geometry, mass and friction) set in a Gaussian-splat background, for robotics simulation, film, games and spatial computing.
works.description_zh: Hyper3D 的场景生成产品：把一张照片变成由独立、可编辑物体组成的三维场景——物体由 Rodin 生成网格，并估计碰撞几何、质量和摩擦——背景则用高斯泼溅呈现，面向机器人仿真、影视、游戏和空间计算。
works.idea_en: Objects arrive with physical properties, so a photographed room can become an interactive scene rather than a backdrop.
works.idea_zh: 物体自带物理属性，一张房间照片因此能变成可交互的场景，而不是一块背景板。
works.method: Building on CAST, objects are detected automatically or by user boxes, completed in 3D, placed via a contact, support and suspension relation graph with estimated pose, scale and physics, while the background is reconstructed as 3D Gaussian splats.
works.method_zh: 在 CAST 的基础上，自动检测物体或由用户框选，补全三维形状，借助接触、支撑与悬挂的关系图估计位姿、尺度与物理属性并完成摆放，背景则重建为三维高斯泼溅。

works.title: VR scuba diving with harbor seals increases ocean connectedness, and the effect of conversational AI on pro-environmental engagement depends on prior experience with seals
works.description: In OceanSpeak, participants scuba-dive in VR and talk with an AI-powered harbor seal about ocean acidification and overfishing. A preregistered study (N=106) used a yoked control: control participants saw identical content, including another participant's AI conversation, but could not talk themselves.
works.description_zh: 在 OceanSpeak 中，参与者在 VR 里潜水，并与一只 AI 驱动的港海豹谈论海洋酸化与过度捕捞。一项预注册研究（N=106）采用“配对对照”设计：对照组看到完全相同的内容，包括另一位参与者与 AI 的对话，但自己不能开口。
works.idea_en: Yoked controls address the core problem of studying generative conversation: each control sees exactly what a treated participant got, which isolates the effect of interacting.
works.idea_zh: 配对对照解决了研究生成式对话的核心难题：每个对照者看到的正是某位实验组参与者得到的内容，从而分离出“互动”本身的效应。
works.method: Preregistered between-subjects experiment with Stanford's Virtual Human Interaction Lab using yoked replay of AI conversations; outcomes were ocean connectedness, empathy with seals, pro-ocean behaviors and knowledge.
works.method_zh: 与斯坦福虚拟人交互实验室合作的预注册被试间实验，以配对回放 AI 对话作为对照；结局指标包括海洋联结感、对海豹的共情、护海行为与知识。

paper.title: VR scuba diving with harbor seals increases ocean connectedness, and the effect of conversational AI on pro-environmental engagement depends on prior experience with seals

works.title_zh: 与港海豹一起 VR 潜水可增强海洋联结感，而对话式 AI 对护海参与的影响取决于此前与海豹的接触经历

works.title: Tripo P2.0
works.description: Tripo's character model that generates animation-ready characters with clean quad topology from an image or a prompt; it appeared as a preview on 6 September 2026 and was released officially on 1 October 2026.
works.description_zh: Tripo 的角色模型，可由图像或提示词生成带干净四边形拓扑、可直接做动画的角色；2026 年 9 月 6 日发布预览，10 月 1 日正式上线。
works.idea_en: Quad topology with sensible edge flow is what lets a generated character deform properly when it moves; P2.0 targets the gap between a statue and an actor.
works.idea_zh: 布线合理的四边形拓扑，是生成角色在运动时能正确变形的前提；P2.0 针对的正是“雕像”与“演员”之间的差距。
works.method: Proprietary; VAST has not published the architecture.
works.method_zh: 专有模型；VAST 尚未公开其架构。

works.title: GWM Worlds 2
works.description: A research preview of a playable world model that streams video and sound together; one person can play a character while another 'directs' the scene with text actions addressed to any subject, such as a sword slash, a spoken reply or a room flooding.
works.description_zh: 一个可游玩世界模型的研究预览，同时流式生成画面与声音；一个人扮演角色，另一个人可以用发给任何对象的文字动作“导演”场景，比如挥剑、说一句话，或让房间进水。
works.idea_en: Separates what persists (scene, subjects, rules) from what happens (timestamped events), which is close to how an experimenter would script a situation.
works.idea_zh: 把“持续存在的东西”（场景、角色、规则）与“发生的事”（带时间戳的事件）分开，这与实验者编排情境的方式非常接近。
works.method: Built on Runway's audio-video model and driven by 'WorldPrompt': a genesis prompt with scene, subjects and laws, a first frame, a timestamped stream of free-text actions, and per-frame camera input.
works.method_zh: 基于 Runway 的音视频生成模型，由“WorldPrompt”驱动：包含场景、角色与规则的创世提示、首帧、带时间戳的自由文本动作流，以及逐帧镜头输入。
works.specs: 720p · 24 fps · 48 kHz audio · no preset session length (developer-reported)

works.title: Atlas
works.description: World Labs' 'omni' world model, pretrained from scratch on text, images, video and 3D: from one to a few reference images and a hand-designed camera path it generates up to one minute of 1440p video, reconstructs real places from one to over a hundred photos, and outputs point clouds or Gaussian splats. Early access only as of October 2026; World Labs says it will power future versions of Marble.
works.description_zh: World Labs 的“全模态”世界模型，从零开始在文本、图像、视频和三维数据上预训练：给定一到几张参考图和手工设计的镜头路径，可生成最长一分钟的 1440p 视频；能用一张到一百多张照片重建真实地点，并输出点云或高斯泼溅。截至 2026 年 10 月仅开放抢先体验；World Labs 表示它将驱动未来版本的 Marble。
works.idea_en: One model now spans imagined and real places: the more photos of a site you give it, the less it invents, which makes 'grounded versus imagined' a dial a study can set.
works.idea_zh: 同一个模型既能想象也能重建：给它的现场照片越多，它编造的就越少，“真实与想象”的比例变成研究可以设定的一个旋钮。
works.method: A multimodal autoregressive diffusion transformer encodes every input image at a 3D position in a shared spatial context and generates new frames and depth maps conditioned on it with pixel-exact camera geometry; depth is fused into point clouds and completed into 3D Gaussian splats.
works.method_zh: 多模态自回归扩散 Transformer 把每张输入图像放在共享空间上下文中的三维位置上，再以像素级精确的相机几何为条件生成新画面与深度图；深度被融合成点云，并补全为三维高斯泼溅。
works.specs: up to 60 s video at 1440p · 1–6 reference images for generation · reconstruction from 1 to 100+ images · point cloud / 3DGS output

works.title: Sparrow-2
works.description: Sparrow-2 is Tavus' turn-taking model: it decides every 10 ms whether a voice or video agent should listen, wait or speak, distinguishing a thinking pause from the end of a turn and real interruptions from background noise. Tavus reports it leads the TurnBench benchmark in end-of-turn (92.4% recall) and interruption detection (97.4% recall).
works.description_zh: Sparrow-2 是 Tavus 的轮流发言模型：它每 10 ms 判断一次语音或视频智能体应该听、等还是说，能区分思考中的停顿与话轮结束，也能区分真正的打断与背景噪声。Tavus 称它在 TurnBench 基准上的话轮结束检测（召回率 92.4%）和打断检测（召回率 97.4%）均排名第一。
works.idea_en: Conversational timing is now a measurable model output with its own benchmark, which makes response latency something an experiment can set.
works.idea_zh: 对话时机如今是有专门基准的可测量模型输出，这让回应延迟成为实验可以设定的变量。
works.method: A streaming acoustic-semantic model over the whole audio scene (speaker intent, prosody, environment) that replaces silence timers and VAD endpointing; successor to Sparrow-0 (2025) and Sparrow-1 (January 2026).
works.method_zh: 一个基于整体音频场景（说话意图、韵律、环境）的流式声学-语义模型，取代静音计时与 VAD 端点检测；前代为 Sparrow-0（2025）和 Sparrow-1（2026 年 1 月）。
works.specs: 10 ms decision frame · TurnBench end-of-turn recall 92.4% · interruption recall 97.4%
works.title_zh: Sparrow-2 轮流发言模型

works.title: Meshy 7
works.description: Meshy's image-to-3D model tuned for geometry alignment, meaning how closely the generated shape matches the input image, launched with Meshy's own alignment benchmark; the Meshy 7.1 update (10 September 2026) adds an Ultra 4K mode that generates geometry at 4096³ with raw meshes of up to 80 million triangles.
works.description_zh: Meshy 针对“几何对齐”（生成形状与输入图像的吻合程度）调优的图生三维模型，并随模型发布了自建的对齐基准；2026 年 9 月 10 日的 Meshy 7.1 更新加入 Ultra 4K 模式，几何分辨率达 4096³，原始网格最多 8000 万个三角面。
works.idea_en: Once obvious failures are rare, 3D generators compete on faithfulness to a reference and on surface detail, which matters when a generated prop must match a specific real object. Meshy reports that Meshy 7 and 7.1 lead its own benchmarks; these are not independent tests.
works.idea_zh: 当明显的失败已不多见，三维生成的竞争就落在对参考图的忠实度和表面细节上，这在生成的道具必须对应某个真实物体时尤其重要。Meshy 称 Meshy 7 和 7.1 在其自建基准上领先，但这些并非独立测试。
works.method: Proprietary image-to-3D foundation model; for 7.1 Meshy scaled its voxel geometry representation and generation backbone from 2048³ to 4096³ and added high-precision mesh extraction and simplification.
works.method_zh: 专有的图生三维基础模型；7.1 把体素几何表示和生成主干从 2048³ 扩展到 4096³，并加入高精度网格提取与简化。
works.specs: 7.1 Ultra 4K: 4096³ geometry · up to 80M raw triangles

works.title: WorldClaw
works.description: A Tencent Hunyuan agentic system that turns one open-ended prompt into a large, explorable open-world 3D scene with terrain, regions and editable instance-level assets.
works.description_zh: 腾讯混元的智能体系统：把一句开放式提示词变成大尺度、可探索的开放世界三维场景，包含地形、分区和可编辑的实例级资产。
works.idea_en: Agents that plan, build and then inspect renders can scale generation from a room to a landscape while keeping every object editable.
works.idea_zh: 会规划、会搭建、还会检查渲染结果的智能体，可以把生成规模从一个房间扩展到一片地景，同时让每个物体都保持可编辑。
works.method: Planning agents write a structured specification (regions, terrain, assets, materials, spatial relations); a region-aware height field and semantic layout form the terrain, detailed regions are generated as terrain-conditioned compositions and reconstructed into textured meshes, and render-based agents refine terrain, objects and contacts.
works.method_zh: 规划智能体先写出结构化规格（分区、地形、资产、材质、空间关系）；由分区感知的高度场和语义布局构成地形，细节区域以地形为条件生成组合并重建为带纹理的网格，最后由基于渲染的智能体修正地形、物体与接触关系。

paper.title: WorldClaw: Agentic 3D Open-World Generation at Scale

works.title_zh: WorldClaw：智能体驱动的大规模开放世界生成

works.title: WorldTrace
works.description: A training-free fix for interactive video world models that forget once a session runs past their training length: it keeps the model's compressed memory addressable so long rollouts stay smooth and previously visited scenes can be recalled.
works.description_zh: 一种无需重新训练的修补方法，针对会话超出训练长度后就开始遗忘的交互视频世界模型：让模型压缩后的记忆仍可被准确寻址，使长时推演保持平滑，并能回想起曾经到过的场景。
works.idea_en: Pinpoints why world models forget (positional encodings drift out of range) and fixes it without retraining, so existing models can run longer sessions.
works.idea_zh: 指出世界模型遗忘的原因在于位置编码超出训练范围，并在不重新训练的情况下加以修复，让现有模型能运行更长的会话。
works.method: The KV cache is compressed into fixed in-distribution slot positions with canonical-key writers, avoiding averaging across incompatible RoPE phases; two variants target smooth rollouts (Field) and scene recall (Landmark).
works.method_zh: 把 KV 缓存压缩到固定、处于训练分布内的槽位，并用规范化键写入，避免把相位不兼容的 RoPE 平均在一起；两个变体分别面向平滑推演（Field）与场景回想（Landmark）。

paper.title: Addressable Memory for Video World Models

works.title_zh: WorldTrace：视频世界模型的可寻址记忆

works.title: Wan 3.0
works.description: Wan 3.0 entered public beta on Alibaba Cloud on 2026-08-06; unlike the open Wan 2.1 and 2.2 it is closed and API-only, and it takes text, image, video and audio in one prompt. Wan 2.5 (2025-09) and Wan 2.6 (2025-12) had already added native audio and reference casting.
works.description_zh: 通义万相 Wan 3.0 于 2026-08-06 在阿里云开启公测；与开源的 Wan 2.1、2.2 不同，它闭源、仅提供 API，可在一个提示中同时接收文本、图像、视频和音频。此前 Wan 2.5（2025 年 9 月）和 Wan 2.6（2025 年 12 月）已加入原生音频与参考角色功能。
works.idea_en: Even the leading open-weight video lab now keeps its newest flagship closed, so open Wan models trail by a generation.
works.idea_zh: 就连最重要的开源视频团队也开始把最新旗舰闭源，开源的 Wan 模型因此落后一代。
works.method: Multimodal audio-video generation model served through Alibaba Cloud Model Studio; architecture and weights not published as of October 2026.
works.method_zh: 通过阿里云百炼提供服务的多模态音视频生成模型；截至 2026 年 10 月，架构与权重均未公开。
works.title_zh: 通义万相 3.0

works.title: SeedRealtime
works.description: ByteDance Seed's native audio-visual full-duplex model, which watches, listens and speaks at once, chimes in or pauses at the right moment, and ignores bystander chatter and background noise. Seed reports that it halves conversational pacing problems compared with cascaded systems in human evaluation, and that it is fully rolled out at scale.
works.description_zh: 字节跳动 Seed 的原生视听全双工模型：能同时看、听、说，在合适的时机插话或停顿，并能忽略旁人闲聊和背景噪音。Seed 报告称，人工评测中它的对话节奏问题比级联系统减少一半，并已全量大规模上线。
works.idea_en: Proactive, interference-robust timing in a deployed product: the system decides when to speak from what it sees and hears, not from silence.
works.idea_zh: 在已部署的产品中实现主动、抗干扰的对话时机：系统根据看到和听到的内容决定何时开口，而不是依据静音。
works.method: A unified architecture that natively fuses continuous audio, video and text streams and models the user's conversational state, replacing an external voice-activity detector.
works.method_zh: 统一架构原生融合连续的音频、视频与文本流，并对用户的对话状态建模，取代外部的语音活动检测器。
works.title_zh: SeedRealtime 视听全双工大模型

works.title: GAIA-4
works.description: The fourth GAIA world model, which puts Wayve's AI Driver in the loop: a recorded drive becomes the starting point of a simulation in which the camera view changes with every braking or steering decision, so engineers can test futures that never happened.
works.description_zh: 第四代 GAIA 世界模型，让 Wayve 的 AI 驾驶员参与闭环：一段真实行驶记录成为仿真的起点，每一次刹车或转向决定都会改变摄像头看到的画面，工程师因此可以测试从未发生过的未来。
works.idea_en: Closed-loop and anchored to a real recording: the counterfactual changes only what the agent's decision changes, a clean design for 'what if' tests.
works.idea_zh: 闭环且锚定在真实记录上：反事实只改变由智能体决定所引起的部分，是做“如果……会怎样”测试的干净设计。
works.method: A multimodal world model that re-simulates sensor input conditioned on the driving model's actions while keeping the underlying scene tied to the original recording as a deterministic baseline.
works.method_zh: 多模态世界模型，以驾驶模型的动作为条件重新模拟传感器输入，同时让底层场景与原始记录保持一致，作为确定性的基线。

works.title: MiniMax H3
works.description: MiniMax H3 (2026-07-31) generates up to 15 seconds of 2K video with native stereo sound from text, image, video and audio context and edits video by instruction; unusually for a flagship, MiniMax published the weights on Hugging Face.
works.description_zh: MiniMax H3（2026-07-31）可根据文本、图像、视频和音频上下文生成最长 15 秒、2K 分辨率并带原生立体声的视频，也能按指令编辑视频；少见的是，MiniMax 把这款旗舰模型的权重发布在了 Hugging Face 上。
works.idea_en: A flagship-level audio-video model with downloadable weights lets a lab pin the exact model behind its stimuli.
works.idea_zh: 可下载权重的旗舰级音视频模型，让实验室能锁定刺激材料背后的确切模型版本。
works.method: Contextual Omni Representation with an H3-VAE, an H3-Omni Transformer and in-context regeneration for editing (per MiniMax).
works.method_zh: MiniMax 称其采用上下文全模态表征（Contextual Omni Representation），包括 H3-VAE、H3-Omni Transformer，以及用于编辑的上下文再生成。
works.specs: up to 15 s · 2K · native stereo audio

works.title: Real-time AI style transfer on Spectacles
works.description: An experiment connects Snap Spectacles to Decart's real-time video model and projects the transformed camera feed back into the wearer's view at real-world scale, so the street appears restyled live.
works.description_zh: 一项实验把 Snap Spectacles 接入 Decart 的实时视频模型，再把改造后的摄像头画面按真实尺度投回佩戴者视野，让街景实时呈现另一种风格。
works.idea_en: On see-through glasses, restyling has to decide what to augment and where, not just filter the whole frame.
works.idea_zh: 在透视式眼镜上，重绘需要决定增强什么、在哪里增强，而不只是给整个画面加滤镜。
works.method: The Spectacles camera stream is sent over WebRTC to Decart's real-time video-to-video API and the returned frames are rendered at world scale in the lens; the prototype was built in a day with an agentic coding loop.
works.method_zh: Spectacles 摄像头画面经 WebRTC 发送到 Decart 的实时视频到视频 API，返回的画面在镜头中按真实尺度渲染；这个原型借助智能体编程循环在一天内完成。
works.title_zh: Spectacles 上的实时 AI 风格迁移

works.title: Seed Audio 1.0
works.description: ByteDance Seed's scene-level audio creation model that generates speech, sound effects, ambience and background texture together from one prompt, so a line of dialogue arrives with its room tone, footsteps and alarms already in place. It is available through BytePlus.
works.description_zh: 字节跳动 Seed 的场景级音频创作模型，用一个提示同时生成语音、音效、环境声与背景质感，让一句台词连同房间混响、脚步声和警报声一起出现。可通过 BytePlus 使用。
works.idea_en: Generates the sound scene rather than separate clips, which is closer to how an immersive situation is actually heard.
works.idea_zh: 生成的是整个声音场景，而不是零散的片段，更接近人们在沉浸情境中真实听到的样子。
works.method: A unified generative framework that models the speech, effects and ambience of one scene jointly (architecture unpublished).
works.method_zh: 统一的生成框架，联合建模同一场景中的语音、音效与环境声（架构未公开）。
works.title_zh: Seed Audio 1.0 音频创作模型

works.title: ARDY
works.description: Streaming motion generator from NVIDIA and ETH Zürich that produces 3D human motion in real time while accepting new text prompts and kinematic constraints on the fly: root paths, waypoints, full-body keyframes and sparse joint targets.
works.description_zh: 英伟达与苏黎世联邦理工学院的流式动作生成模型，可实时生成三维人体动作，并能随时接收新的文字提示和运动学约束：根轨迹、路径点、全身关键帧和稀疏关节目标。
works.idea_en: Moves text-to-motion from offline clips to a live, steerable body, the property a generated virtual human needs when a participant changes the situation mid-scene.
works.idea_zh: 把文生动作从离线片段推进到实时、可操控的身体——当参与者在场景中途改变情境时，生成的虚拟人正需要这种能力。
works.method: A two-stage autoregressive transformer denoiser over a hybrid representation (explicit root features plus a latent body embedding), with variable history context and long-horizon constraint conditioning, trained on a large motion-capture corpus.
works.method_zh: 基于混合表示（显式根节点特征加潜在身体嵌入）的两阶段自回归 Transformer 去噪器，支持可变长度的历史上下文和长时程约束条件，在大规模动捕语料上训练。

paper.title: ARDY: Autoregressive Diffusion with Hybrid Representation for Interactive Human Motion Generation

works.title: GPT-Live
works.description: A full-duplex voice model that now powers ChatGPT Voice: it listens while it speaks, says 'mhmm' or 'yeah' to show attention and can stay quiet while the user thinks. Harder requests are handed to a frontier model (GPT-5.5 at launch) in the background while the conversation continues. GPT-Live-1 became generally available in the API on 10 September 2026, and GPT-Live-1.1 (15 October 2026) added voices and accents in ChatGPT.
works.description_zh: 一个全双工语音模型，现在驱动 ChatGPT 语音：它边说边听，会用“嗯哼”“对”表示在听，也能在用户思考时保持安静。较难的请求会在后台交给前沿模型（发布时为 GPT-5.5）处理，对话不中断。GPT-Live-1 于 2026 年 9 月 10 日在 API 中正式可用，GPT-Live-1.1（2026 年 10 月 15 日）为 ChatGPT 增加了新声音和口音。
works.idea_en: OpenAI's own break with turn-based voice: the mainstream ChatGPT voice now overlaps and backchannels, so full-duplex timing is no longer a research-only property.
works.idea_zh: OpenAI 自己告别了回合制语音：主流的 ChatGPT 语音如今会重叠发言、会附和，全双工的对话节奏不再只是研究原型的特性。
works.method: Full-duplex architecture that processes input continuously while generating output, with background delegation to a reasoning model; outputs carry SynthID watermarks since 31 July 2026.
works.method_zh: 全双工架构：在生成输出的同时持续处理输入，并把推理任务委托给后台模型；自 2026 年 7 月 31 日起输出带有 SynthID 水印。
works.specs: GPT-Live-1 and GPT-Live-1 mini · ChatGPT · API GA 2026-09-10 (v1/live/sessions)

works.title: LingBot-World 2.0
works.description: The second LingBot world model (also called LingBot-World-Infinity), which Robbyant describes as the first hour-long interactive world model: an unbounded interaction horizon, attacks, archery and spell-casting actions, text-driven events, and an agent harness with a 'pilot' agent that plays and a 'director' agent that adds scene elements.
works.description_zh: 第二代 LingBot 世界模型（又名 LingBot-World-Infinity），灵波科技称其为首个可交互一小时的世界模型：交互时长不设上限，支持攻击、射箭、施法等动作和文字驱动的事件，并配有智能体框架：“驾驶员”智能体负责游玩，“导演”智能体负责添加场景元素。
works.idea_en: Pairs a world model with two LLM agents, one acting and one directing, a pattern that maps directly onto confederate and experimenter roles.
works.idea_zh: 把世界模型与两个大模型智能体搭配：一个负责行动、一个负责导演，这一模式可以直接对应实验中的“同谋者”与“实验者”角色。
works.method: Causal pretraining for unbounded rollouts, a distilled real-time variant, and an agentic harness in which a pilot agent plans character behavior and a director agent synthesizes new environmental elements as the scene progresses.
works.method_zh: 通过因果预训练实现无上限的推演，蒸馏出实时版本，并加入智能体框架：驾驶员智能体规划角色行为，导演智能体随场景推进合成新的环境元素。

paper.title: Infinite Worlds with Versatile Interactions

works.title_zh: LingBot-World 2.0（蚂蚁灵波）

works.title: MIRA
works.description: An open multiplayer world model of Rocket League in which four people play a 2v2 match in a browser, each seeing a consistent generated view at 20 fps, with boost, goals and demolitions tracked by the model alone; an autopilot mode lets the model play for absent players.
works.description_zh: 一个开源的《火箭联盟》多人世界模型：四名玩家在浏览器中进行 2 对 2 比赛，每人看到的生成画面都保持一致，帧率 20 fps；加速槽、进球与撞毁全部由模型自行追踪；“自动驾驶”模式还能让模型替缺席的玩家上场。
works.idea_en: Several people share one generated situation and see each other's actions, with no game engine underneath; the developers report it runs indefinitely without diverging.
works.idea_zh: 多人共享同一个生成情境并看到彼此的动作，背后没有任何游戏引擎；开发者称它可以无限运行而不发散。
works.method: A 5B-parameter diffusion transformer over a 600M-parameter video representation codec, trained on bot gameplay with action dropout, conditioned on all four players' inputs; developed by General Intuition and Kyutai with Epic Games.
works.method_zh: 以 6 亿参数的视频表征编解码器为基础的 50 亿参数扩散 Transformer，在机器人对局录像上以“动作随机丢弃”方式训练，并以四名玩家的输入为条件；由 General Intuition 与 Kyutai 联合 Epic Games 开发。
works.specs: 4 players · 20 fps · 576p split across players · 5B + 600M parameters (developer-reported)
works.title_zh: MIRA：多人交互世界模型

works.title: Vidu S1
works.description: Vidu S1 (2026-07-03) is Shengshu's real-time interactive video model: a generated character or scene responds within milliseconds as you talk to it, for uses such as talking pets or gaming companions.
works.description_zh: Vidu S1（2026-07-03）是生数科技的实时交互视频模型：你对它说话时，生成的角色或场景会在毫秒级作出回应，可用于“会说话的宠物”、游戏陪伴等场景。
works.idea_en: Conversation-paced video generation moves video models into the turn-taking loop of virtual humans.
works.idea_zh: 跟得上对话节奏的视频生成，把视频模型带进了虚拟人的轮流对话循环。
works.method: Real-time video generation conditioned on streaming voice input; architecture not published.
works.method_zh: 以流式语音输入为条件的实时视频生成；架构未公开。

works.title: FacePlex
works.description: FacePlex generates a conversational avatar's speech and facial motion together, token by token, while the user talks, prepares mouth shapes before the matching audio is emitted, and adds non-verbal reactions grounded in the dialogue, rendered with Gaussian splatting.
works.description_zh: FacePlex 在用户说话的同时逐 token 地联合生成对话虚拟人的语音和面部动作，在对应音频发出之前就准备好口型，并加入与对话内容相关的非语言反应，最后用高斯泼溅渲染。
works.idea_en: Shows that a full-duplex face needs to anticipate its own speech, not just follow it.
works.idea_zh: 说明全双工的脸需要预判自己将要说的话，而不只是跟着语音动。
works.method: A unified streaming framework that places speech tokens, facial-motion tokens and Gaussian-splatting rendering on one shared timeline, built on a full-duplex spoken dialogue model.
works.method_zh: 一个统一的流式框架，把语音 token、面部动作 token 和高斯泼溅渲染放在同一条时间线上，基于全双工语音对话模型构建。

paper.title: FacePlex: Toward Natural Full-Duplex Conversational Avatars

works.title_zh: FacePlex：全双工对话虚拟人

works.title: Wan-Streamer
works.description: Wan-Streamer is an end-to-end model that listens, sees, thinks, speaks and responds on video at the same time, inside one Transformer, with no separate speech recognition, LLM, TTS or avatar modules. Version 0.3 (July 2026) adds 'world + event stream' video pretraining for free-form behaviour; the demos show real-time full-duplex video conversation.
works.description_zh: Wan-Streamer 是一个端到端模型，在同一个 Transformer 中同时完成听、看、思考、说话和视频回应，不依赖单独的语音识别、大模型、语音合成或虚拟人模块。0.3 版（2026 年 7 月）加入“世界设定 + 事件流”的视频预训练以支持自由行为；演示展示了实时的全双工视频对话。
works.idea_en: Collapses the whole cascade into one streaming model, so timing, turn-taking and expression are learned jointly rather than stitched together.
works.idea_zh: 把整条级联压缩进一个流式模型，时机、轮流发言和表情都在一起学习，而不是拼接起来。
works.method: Interleaved visual, audio and text input and output tokens in a single Transformer with block-causal attention, causal encoders and decoders for incremental streaming.
works.method_zh: 在单个 Transformer 中交错排列视觉、音频与文本的输入和输出 token，配合块因果注意力以及因果编码器与解码器，实现增量式流式生成。

paper.title: Wan-Streamer v0.1: End-to-end Real-time Interactive Foundation Models

works.title_zh: Wan-Streamer：面向实时交互的端到端基础模型

works.title: Editing Reality
works.description: A mixed-reality system for co-creating with generative AI inside a physical room: by speaking, sketching and grabbing, a person generates, modifies, erases and retextures virtual and reconstructed objects anchored where they stand.
works.description_zh: 一个在真实房间里与生成式 AI 共同创作的混合现实系统：通过说话、画草图和直接抓取，人可以就地生成、修改、擦除和重新贴图锚定在身边的虚拟物体与重建物体。
works.idea_en: Treats generation as a material you shape in place, round after round, rather than a one-shot command typed on a screen.
works.idea_zh: 把生成当作可以在现场一轮轮塑造的材料，而不是在屏幕上敲下的一次性指令。
works.method: Research through design: iterative system development combining speech, sketch and direct manipulation with generative 3D and texture models, a formative workshop and an expert review, distilled into design framings for in-situ co-creation.
works.method_zh: 设计研究（Research through Design）：结合语音、草图、直接操作与生成式三维和纹理模型迭代开发系统，并通过形成性工作坊与专家评审，提炼现场共创的设计框架。

paper.title: Editing Reality: Designing In-Situ Co-Creation with Generative AI in Mixed Reality

works.title_zh: 编辑现实：混合现实中与生成式 AI 的现场共创

works.title: Oasis 3
works.description: Decart's interactive world model for physical AI, starting with autonomous driving: it generates diverse, photorealistic driving environments from a single prompt that respond to the vehicle's actions in real time, and was available by API from launch.
works.description_zh: Decart 面向物理 AI 的交互式世界模型，先从自动驾驶入手：根据一句提示生成多样、逼真的驾驶环境，并实时响应车辆的动作；发布当天即可通过 API 使用。
works.idea_en: Rare long-tail events become something you can request by prompt and drive through, rather than wait for on real roads.
works.idea_zh: 罕见的长尾事件变成可以通过提示调用、直接驶入的场景，而不必在真实道路上苦等。
works.method: A real-time generative world model served on Decart's optimized inference stack (DOS), conditioned on prompts and vehicle controls for closed-loop robot training.
works.method_zh: 运行在 Decart 优化推理栈（DOS）上的实时生成式世界模型，以提示与车辆控制为条件，用于闭环机器人训练。

works.title: Cosmos 3
works.description: An open 'omni-model' announced at GTC Taipei that reasons about a scene, generates video and ambient sound, and outputs robot action data such as joint angles and gripper positions, so one model can describe, simulate and act.
works.description_zh: 在 GTC 台北发布的开源“全能模型”：先理解场景，再生成视频与环境声，还能输出关节角度、夹爪位置等机器人动作数据，让一个模型同时负责描述、模拟与行动。
works.idea_en: Reasoning about a situation before simulating it is the step that makes generated outcomes checkable against an explanation.
works.idea_zh: 先推理情境、再进行模拟，这一步让生成的结果可以对照解释加以核查。
works.method: A mixture-of-transformers model in which a reasoning block interprets the scene and a generation block produces physically grounded video, audio and numerical action outputs; it can be post-trained as a world-action model.
works.method_zh: 混合 Transformer 架构：推理模块先解读场景，生成模块再输出符合物理的视频、音频与数值动作；可后训练为世界-动作模型。

works.title: Meshy 3D Agent
works.description: A conversational agent inside Meshy: a person describes an idea or uploads a photo or sketch, and the agent brainstorms directions, generates concept images in batches, turns the chosen one into a downloadable 3D model, and can rig and animate characters through chat.
works.description_zh: Meshy 内置的对话式智能体：用户描述想法或上传照片、草图，智能体会提出方向、批量生成概念图，把选中的方案变成可下载的三维模型，还能通过对话为角色绑定和制作动画。
works.idea_en: Moves asset generation from a single prompt box to a dialogue that plans and iterates, the pattern a researcher could use to author scenario props by talking.
works.idea_zh: 把资产生成从单个提示框变成能规划、能迭代的对话，研究者也可以用这种方式“说”出情境所需的道具。
works.method: An LLM-driven agent that orchestrates Meshy's image generation, image-to-3D, texturing, rigging and animation tools in one chat; Meshy also exposes these tools to outside agents through an MCP server.
works.method_zh: 由大语言模型驱动的智能体，在一次对话中调度 Meshy 的图像生成、图生三维、贴图、绑定和动画工具；Meshy 还通过 MCP 服务器把这些工具开放给外部智能体。
works.title_zh: Meshy 3D 智能体

works.title: VideoFDB
works.description: VideoFDB is the first benchmark for full-duplex audio-visual-to-audio-visual conversational agents: 237 expert-annotated dyadic clips from real video calls covering 11 nonverbal dynamics, scored separately for perception (does the agent read the moment) and generation (does it respond with fitting speech, gaze and expression), with a public leaderboard.
works.description_zh: VideoFDB 是第一个评测全双工“视听到视听”对话智能体的基准：包含来自真实视频通话、由专家标注的 237 段双人片段，覆盖 11 种非语言互动动态；分别对感知（智能体能否读懂当下）和生成（能否以恰当的语音、视线和表情回应）打分，并设有公开排行榜。
works.idea_en: Gives full-duplex virtual humans a shared yardstick with a human reference score, so vendor claims can be compared.
works.idea_zh: 为全双工虚拟人提供带有人类参照分数的共同标尺，让各家厂商的说法可以相互比较。
works.method: Clips from natural video calls annotated with a taxonomy that separates perception from generation behaviours, scored by a rubric-based LM-as-judge on fluency, affect matching, nonverbal fit and timing.
works.method_zh: 从自然视频通话中截取片段，按区分感知与生成行为的分类体系标注，再由基于评分细则的语言模型评审，从流畅度、情绪匹配、非语言契合度和时机等维度打分。

paper.title: VideoFDB: Evaluating Full-Duplex Vision-Speech Capabilities in Conversational Agents

works.title_zh: VideoFDB 全双工视听对话基准

works.title: Gemini Omni
works.description: Google's successor to the Veo line, announced at I/O on 2026-05-19. Its first model, Gemini Omni Flash, takes any mix of text, images, audio and video and generates or conversationally edits video with sound in the Gemini app, Flow, YouTube Shorts and Google Vids; in the Gemini API it entered preview on 2026-06-30 and became generally available as gemini-omni-1.1-flash on 2026-08-27.
works.description_zh: Google 在 2026-05-19 I/O 上发布的 Veo 系列后继。首个模型 Gemini Omni Flash 可接受文本、图像、音频与视频的任意组合，生成带声音的视频或通过对话修改视频，已上线 Gemini 应用、Flow、YouTube Shorts 与 Google Vids；在 Gemini API 中于 2026-06-30 进入预览，2026-08-27 以 gemini-omni-1.1-flash 正式发布（GA）。
works.idea_en: Generation and editing merge into one conversation, so a scenario can be revised shot by shot ('make the bystander turn around') instead of re-rolled.
works.idea_zh: 生成与编辑合并为一场对话：情境可以逐镜修改（“让旁观者转过身”），而不必整段重新抽卡。
works.method: Natively multimodal Gemini-family generator that accepts up to three seconds of reference video plus images and audio; DeepMind reports leading human-rater preference for editing and for text-, image- and reference-to-video.
works.method_zh: 原生多模态的 Gemini 系列生成模型，可接收最长约 3 秒的参考视频以及图像和音频；DeepMind 称其在编辑以及文生、图生、参考生成视频的人工评测中领先。
works.specs: 360p / 720p · 1080p and 4K via upscaling · up to 3 s video reference · API GA 2026-08-27

works.title: Project Genie: Street View grounding
works.description: An I/O 2026 update that lets Project Genie start a world from a real place: users drop a Maps pin in the U.S., pick a style such as 'Ocean World' or 'B&W film', describe a character, and Genie builds the world from Street View imagery; access widened the same day to Google AI Ultra subscribers worldwide.
works.description_zh: 2026 年 I/O 大会上的更新，让 Project Genie 可以从真实地点出发：用户在地图上为美国某处放置图钉，选择“海洋世界”或“黑白电影”等风格并描述角色，Genie 便基于街景图像生成世界；同日向全球 Google AI Ultra 订阅用户开放。
works.idea_en: Grounds a generated world in a specific real street, which makes place-based scenarios possible, though only as a stylised starting point that drifts as you move.
works.idea_zh: 让生成的世界锚定在一条真实的街道上，使基于具体地点的情境成为可能；但它只是带风格化的起点，随着移动会逐渐偏离。
works.method: Street View imagery retrieved through Google's Maps Imagery Grounding conditions the opening frames, after which Genie 3 continues the world in real time from user actions.
works.method_zh: 通过谷歌的 Maps Imagery Grounding 调取街景图像作为开场画面的条件，之后由 Genie 3 根据用户动作实时延续世界。
works.specs: U.S. places at launch · global Google AI Ultra rollout (developer-reported)
works.title_zh: Project Genie：街景锚定

works.title: Rodin Gen-2.5
works.description: Rodin Gen-2.5 generates meshes of up to 10 million polygons and lets users set an adaptive 'thinking effort' that trades seconds for detail, from roughly 4-second drafts to slower hero assets, with 3D-native textures, batches of up to 10 results and manual part splitting.
works.description_zh: Rodin Gen-2.5 可生成最多 1000 万面的网格，并允许用户调节自适应的“思考强度”，用时间换细节：从约 4 秒的草稿到耗时更长的主角级资产；同时提供原生三维贴图、单次最多 10 个结果以及手动部件拆分。
works.idea_en: Adds an LLM-style speed–quality dial to 3D generation, useful when a scenario needs many cheap background props and a few detailed focal objects.
works.idea_zh: 给三维生成加入类似大语言模型的速度—质量调节，适合需要大量廉价背景道具和少数精细焦点物体的情境。
works.method: Proprietary; Deemos describes adaptive inference-time compute ('thinking effort') for geometry and texture and 3D-native texture generation, building on Gen-2's part-based pipeline.
works.method_zh: 专有模型；影眸科技称其对几何和贴图采用自适应的推理时计算（“思考强度”）和原生三维贴图生成，并沿用 Gen-2 的部件式流程。
works.specs: up to 10M polygons · 1M-poly mesh in ~4 s (developer claims)

works.title: VGGT-Ω
works.description: VGGT-Ω is the 2026 successor to VGGT: a larger feed-forward reconstructor for both static and dynamic scenes, with a text-aligned variant and a public Hugging Face demo.
works.description_zh: VGGT-Ω 是 VGGT 在 2026 年的后续版本：一个更大的前馈式重建模型，同时处理静态与动态场景，另有文本对齐版本和公开的 Hugging Face 演示。
works.idea_en: The authors report that reconstruction quality scales predictably with model and data size, which suggests feed-forward 3D will keep improving the way language models did.
works.idea_zh: 作者报告重建质量随模型与数据规模可预测地提升，这意味着前馈式三维会像语言模型那样持续进步。
works.method: A simplified VGGT with a single multi-task dense head, registers and no high-resolution convolutions, trained at larger scale with a dynamic-scene annotation pipeline and self-supervision.
works.method_zh: 简化后的 VGGT：单一多任务稠密预测头、加入寄存器标记、去掉高分辨率卷积层，并借助支持动态场景的标注流程与自监督在更大规模上训练。
works.specs: ~1B parameters · 256–512 px checkpoints · gated weights on Hugging Face

paper.title: VGGT-Ω

works.title: CARA-4
works.description: CARA-4 is Anam's real-time avatar diffusion model: from a single photo it renders a conversational face at 25 fps in landscape (1152×768) or portrait (768×1152), with Director Notes that let a builder set how the avatar performs (warm, distressed, angry) and let the LLM shift that direction mid-reply.
works.description_zh: CARA-4 是 Anam 的实时虚拟人扩散模型：只需一张照片即可以 25 fps 渲染横屏（1152×768）或竖屏（768×1152）的对话人脸；Director Notes 让开发者设定虚拟人的表演方式（温和、痛苦、愤怒等），并允许大模型在一次回复中途改变表演方向。
works.idea_en: Directable performance (a distressed patient versus a calm coach) turns the avatar's affect into an experimental condition you can write down.
works.idea_zh: 可导演的表演（痛苦的病人与沉着的教练）让虚拟人的情绪成为可以写下来的实验条件。
works.method: A diffusion model generating every pixel in real time, conditioned on speech audio and text performance cues, inside a conversation engine with sub-second median latency from end of user speech.
works.method_zh: 一个实时生成每个像素的扩散模型，以语音和文本表演提示为条件，运行在对话引擎中；从用户说完到虚拟人回应的中位延迟低于 1 秒。

works.title: GPT-Realtime-2
works.description: OpenAI's first voice model with GPT-5-class reasoning, launched with GPT-Realtime-Translate (live translation from 70+ input into 13 output languages) and GPT-Realtime-Whisper (streaming transcription). It can say short preambles such as 'let me check that', call several tools in parallel and keep the conversation going while it works. GPT-Realtime-2.1 and 2.1 mini (6 July 2026) improved alphanumeric recognition, noise handling and interruption behaviour.
works.description_zh: OpenAI 第一个具备 GPT-5 级推理能力的语音模型，同时发布 GPT-Realtime-Translate（70 多种输入语言到 13 种输出语言的实时翻译）和 GPT-Realtime-Whisper（流式转写）。它会先说一句“我查一下”之类的过渡语，可以并行调用多个工具，并在处理任务时继续对话。GPT-Realtime-2.1 及 2.1 mini（2026 年 7 月 6 日）改进了字母数字识别、噪声处理和被打断时的表现。
works.idea_en: Voice agents that reason and act mid-conversation make multi-step role-play scenarios (a dispatcher, a clerk, a negotiator) feasible over a phone line.
works.idea_zh: 能在对话中推理并采取行动的语音智能体，让多步骤角色扮演情境（调度员、办事员、谈判对手）可以在电话中实现。
works.method: Speech-to-speech model with adjustable reasoning effort, preambles and parallel tool calls in the Realtime API; conversation is still segmented into turns.
works.method_zh: 在 Realtime API 中提供的语音到语音模型，可调节推理强度，支持过渡语与并行工具调用；对话仍按轮次切分。

works.title: TripoSplat
works.description: VAST's open model that turns a single image into 3D Gaussians rather than a mesh, with the Gaussian density learned so that primitives concentrate where geometry is complex; released with code, weights and a ComfyUI workflow.
works.description_zh: VAST 的开源模型，把单张图像生成为三维高斯而非网格，并学习高斯的分布密度，让基元集中在几何复杂的区域；同时发布了代码、权重和 ComfyUI 工作流。
works.idea_en: Generated assets in splat form can sit natively inside Gaussian-splat captures of real places, narrowing the gap between captured environments and generated props.
works.idea_zh: 以高斯泼溅形式生成的资产，可以直接放进真实场所的高斯泼溅扫描中，缩小了实拍环境与生成道具之间的差距。
works.method: Density-Sampled Gaussians (DeG): Gaussian centres are sampled from a learnable density over an octree and trained with a differentiable render-contribution gradient, and a latent diffusion model is trained on the DeG representation.
works.method_zh: 密度采样高斯（DeG）：高斯中心从八叉树上的可学习概率密度中采样，用可微的渲染贡献梯度训练，再在 DeG 表示上训练潜扩散模型。

paper.title: Generative 3D Gaussians with Learned Density Control

works.title: Prop-Chromeleon
works.description: Hold a water bottle, type 'a magic lantern', and a virtual lantern shaped to fit the bottle is generated and anchored onto it in mixed reality, so what you see matches what you feel.
works.description_zh: 手握一个水瓶，输入“魔法灯笼”，系统就生成一个贴合水瓶形状的虚拟灯笼并锚定在它上面，让你看到的与摸到的一致。
works.idea_en: Constraining generation to the shape of a real object turns any household item into a passive haptic prop for generated content.
works.idea_zh: 把生成约束在真实物体的形状之内，任何家居物品都能成为生成内容的被动触觉道具。
works.method: A generative pipeline produces 3D assets from text prompts under geometric constraints from the scanned prop and anchors them to it; a generation study scores shape similarity and prompt fidelity, and a user study compares realism and enjoyment with static props.
works.method_zh: 生成流程在扫描道具的几何约束下，根据文字提示生成三维资产并锚定在道具上；生成实验评估形状相似度与提示忠实度，用户研究则与静态道具比较真实感和乐趣。

paper.title: Prop-Chromeleon: Adaptive Haptic Props in Mixed Reality through Generative Artificial Intelligence

works.title: Echo-2
works.description: SpAItial's second world model generates real-time navigable 3D scenes from text or images that run in a browser on any device; in June 2026 the company added a Claude plugin and hosted MCP server for generating and editing worlds from a chat.
works.description_zh: SpAItial 的第二代世界模型，根据文字或图像生成可实时漫游、在任何设备浏览器中运行的三维场景；2026 年 6 月又推出 Claude 插件和托管 MCP 服务器，可在对话中生成与编辑世界。
works.idea_en: World generation is becoming a tool call: an agent can now request, edit and hand over a 3D place in the middle of a conversation.
works.idea_zh: 世界生成正在变成一次“工具调用”：智能体可以在对话中途请求、编辑并交付一个三维场所。
works.method: Generates one spatially persistent 3D scene per prompt instead of a frame sequence; SpAItial claims it outperforms Marble 1.1 on the WorldScore benchmark (company claim, not independently verified).
works.method_zh: 每个提示词生成一个空间上持久的三维场景，而不是一串画面；SpAItial 称其在 WorldScore 基准上优于 Marble 1.1（公司自述，未经独立验证）。

works.title: Seed3D 2.0
works.description: Second Seed3D generation focused on geometric precision and material quality; it adds part-level segmentation and completion, articulated assets exported with joint information in URDF for simulators such as Isaac Sim, and scene composition from images, videos or text. It is offered through ByteDance's Volcano Engine Ark platform.
works.description_zh: 第二代 Seed3D，重点提升几何精度与材质质量；新增部件级分割与补全、以 URDF 格式导出带关节信息的可动资产（可用于 Isaac Sim 等仿真器），以及由图像、视频或文字进行场景组合。通过字节跳动火山引擎方舟平台提供。
works.idea_en: Articulated output, such as drawers that open and doors that swing, turns a generated prop into something a person or a robot can manipulate.
works.idea_zh: 可动结构的输出（能拉开的抽屉、能转动的门）让生成的道具变成人或机器人可以操作的东西。
works.method: Coarse-to-fine two-stage geometry generation and a unified Mixture-of-Experts PBR material model with vision-language priors for material decomposition under unknown lighting (ByteDance Seed blog).
works.method_zh: 由粗到细的两阶段几何生成，加上统一的混合专家（MoE）PBR 材质模型，并引入视觉语言先验以在未知光照下分解材质（据字节跳动 Seed 博客）。

works.title: HY-World 2.0
works.description: Tencent's second-generation open world model: text or a single image is expanded into a navigable 3D Gaussian-splat or mesh world, and multi-view photos or video are reconstructed into 3D, with outputs that import into Blender, Unity, Unreal Engine and Isaac Sim. Weights were released in April–May 2026; an HY World 2.1 update, usable in Tencent's web product, followed in July 2026.
works.description_zh: 腾讯第二代开源世界模型：把文字或单张图像扩展为可漫游的三维高斯泼溅或网格世界，也能把多视角照片或视频重建为三维，输出可直接导入 Blender、Unity、虚幻引擎和 Isaac Sim。权重于 2026 年 4–5 月陆续开源，7 月发布 HY World 2.1 更新，可在腾讯的网页产品中使用。
works.idea_en: Tencent frames it explicitly against video world models: build the world once as assets and render it for free, instead of paying per frame for a world that disappears.
works.idea_zh: 腾讯明确把它与视频世界模型对照：把世界一次性建成资产、此后渲染几乎零成本，而不是为一个会消失的世界逐帧付费。
works.method: Four stages: HY-Pano 2.0 (about 80B parameters) generates a panorama, WorldNav plans camera trajectories, WorldStereo 2.0 (about 17B) expands the world with keyframe views and geometric memory, and WorldMirror 2.0, a feed-forward model predicting depth, normals, cameras, points and 3DGS, composes the final world.
works.method_zh: 共四个阶段：HY-Pano 2.0（约 800 亿参数）生成全景图，WorldNav 规划镜头轨迹，WorldStereo 2.0（约 170 亿参数）借助关键帧视图与几何记忆扩展世界，最后由能前馈预测深度、法线、相机、点云和 3DGS 的 WorldMirror 2.0 合成完整世界。

paper.title: HY-World 2.0: A Multi-Modal World Model for Reconstructing, Generating, and Simulating 3D Worlds

works.title_zh: 混元世界模型 2.0（HY-World 2.0）

works.title: LingBot-Map
works.description: LingBot-Map is an open streaming 3D reconstruction model from Ant Group's Robbyant that turns a live video stream into camera poses and a point cloud at about 20 frames per second.
works.description_zh: LingBot-Map 是蚂蚁集团灵波科技（Robbyant）发布的开源流式三维重建模型，可将实时视频流以约每秒 20 帧的速度转换为相机位姿与点云。
works.idea_en: Feed-forward reconstruction that keeps up with a walking camera is what live mapping of a person's surroundings needs.
works.idea_zh: 能跟上行走相机速度的前馈式重建，正是实时映射人周围环境所需要的。
works.method: A geometric context transformer combines an anchor context, a pose-reference window and a trajectory memory in its attention to limit drift while keeping the streaming state compact.
works.method_zh: 几何上下文 Transformer 在注意力中结合锚点上下文、位姿参考窗口与轨迹记忆，在保持流式状态紧凑的同时抑制漂移。

paper.title: LingBot-Map: Geometric Context Transformer for Streaming 3D Reconstruction

works.title_zh: LingBot-Map 流式三维重建

works.title: Lyra 2.0
works.description: NVIDIA's open successor to Lyra for large environments: it generates long camera-controlled walkthroughs that can turn back and revisit places, and lifts them into a persistent 3D world exportable as splats or meshes, for example as robot training scenes in Isaac Sim. GUI and training code were released in July 2026.
works.description_zh: NVIDIA 面向大场景的开源 Lyra 后继版本：生成可以回头、重访已到过地点的长距离镜头漫游视频，并把它提升为可导出为泼溅或网格的持久三维世界，例如用作 Isaac Sim 中的机器人训练场景。2026 年 7 月发布了图形界面与训练代码。
works.idea_en: It targets the two failures that limit long generated walks, forgetting places that fall out of context and drifting appearance, which are also what break a participant's sense of a stable place.
works.idea_zh: 它针对长距离生成漫游的两大问题——走出上下文后忘掉去过的地方、外观逐渐漂移——而这两点恰恰也是破坏参与者“稳定场所感”的原因。
works.method: Per-frame 3D geometry is kept only to retrieve relevant past frames and build dense correspondences with the target view (against spatial forgetting), the video model is trained on self-augmented histories of its own degraded outputs (against drift), and the long trajectories fine-tune feed-forward reconstruction into 3D Gaussians and meshes.
works.method_zh: 保留逐帧三维几何，只用于检索相关的历史帧并与目标视角建立稠密对应（应对空间遗忘）；用模型自身退化输出构成的“自增强历史”训练视频模型（应对漂移）；再用得到的长轨迹微调前馈式重建，输出三维高斯与网格。
works.specs: long-horizon walkthroughs with revisits · 3DGS and mesh export

paper.title: Lyra 2.0: Explorable Generative 3D Worlds

works.title: CoEmpaTeam: Enhancing Cognitive Empathy using LLM-based Avatars and Dynamic Role Play in Virtual Reality
works.description: VR system for training cognitive empathy in which users work with three LLM-driven avatars of clearly different personalities and switch roles to see situations through another person's eyes; the personalities were validated in an online experiment (n=90) and the system was tested in a lab study (n=32).
works.description_zh: 用于训练认知共情的 VR 系统：用户与三个性格迥异、由大语言模型驱动的化身协作，并通过角色互换从他人视角体验情境；化身性格在线上实验（n=90）中得到验证，系统在实验室研究（n=32）中接受了评估。
works.idea_en: Personality becomes a controllable, pre-validated parameter of LLM characters, a step toward treating generated people as calibrated stimuli.
works.idea_zh: 性格成为大语言模型角色可控且经预先验证的参数——朝着把生成的人物视为“经过校准的刺激”迈出了一步。
