works.method: LLM-driven avatars with prompted personalities, technical and online validation of perceived personality, then a lab experiment on cognitive-empathy outcomes.
works.method_zh: 以提示词设定性格的大语言模型化身，先进行技术评估与线上性格感知验证，再开展关于认知共情结果的实验室实验。

paper.title: CoEmpaTeam: Enhancing Cognitive Empathy using LLM-based Avatars and Dynamic Role Play in Virtual Reality

works.title_zh: CoEmpaTeam：在虚拟现实中用大语言模型化身与动态角色扮演提升认知共情

works.title: LPM 1.0 (Large Performance Model)
works.description: LPM 1.0 is a video model for conversational character performance: given a character image, it generates listening video from the user's audio and speaking video from synthesized speech, with text prompts for motion, in real time and at unbounded length while keeping identity stable. The authors propose LPM-Bench for interactive character performance.
works.description_zh: LPM 1.0 是一个用于对话角色表演的视频模型：给定一张角色图像，它会根据用户的音频生成倾听画面，根据合成语音生成说话画面，并可用文本提示控制动作；它实时运行、时长不受限，同时保持身份稳定。作者还提出了交互式角色表演基准 LPM-Bench。
works.idea_en: Frames expressiveness, real-time speed and long-horizon identity as one 'performance trilemma' that game NPCs and live characters must solve together.
works.idea_zh: 把表现力、实时速度和长时身份一致性视为同一个“表演三难”，游戏 NPC 和直播角色必须同时解决。
works.method: A 17B Diffusion Transformer trained on speaking-listening paired human video with identity-aware references, distilled into a causal streaming generator (Online LPM).
works.method_zh: 在说话-倾听配对的人物视频和身份参考上训练 17B 扩散 Transformer，再蒸馏为因果流式生成器（Online LPM）。

paper.title: LPM 1.0: Video-based Character Performance Model

works.title_zh: LPM 1.0 大型表演模型

works.title: Waypoint-1.5
works.description: An open-weight real-time world model that runs locally on gaming PCs or by streaming, turning a prompt or image into an explorable first-person world; it follows Waypoint-1 (January 2026), and a Waypoint 2 beta was inviting builders in October 2026.
works.description_zh: 一个开源权重的实时世界模型，可在游戏电脑上本地运行或通过串流使用，把一段提示或一张图像变成可探索的第一人称世界；它是 Waypoint-1（2026 年 1 月）的后继，2026 年 10 月 Waypoint 2 正在分批邀请开发者内测。
works.idea_en: World models on consumer hardware: a lab can run sessions offline, log them and avoid cloud latency.
works.idea_zh: 让世界模型跑在消费级硬件上：实验室可以离线运行、记录会话，并避开云端延迟。
works.method: A real-time diffusion world model with a prompting pipeline that rewrites user input into seed images, synthetic video and aligned controls, released in 720p and 360p tiers for local and streamed play.
works.method_zh: 实时扩散世界模型，配有把用户输入改写为种子图像、合成视频与对齐操控信号的提示流程；分为 720p 与 360p 两档，可本地运行或串流。
works.specs: up to 720p · 60 fps · 1B parameters · consumer GPUs (developer-reported)

works.title: Android XR auto-spatialization
works.description: An experimental Android XR feature on the Samsung Galaxy XR headset that turns almost any app, game, website, image or video, including YouTube videos and 2D games, into a 3D experience at the push of a button.
works.description_zh: Android XR 在三星 Galaxy XR 头显上推出的实验功能：一键把几乎任何应用、游戏、网站、图像或视频（包括 YouTube 视频和二维游戏）变成三维体验。
works.idea_en: System-level 2D-to-3D conversion means every flat source becomes stereoscopic content in a headset, generated rather than captured.
works.idea_zh: 系统级的二维转三维意味着，任何平面内容在头显里都能成为立体内容，靠的是生成而不是拍摄。
works.method: Likely per-frame monocular depth estimation with stereo view synthesis at the system compositor; enabled from the Labs tab in Settings.
works.method_zh: 很可能是在系统合成器层面对每帧做单目深度估计并合成立体视图；在“设置”的 Labs 页面中开启。
works.title_zh: Android XR 自动空间化

works.title: Large-scale Codec Avatars (LCA)
works.description: LCA produces a full-body, high-fidelity 3D avatar of almost anyone in a single forward pass, with fine facial expressions and finger-level control, generalizing across hairstyles, clothing and demographics.
works.description_zh: LCA 只需一次前向推理就能为几乎任何人生成高保真的全身三维化身，具备细致的面部表情和手指级控制，并能泛化到不同发型、服装和人群。
works.idea_en: Applies the foundation-model recipe (pretrain on a million in-the-wild videos, post-train on studio data) to 3D avatars, so diversity of people stops being a capture bottleneck.
works.idea_zh: 把基础模型的做法（在一百万段真实视频上预训练，再用影棚数据后训练）用于三维化身，让人群多样性不再受限于采集。
works.method: Pre-training a feed-forward Gaussian avatar model on 1M in-the-wild videos for appearance and geometry priors, then post-training on curated multi-view data for expressivity and fidelity.
works.method_zh: 先在一百万段真实场景视频上预训练前馈高斯化身模型以获得外观与几何先验，再在精选多视角数据上后训练以提升表现力和保真度。

paper.title: Large-scale Codec Avatars: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Large-scale Avatar Pretraining

works.title_zh: 大规模 Codec Avatars（LCA）

works.title: Where extended reality and AI may take us: Ethical issues of impersonation and AI fakes in social virtual reality
works.description: At IEEE VR 2025 a panel was held in social VR with each panellist in a look-alike avatar; midway two panellists swapped avatars and impersonated each other, and an LLM-controlled Alan Turing avatar took part. About 40 of the 100 audience members who answered a survey did not notice the swap.
works.description_zh: IEEE VR 2025 大会上，一场小组讨论在社交 VR 中进行，每位嘉宾都使用与本人相貌相似的化身；中途两位嘉宾互换化身并假扮对方，另有一个由大语言模型控制的艾伦·图灵化身参与讨论。在填写问卷的 100 名观众中，约 40 人没有察觉这次互换。
works.idea_en: Look-alike avatars plus LLM agents make identity itself manipulable, so studies with generated people need disclosure and consent rules of their own.
works.idea_zh: 相貌相似的化身加上大语言模型智能体，让“身份”本身变得可以操纵——使用生成人物的研究需要专属的告知与同意规则。
works.method: Field study during a live conference panel projected to the audience, with a post-panel survey on detecting the swap and perceiving the AI panellist.
works.method_zh: 在现场会议小组讨论中开展的实地研究，画面投影给观众，会后以问卷调查观众是否察觉互换以及如何看待 AI 嘉宾。

paper.title: Where extended reality and AI may take us: Ethical issues of impersonation and AI fakes in social virtual reality

works.title_zh: 扩展现实与 AI 可能把我们带向何方：社交虚拟现实中冒充与 AI 伪造的伦理问题

works.title: Body Oracle Translator
works.description: Looking through a handheld mixed-reality lens, people see each other's postures and movements translated in real time into speculative AI-generated characters inspired by Chinese oracle-bone script.
works.description_zh: 透过手持混合现实镜头，人们看到彼此的姿态和动作被实时“翻译”成受甲骨文启发的、由 AI 生成的思辨文字。
works.idea_en: Restyles people rather than rooms: the lens rewrites bodies as an alternative written language, an 'alternative present' to share.
works.idea_zh: 重绘的对象是人而不是房间：镜头把身体改写成另一种文字，营造一个可以共享的“另类当下”。
works.method: Pose tracking feeds an image-generation model trained to map body skeletons to oracle-bone-style glyphs (building on Body Oracle), and the glyphs are overlaid on people in the handheld MR view.
works.method_zh: 姿态追踪数据输入一个把身体骨架映射为甲骨文风格字形的图像生成模型（基于 Body Oracle），字形叠加在手持 MR 画面中的人物身上。
works.title_zh: 身体甲骨文翻译器

works.title: Matrix-Game 3.0
works.description: An open-weight, memory-augmented interactive world model that streams 720p video in real time and keeps scenes consistent over long sessions by retrieving relevant past frames by camera position; Skywork followed it with Matrix-Game 3.5 (patch memory) in August 2026.
works.description_zh: 一个开源权重、带记忆增强的交互世界模型：实时流式输出 720p 视频，并按相机位置调取相关历史帧，使长时会话中的场景保持一致；昆仑万维于 2026 年 8 月推出后续版本 Matrix-Game 3.5（块记忆）。
works.idea_en: Shows memory and real-time speed together in an open model, at a hardware cost (8 GPUs) that still limits lab use.
works.idea_zh: 在开源模型中同时实现记忆与实时速度，但硬件成本（8 张 GPU）仍限制了实验室的使用。
works.method: A 5B autoregressive diffusion model building on Matrix-Game 2.0 with GPU-based camera-aware memory retrieval, few-step sampling, INT8 quantization, distillation and a lightweight VAE.
works.method_zh: 在 Matrix-Game 2.0 基础上构建的 50 亿参数自回归扩散模型，采用基于 GPU 的相机感知记忆检索、少步采样、INT8 量化、蒸馏和轻量 VAE。

paper.title: Matrix-Game 3.0: Real-Time and Streaming Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory

works.title_zh: Matrix-Game 3.0（昆仑万维）

works.title: Artificial intelligence (AI) for virtual reality exposure therapy (VRET): A systematic review
works.description: PRISMA systematic review of 23 peer-reviewed articles, published up to November 2025, on using artificial intelligence to tailor VR exposure therapy to the needs of patients and therapists.
works.description_zh: 按 PRISMA 流程纳入截至 2025 年 11 月发表的 23 篇同行评审文章，系统梳理如何用人工智能让 VR 暴露疗法更贴合患者与治疗师的需要。
works.idea_en: Adaptive exposure, adjusting the feared situation to the patient in the moment, is the clinical use case closest to real-time generation, and its evidence base is still small.
works.idea_zh: 自适应暴露——根据患者当下状态调整所恐惧的情境——是最接近实时生成的临床用例，而其证据基础仍然有限。
works.method: Systematic review following PRISMA across PsycINFO, Web of Science, Google Scholar, EMBASE, CINAHL and MEDLINE; 23 of 377 screened records included.
works.method_zh: 遵循 PRISMA 的系统综述，检索 PsycINFO、Web of Science、Google Scholar、EMBASE、CINAHL 与 MEDLINE，从 377 条记录中纳入 23 篇。

paper.title: Artificial intelligence (AI) for virtual reality exposure therapy (VRET): A systematic review

works.title_zh: 人工智能用于虚拟现实暴露疗法（VRET）：一项系统综述

works.title: Suno v5.5
works.description: The 2026 version of Suno's song generator, which adds Voices (singing in your own recorded voice), custom models tuned to a creator's catalogue and a taste profile. It follows Suno v5 (September 2025).
works.description_zh: Suno 歌曲生成器的 2026 年版本，新增 Voices（用你自己录制的声音演唱）、按创作者作品定制的模型，以及个人口味画像。它是 Suno v5（2025 年 9 月）的后续版本。
works.idea_en: Personal voice and style models move music generation from generic tracks toward a person's own sonic identity.
works.idea_zh: 个人声音与风格模型，让音乐生成从千篇一律的曲目走向个人自己的声音身份。
works.method: Proprietary song-generation model (likely a Transformer over audio tokens) with voice cloning and per-user model customisation.
works.method_zh: 专有的歌曲生成模型（可能是基于音频标记的 Transformer），具备声音克隆与按用户定制模型的功能。

works.title: Vibe Coding XR
works.description: A prompt such as 'create a dandelion that reacts to my hand' becomes a working, physics-aware mixed-reality app that can be tested in a simulated room on the desktop and then sent to a headset.
works.description_zh: 像“做一朵会对我的手作出反应的蒲公英”这样的提示词，会直接变成一个具备物理效果的混合现实应用，先在桌面的模拟房间里测试，再部署到头显。
works.idea_en: Gives language models a compact vocabulary for users, rooms and agents, so a one-line request can produce a runnable XR prototype.
works.idea_zh: 为语言模型提供描述用户、房间与智能体的精简词汇，让一句话就能产出可运行的 XR 原型。
works.method: Gemini generates code against XR Blocks' semantic 'Reality Model' WebXR API; a desktop simulated-reality loop precedes headset deployment, and the VCXR60 set of 60 prompts with automated evaluation measures one-shot success.
works.method_zh: Gemini 基于 XR Blocks 的语义化“现实模型” WebXR API 生成代码；先在桌面模拟现实中循环测试，再部署到头显，并用 60 条提示组成的 VCXR60 与自动评估流程测量一次成功率。

paper.title: Vibe Coding XR: Accelerating AI + XR Prototyping with XR Blocks and Gemini

works.title: V4 Expressive Visual Agents
works.description: D-ID's V4 Expressive Visual Agents are real-time conversational avatars whose expressions follow the emotional tone of what they say, built from a short recording of a person and deployable on websites or via API, with a self-hosting option for enterprises.
works.description_zh: D-ID 的 V4 Expressive 可视化智能体是实时对话虚拟人，表情会跟随所说内容的情绪基调；只需一段真人短视频即可生成，可部署到网站或通过 API 调用，企业还可自行托管。
works.idea_en: Emotion-matched expression became a standard feature of commercial agents, but it follows the agent's own text, not the user's behaviour.
works.idea_zh: 与情绪匹配的表情已成为商用智能体的标配，但它跟随的是智能体自己的文本，而不是用户的行为。
works.method: A cascaded agent (knowledge base, LLM, TTS) drives D-ID's V4 avatar video model, which conditions facial expression on the sentiment of the generated speech.
works.method_zh: 级联智能体（知识库、大模型、语音合成）驱动 D-ID 的 V4 虚拟人视频模型，该模型以生成语音的情绪为条件控制面部表情。
works.title_zh: V4 Expressive 可视化智能体

works.title: TADA
works.description: An open-source speech-language model from Hume that aligns text and audio one-to-one, so by construction it cannot skip or hallucinate words. Hume reports a real-time factor of 0.09, more than five times faster than comparable LLM-based TTS.
works.description_zh: Hume 开源的语音-语言模型，让文本与音频一一对齐，因此从结构上就不会漏词或凭空多出词。Hume 报告其实时率为 0.09，比同级别的大模型语音合成快五倍以上。
works.idea_en: Guaranteed text fidelity matters in experiments: a stimulus voice that never drops or invents a word is a controllable stimulus.
works.idea_zh: 文本忠实度有保证对实验很重要：一个从不漏词、不多词的刺激声音，才是可控的刺激。
works.method: Llama-based 1B (English) and 3B (multilingual) models over a tokenizer running at 2-3 audio frames per second with text-acoustic dual alignment.
works.method_zh: 基于 Llama 的 1B（英语）与 3B（多语言）模型，配合每秒仅 2–3 帧的音频分词器，实现文本与声学的双重对齐。
works.specs: 1B / 3B · RTF 0.09 · 2-3 tokens per second of audio

paper.title: TADA: A Generative Framework for Speech Modeling via Text-Acoustic Dual Alignment

works.title: CinemaWorld
works.description: While a 2D film plays, the viewer's own room on a Meta Quest 3 fills with generated 3D content synchronized to the scene: particle effects, surrounding objects, textures, character-driven effects and lighting.
works.description_zh: 在播放二维电影的同时，观者在 Meta Quest 3 中看到自己的房间里出现与镜头同步的生成三维内容：粒子特效、环绕物体、纹理覆盖、角色驱动的效果与灯光。
works.idea_en: Extends a fixed film into the viewer's physical space automatically, without hand-authored AR for each scene.
works.idea_zh: 无需为每个镜头手工制作 AR，就能把一部固定的电影自动延伸到观者的物理空间。
works.method: Films are preprocessed with multimodal LLMs to extract key features, generative AI produces dynamic 3D augmentations that are embedded spatially in the room; evaluated with 100 clips, a user study (N=12) and interviews with film creators (N=8).
works.method_zh: 先用多模态大语言模型预处理电影、提取关键特征，再用生成式 AI 制作动态三维增强并嵌入房间空间；通过 100 段片段的技术评估、用户研究（N=12）与电影创作者访谈（N=8）评估。

paper.title: CinemaWorld: Generative Augmented Reality with LLMs and 3D Scene Generation for Movie Augmentation

works.title_zh: CinemaWorld：用生成式 AR 延展电影

works.title: Roomify
works.description: Turns your physical room into a themed virtual environment, such as a forest cabin or a spaceship, in which every sofa, table and wall stays where it really is, and lets designers edit it in MR and preview it in VR.
works.description_zh: 把你的真实房间变成主题化的虚拟环境，例如林中小屋或宇宙飞船，其中每张沙发、桌子和每面墙都留在真实的位置，设计者可以在 MR 中编辑、在 VR 中预览。
works.idea_en: Keeping the room's functional layout while changing its style offers presence without losing spatial awareness.
works.idea_zh: 保留房间的功能布局、只改换风格，可以在不丢失空间感知的前提下获得临场感。
works.method: In-situ 3D scene understanding, AI spatial reasoning and style-aware generation replace each furnishing with a themed counterpart of matching geometry and function; studies with 18 VR users and 8 design professionals.
works.method_zh: 通过现场三维场景理解、AI 空间推理与风格感知生成，把每件陈设替换为几何与功能相匹配的主题对应物；分别对 18 名 VR 用户和 8 名设计专业人员开展研究。
works.specs: presence +63% vs passthrough, +26% vs fully virtual (reported, N=18)

paper.title: Roomify: Spatially-Grounded Style Transformation for Immersive Virtual Environments

works.title: Helios
works.description: Helios (Peking University with ByteDance, 2026-03) is an open 14-billion-parameter model that generates minute-scale video in real time on a single H100, showing large real-time models can match small ones in speed.
works.description_zh: Helios（北京大学与字节跳动，2026 年 3 月）是 140 亿参数的开源模型，可在单张 H100 上实时生成分钟级视频，表明大规模实时模型在速度上也能追平小模型。
works.idea_en: Real-time no longer means 1.3B: quality and responsiveness stop being a trade-off.
works.idea_zh: 实时不再意味着只能用 13 亿参数的小模型：质量与响应速度不必二选一。
works.method: Autoregressive video diffusion with techniques for long-horizon stability and efficient inference (per the Helios paper).
works.method_zh: 自回归视频扩散，结合长时稳定性与高效推理技术（据 Helios 论文）。

paper.title: Helios: Real Real-Time Long Video Generation Model

works.title: Lyria 3
works.description: Google DeepMind's 2026 music model with vocals, launched in the Gemini app on 18 February 2026, followed by Lyria 3 Pro for full-length songs (25 March 2026) and Lyria 3.5 (generally available 3 September 2026). It accepts text and image prompts, and all outputs carry SynthID watermarks.
works.description_zh: Google DeepMind 2026 年带人声的音乐模型，2026 年 2 月 18 日在 Gemini 应用中上线，随后推出生成完整歌曲的 Lyria 3 Pro（2026 年 3 月 25 日）和 Lyria 3.5（2026 年 9 月 3 日正式可用）。它接受文字和图像提示，所有输出都带 SynthID 水印。
works.idea_en: Image-to-music lets a soundtrack be derived from how a scene looks, keeping score and setting consistent.
works.idea_zh: 从图像生成音乐，让配乐可以从场景的外观中推导出来，使音乐与场景保持一致。
works.method: Generative music model with vocals (architecture unpublished), exposed as 30-second clip and full-song variants; outputs are SynthID-watermarked.
works.method_zh: 带人声的生成式音乐模型（架构未公开），提供 30 秒片段与完整歌曲两种版本；输出带 SynthID 水印。

works.title: Phoenix-4
works.description: Phoenix-4 renders a full-face video replica of a real person in real time, with explicit emotion control and active-listening expressions while the user speaks; it is the face of Tavus' Conversational Video Interface. Phoenix-4.5 (2026-09-09) adds upper-body motion, zero-shot identities and about 134 ms audio-to-video latency.
works.description_zh: Phoenix-4 能实时渲染真人的全脸视频复刻，可显式控制情绪，并在用户说话时呈现主动倾听的表情；它是 Tavus 对话视频接口的“脸”。Phoenix-4.5（2026-09-09）加入上半身动作和零样本身份，音频到视频延迟约 134 ms。
works.idea_en: Makes the listening face, not just the speaking mouth, a controllable output of a real-time renderer.
works.idea_zh: 让“倾听时的脸”而不只是说话的嘴，成为实时渲染器的可控输出。
works.method: An audio feature encoder and behaviour model drive a real-time full-face rendering network trained on conversation video, with emotion and listening states as conditioning; it works alongside Sparrow (turn-taking) and Raven (perception) in a cascaded stack.
works.method_zh: 音频特征编码器和行为模型驱动一个在对话视频上训练的实时全脸渲染网络，以情绪和倾听状态作为条件；它与 Sparrow（轮流发言）和 Raven（感知）组成级联系统协同工作。

works.title: Hibiki-Zero
works.description: A simultaneous speech-to-speech translation model that listens to French, Spanish, Portuguese or German and speaks the English translation in the speaker's own voice while they are still talking. It follows Hibiki (February 2025) and no longer needs word-aligned training data.
works.description_zh: 一个同声传译式的语音到语音翻译模型：听法语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语或德语，在对方还在说话时就用对方自己的声音说出英文译文。它是 Hibiki（2025 年 2 月）的后续，不再需要逐词对齐的训练数据。
works.idea_en: Live interpretation with voice transfer makes cross-language encounters stageable: a participant hears a foreign-language interlocutor in their own language with a short, natural delay.
works.idea_zh: 带声音迁移的实时传译让跨语言相遇可以被布置出来：参与者能以短而自然的延迟，用自己的语言听到外语对话者的话。
works.method: A 3B decoder-only multistream Transformer over Mimi tokens at 12.5 Hz that models source and target speech jointly and adapts its delay to gather just enough context, trained without word-level alignments.
works.method_zh: 一个 3B 的仅解码器多流 Transformer，基于 12.5 Hz 的 Mimi 音频标记，联合建模源语音与目标语音，并自适应调整延迟以积累恰好足够的上下文，训练时无需词级对齐。

paper.title: Simultaneous Speech-to-Speech Translation Without Aligned Data

works.title_zh: Hibiki-Zero 同声传译模型

works.title: Seedance 2.0
works.description: Seedance 2.0 (public release in ByteDance's Jimeng and Doubao apps on 2026-02-12; global via BytePlus in April) generates audio and video jointly from any mix of text, image, audio and video references. Press reports say ByteDance paused real-person reference uploads soon after launch; Seedance 2.5 (2026-07-30) extends single generations to 30 seconds.
works.description_zh: Seedance 2.0（2026-02-12 在字节跳动的即梦与豆包中公开上线，4 月经 BytePlus 面向全球）可根据文本、图像、音频和视频参考的任意组合联合生成音视频。据媒体报道，字节跳动在发布后不久暂停了真人参考素材上传；Seedance 2.5（2026-07-30）把单次生成延长到 30 秒。
works.idea_en: Audio, motion and camera references in one prompt give director-level control, and also make consent for likeness a design requirement.
works.idea_zh: 在一个提示中同时给出音频、动作和镜头参考，带来导演级的控制，也让肖像授权成为必须的设计要求。
works.method: Unified multimodal audio-video joint generation architecture accepting text, image, audio and video inputs (per the Seedance 2.0 technical report).
works.method_zh: 统一的多模态音视频联合生成架构，接受文本、图像、音频与视频输入（据 Seedance 2.0 技术报告）。
works.specs: 4–15 s · joint audio-video · Seedance 2.5: up to 30 s

paper.title: Seedance 2.0: Advancing Video Generation for World Complexity

works.title: Simile
works.description: A commercial platform that simulates how real customer groups would respond to a product launch, price change or campaign, using agents built from interviews and survey data in the line of the Stanford 1,000-person study.
works.description_zh: 一个商业平台，用访谈与问卷数据构建的智能体，模拟真实客户群体对产品发布、价格调整或营销活动的反应，延续斯坦福 1,000 人研究的思路。
works.idea_en: Population simulation has become a product; its accuracy claims are exactly what behavioral researchers would need to check before using such twins as participants.
works.idea_zh: 人群模拟已经成为产品；它的准确性声明，正是行为研究者把这类“数字孪生”当作被试之前必须检验的内容。
works.method: Likely the generative-agent architecture with interview-grounded personas, validated by comparing simulated and held-out human response distributions; Simile reports enterprise studies (e.g. with CVS Health) but does not publish full model details.
works.method_zh: 很可能沿用以访谈为基础人设的生成式智能体架构，并通过比较模拟回答与留出的真人回答分布来验证；Simile 披露了与企业（如 CVS Health）的合作研究，但未公开完整模型细节。

works.title: Raven-1
works.description: Raven-1 is Tavus' multimodal perception model for live conversation: it fuses the user's tone, facial expression, gaze, posture and hesitation into running natural-language descriptions that the agent's LLM reads, so a flat 'fine' and a cheerful 'fine' lead to different replies.
works.description_zh: Raven-1 是 Tavus 用于实时对话的多模态感知模型：它把用户的语气、面部表情、视线、姿态和迟疑融合成持续更新的自然语言描述供智能体的大模型读取，于是语气平淡的“还行”和愉快的“还行”会得到不同的回应。
works.idea_en: Perception of the human becomes a separate, swappable model whose outputs could be logged as a record of what the agent 'saw'.
works.idea_zh: 对人的感知成为一个可单独替换的模型，其输出可以记录下来，作为智能体“看到了什么”的日志。
works.method: Unified audio-visual fusion producing LLM-readable descriptions rather than emotion labels, with rolling updates so context is never more than about 300 ms stale.
works.method_zh: 统一的视听融合，输出大模型可读的描述而非情绪标签，并滚动更新，使上下文的滞后不超过约 300 ms。
works.specs: audio descriptions <100 ms · context ≤300 ms stale · pipeline <600 ms
works.title_zh: Raven-1 多模态感知模型

works.title: SAGE
works.description: Given an embodied task such as 'pick up a bowl and place it on the table', SAGE's agent generates a physically valid, simulation-ready room for it and refines it until it passes its own checks; NVIDIA released code and the SAGE-10k scene dataset.
works.description_zh: 给定“拿起碗放到桌上”这样的具身任务，SAGE 的智能体会为之生成一个物理上有效、可直接仿真的房间，并不断修正直到通过自身的检查；NVIDIA 公开了代码和 SAGE-10k 场景数据集。
works.idea_en: Generating the situation from the task description, then checking it with critics, is the same loop a study needs when its scenario must be both varied and valid.
works.idea_zh: 根据任务描述生成情境、再用评审器检查，这正是研究中既要变化多样又要保证有效的情境所需要的循环。
works.method: An LLM agent couples layout and object-composition generators (including TRELLIS assets) with critics for semantic plausibility, visual realism and physical stability, iterating until the scene meets intent and loads stably in Isaac Sim.
works.method_zh: 语言模型智能体把布局生成器、物体组合生成器（包括 TRELLIS 资产）与语义合理性、视觉真实感和物理稳定性评审器结合起来，反复迭代，直到场景符合意图并能在 Isaac Sim 中稳定加载。
works.specs: SAGE-10k dataset · Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab

paper.title: SAGE: Scalable Agentic 3D Scene Generation for Embodied AI

works.title: Waymo World Model
works.description: A driving simulator built on Genie 3 that generates both camera and lidar data, controllable by language prompts, driving inputs and scene layouts, to rehearse rare events such as a tornado, an elephant on the road or a wrong-way driver.
works.description_zh: 一个基于 Genie 3 的驾驶模拟器，同时生成摄像头与激光雷达数据，可通过语言提示、驾驶输入和场景布局控制，用来演练龙卷风、路上出现大象或车辆逆行等罕见事件。
works.idea_en: A general world model's knowledge transfers to a safety-critical domain once post-trained on that domain's sensors, a pattern other high-stakes simulations could follow.
works.idea_zh: 通用世界模型的知识在用某一领域的传感器数据后训练之后，就能迁移到这个安全攸关的领域；其他高风险模拟也可以遵循这一模式。
works.method: Genie 3 post-trained on Waymo driving data to output multi-sensor 2D video and 3D lidar, with an efficient real-time variant used when a simulation departs from a logged event.
works.method_zh: 在 Waymo 驾驶数据上对 Genie 3 进行后训练，使其输出多传感器二维视频与三维激光雷达点云；当仿真偏离记录的事件时，改用高效的实时版本。
works.title_zh: Waymo 世界模型

works.title: Cube 4D generation
works.description: Beta of '4D generation' on Roblox: inside a game, a player types a prompt and receives a functional object, for example a car they can get into and drive, because Cube generates parts that match a schema and Roblox attaches behaviours to them.
works.description_zh: Roblox 上“4D 生成”的测试版：玩家在游戏中输入提示词，就能得到一个可用的物体，例如可以坐进去开的车；做法是 Cube 按“模式”（schema）生成各个部件，再由 Roblox 为部件附加行为。
works.idea_en: Generation at play time, by participants, of objects that obey the world's rules: a concrete template for letting people inside a generated situation create things that actually work. Roblox reports 160,000+ objects generated in early access in one game.
works.idea_zh: 由参与者在游玩过程中生成、并遵守世界规则的物体：为“让身处生成情境中的人创造真正能用的东西”提供了具体范例。Roblox 称在一款游戏的早期测试中已生成超过 16 万个物体。
works.method: Schemas such as Car-5 (body plus four wheels) and Body-1 (any single mesh) define the named mesh parts an object needs; Cube generates those parts and scripted behaviours make them work in the experience.
works.method_zh: Car-5（车身加四个车轮）、Body-1（任意单一网格）等模式规定物体所需的命名网格部件；Cube 生成这些部件，再由脚本行为让它们在体验中运转。
works.specs: beta schemas: Car-5, Body-1 · 160K+ objects in early access
works.title_zh: Cube 4D 生成

works.title: Kling 3.0
works.description: Kling 3.0 (2026-02-04) generates multi-shot sequences of up to 15 seconds with native audio and multilingual, lip-synced dialogue in which users assign who speaks; 'Omni' variants take reference videos and images to keep characters consistent.
works.description_zh: 可灵 3.0（2026-02-04）可生成最长 15 秒的多镜头序列，带原生音频和多语种、口型同步的对白，用户可指定由谁说话；“Omni”版本可用参考视频和图像保持角色一致。
works.idea_en: Directing who speaks and when makes short multi-character dialogue scenes feasible as stimulus material.
works.idea_zh: 可以指定谁在何时说话，多人短对话场景因此可以用作刺激材料。
works.method: Successor of the Kling-Omni architecture with joint audio-visual generation and storyboard-style multi-shot planning (per Kuaishou's press release).
works.method_zh: 沿用 Kling-Omni 架构，加入音视频联合生成与分镜式多镜头规划（据快手新闻稿）。
works.specs: up to 15 s · multi-shot · speech in EN / ZH / JA / KO / ES
works.title_zh: 可灵 3.0

works.title: MiniCPM-o 4.5
works.description: A 9B open omni-modal model that watches a live camera stream, listens and speaks at the same time, and can speak up on its own when it notices something. It runs locally through llama.cpp, Ollama and vLLM and clones a voice from a short reference clip.
works.description_zh: 一个 9B 的开源全模态模型，能看实时摄像头画面，同时听和说，发现情况时还能主动开口。它可以通过 llama.cpp、Ollama 和 vLLM 在本地运行，并用一小段参考音频克隆声音。
works.idea_en: Full-duplex audio-visual conversation small enough for one GPU, so a headset scenario can run its interlocutor offline and version-pinned.
works.idea_zh: 体量小到单张 GPU 即可运行的全双工视听对话，让头显情境中的对话者可以离线、锁定版本地运行。
works.method: End-to-end assembly of SigLIP2 vision, a Whisper-medium audio encoder, a CosyVoice2 speech decoder and a Qwen3-8B backbone, processing continuous audio-video input and concurrent text-speech output streams without mutual blocking.
works.method_zh: 由 SigLIP2 视觉编码器、Whisper-medium 音频编码器、CosyVoice2 语音解码器和 Qwen3-8B 主干端到端组装而成，持续处理音视频输入，并同时输出文本与语音流，二者互不阻塞。

paper.title: MiniCPM-o 4.5: Towards Real-Time Full-Duplex Omni-Modal Interaction

works.title: glTF Gaussian Splatting extension (KHR_gaussian_splatting)
works.description: A Khronos extension that stores 3D Gaussian splats (position, rotation, scale, opacity and spherical-harmonic color) as glTF 2.0 mesh primitives, giving engines and viewers a common baseline format. Khronos released it as a release candidate for industry feedback on 2026-02-03; as of October 2026 the spec is marked complete and ratified, with compression left to future extensions.
works.description_zh: Khronos 的一项扩展，把三维高斯泼溅（位置、旋转、缩放、不透明度与球谐颜色）存为 glTF 2.0 网格图元，为引擎与查看器提供共同的基础格式。Khronos 于 2026-02-03 发布候选版本征求业界意见；截至 2026 年 10 月，规范已标记为完成并获批准，压缩则留给后续扩展。
works.idea_en: A shared file format is what lets a generated world move unchanged from the model that made it to whichever engine runs the study.
works.idea_zh: 有了共享的文件格式，生成的世界才能原封不动地从生成它的模型，转到运行研究的任意引擎中。
works.method: Extends glTF mesh primitives with per-point attributes for Gaussian parameters and a defined rendering model, so splat scenes travel with standard glTF tooling.
works.method_zh: 在 glTF 网格图元上为高斯参数增加逐点属性，并规定渲染模型，使泼溅场景可以沿用标准 glTF 工具链。
works.specs: release candidate 2026-02-03 · ratified (status as of Oct 2026) · glTF 2.0 · uncompressed baseline
works.title_zh: glTF 高斯泼溅扩展（KHR_gaussian_splatting）

works.title: Vidu Q3
works.description: Vidu Q3 (early February 2026) is Shengshu Technology's audio-visual model, generating clips with synchronized speech and sound and strong reference-to-video consistency. Shengshu launched the Vidu line with Tsinghua University in April 2024 as China's first Sora-class model; Vidu Q4 was in preview in October 2026.
works.description_zh: Vidu Q3（2026 年 2 月初）是生数科技的音视频模型，可生成带同步语音和声音的片段，参考生视频的一致性较强。生数科技于 2024 年 4 月与清华大学推出 Vidu 系列，是国内首个 Sora 级模型；2026 年 10 月 Vidu Q4 处于预览阶段。
works.idea_en: Shows how fast Chinese labs iterate: four major Vidu generations in under two years, each adding reference and audio features.
works.idea_zh: 体现了国内团队的迭代速度：不到两年推出四代 Vidu，每代都新增参考生成或音频能力。
works.method: U-ViT diffusion transformer (Tsinghua's architecture) extended to joint audio-visual generation; Q3 details not published.
works.method_zh: 基于清华提出的 U-ViT 扩散 Transformer，扩展到音视频联合生成；Q3 细节未公开。

works.title: Project Genie
works.description: A Google Labs web prototype, powered by Genie 3, Nano Banana Pro and Gemini, where Google AI Ultra subscribers sketch a world and character from text and images, explore it in first or third person, remix others' worlds and download the result; sessions are capped at 60 seconds.
works.description_zh: Google Labs 推出的网页原型，由 Genie 3、Nano Banana Pro 与 Gemini 驱动：Google AI Ultra 订阅用户用文字和图像勾勒世界与角色，以第一或第三人称探索，可改编他人的世界并下载视频；每次体验限时 60 秒。
works.idea_en: Puts a real-time world model in front of paying users for the first time: authoring a world now takes a sentence and a picture, but a session ends after a minute.
works.idea_zh: 首次把实时世界模型交到付费用户手中：创作一个世界只需一句话加一张图，但体验一分钟就会结束。
works.method: Nano Banana Pro renders a preview image the user can edit ('world sketching'), Gemini likely handles prompt understanding, and Genie 3 then generates the path ahead in real time from the user's movement and camera input.
works.method_zh: Nano Banana Pro 生成可编辑的预览图（“世界草图”），Gemini 可能负责理解提示，随后由 Genie 3 根据用户的移动与镜头输入实时生成前方的路。
works.specs: 60 s per generation · U.S. Google AI Ultra, 18+ at launch (developer-reported)

works.title: LingBot-World
works.description: An open-source world simulator from Ant Group's Robbyant that keeps realistic, scientific and cartoon worlds consistent over minute-long interaction and responds in under a second; a hosted demo runs on Reactor.
works.description_zh: 蚂蚁集团灵波科技推出的开源世界模拟器，可在分钟级交互中保持写实、科学与卡通等不同风格世界的一致性，响应延迟低于一秒；可在 Reactor 平台在线试用。
works.idea_en: An open, minute-horizon world model from a Chinese lab, released the day before Project Genie, which narrowed the gap between open and closed world models.
works.idea_zh: 来自中国实验室的开源分钟级世界模型，比 Project Genie 早一天发布，缩小了开源与闭源世界模型之间的差距。
works.method: A world model derived from a large video-generation backbone and post-trained for action conditioning, long-term memory and low-latency streaming; later releases added fast and action variants.
works.method_zh: 由大型视频生成骨干派生、再经后训练获得动作条件、长期记忆与低延迟流式能力的世界模型；后续版本加入了快速版与动作版。

paper.title: Advancing Open-source World Models

works.title_zh: LingBot-World（蚂蚁灵波）

works.title: Lucy 2
works.description: Decart's Lucy 2 (2026-01-26) edits a live video stream at 1080p and 30 fps with near-zero latency, from character swaps and clothing changes to product placement and full environment changes driven by text and reference images; Lucy 2.5 (2026-07-16) improved temporal stability.
works.description_zh: Decart 的 Lucy 2（2026-01-26）能以 1080p、30 fps、近乎零延迟编辑实时视频流，依据文本和参考图完成角色替换、换装、植入商品乃至整体环境变换；Lucy 2.5（2026-07-16）提升了时间稳定性。
works.idea_en: Live, reference-guided transformation of a person's camera view is the building block for generative mixed-reality conditions.
works.idea_zh: 基于参考图对人的实时画面进行变换，是构建生成式混合现实实验条件的基本模块。
works.method: Real-time world-transformation video model building on MirageLSD and Lucy Edit; Decart reports it learns physical consistency without depth maps or 3D.
works.method_zh: 在 MirageLSD 与 Lucy Edit 基础上构建的实时“世界变换”视频模型；Decart 称其无需深度图或三维信息即可学到物理一致性。

works.title: 360Anything
works.description: 360Anything (Google DeepMind with the University of Toronto, ECCV 2026) lifts any perspective image or video, including footage from the Genie 3 world model, to a seamless 360° panorama without camera calibration.
works.description_zh: 360Anything（Google DeepMind 与多伦多大学，ECCV 2026）无需相机标定，就能把任意透视图像或视频（包括 Genie 3 世界模型的画面）提升为无缝的 360° 全景。
works.idea_en: Any generated clip, even a world-model rollout, can be wrapped around the viewer after the fact.
works.idea_zh: 任何生成片段，哪怕是世界模型的推演画面，都可以事后“包裹”到观看者四周。
works.method: Geometry-free diffusion transformer that learns from data where the perspective input sits inside the panorama, without explicit camera intrinsics or extrinsics.
works.method_zh: 无需几何先验的扩散 Transformer，从数据中学习透视输入在全景中的位置，不依赖显式的相机内外参。

paper.title: 360Anything: Geometry-Free Lifting of Images and Videos to 360°

works.title_zh: 360Anything：无需几何的图像与视频 360° 提升

works.title: Arena Video Arena (LMArena)
works.description: Arena's crowdsourced leaderboard for video generation: visitors enter a prompt, watch clips from two anonymous models side by side and vote, and the votes become ratings for text-to-video and image-to-video. It was introduced on lmarena.ai in January 2026; the company has since rebranded from LMArena to Arena (arena.ai).
works.description_zh: Arena 的众包视频生成排行榜：访客输入提示词，并排观看两个匿名模型生成的片段并投票，票数汇总为文生视频与图生视频的评分。它于 2026 年 1 月在 lmarena.ai 上线；此后公司已由 LMArena 更名为 Arena（arena.ai）。
works.idea_en: Human pairwise preference is the closest public proxy for perceived realism, but it rewards impressive short clips, not consistency over a long interactive session.
works.idea_zh: 人类两两偏好是衡量感知真实感最接近的公开指标，但它奖励的是惊艳的短片，而不是长时间交互中的一致性。
works.method: Blind pairwise comparisons from public users, aggregated with a Bradley-Terry model into ratings with confidence intervals.
works.method_zh: 公众用户的盲测两两比较，用 Bradley-Terry 模型汇总为带置信区间的评分。
works.specs: text-to-video and image-to-video leaderboards · blind pairwise votes
works.title_zh: Arena 视频竞技场

works.title: World API
works.description: World Labs' public API for its Marble world model: send text, one image, several images, a 360° panorama or a video, and get back a navigable 3D world that renders in the browser or exports to other tools. World Labs reports uses such as turning 2D films into explorable spaces (Escape.ai) and generating environments for robot simulators like Isaac Sim and MuJoCo.
works.description_zh: World Labs 为 Marble 世界模型开放的公开 API：输入文字、一张或多张图片、360° 全景图或一段视频，就能得到可在浏览器中渲染、也可导出到其他工具的可漫游三维世界。World Labs 介绍的用例包括把二维电影变成可探索的空间（Escape.ai），以及为 Isaac Sim、MuJoCo 等机器人仿真器生成环境。
works.idea_en: Turns 'build the room' into an API call that returns an explicit 3D world, so a lab can generate many variants of a setting and then keep each one fixed for every participant.
works.idea_zh: 把“搭建房间”变成一次返回显式三维世界的 API 调用：实验室可以生成同一场景的多种变体，再让每位被试面对完全相同的版本。
works.method: Asynchronous world-generation requests run Marble, which lifts the inputs into a 3D Gaussian-splat scene with optional mesh export.
works.method_zh: 异步的世界生成请求调用 Marble，把输入提升为三维高斯泼溅场景，并可导出网格。
works.specs: inputs: text, image, multi-image, 360° panorama, video · output: Gaussian splats + mesh · launched 2026-01-21

works.title: Integrating Virtual Reality and Large Language Models for Team-Based Non-Technical Skills Training and Evaluation in the Operating Room
works.description: VORTeX is a multi-user VR operating room in which surgical teams handle laparoscopic emergencies (pneumothorax, intra-abdominal bleeding); an LLM then classifies the team's dialogue against the NOTSS framework and draws networks of who leads and who integrates.
works.description_zh: VORTeX 是一个多人 VR 手术室，外科团队在其中处理腹腔镜手术中的紧急情况（气胸、腹腔内出血）；随后由大语言模型依据 NOTSS 框架对团队对话进行分类，并绘制谁在主导、谁在整合信息的互动网络。
works.idea_en: Here the LLM is the measurement instrument, not the scenario: automated, structured coding of team behavior adds experimental control instead of removing it.
works.idea_zh: 这里的大语言模型是测量工具而非情境本身：对团队行为进行自动化、结构化的编码，是在增强而非削弱实验控制。
works.method: Multi-user VR simulation with recorded team speech; structured prompts derived from NOTSS classify behaviors and build directed communication graphs; pilot with 12 surgical professionals at SAGES 2024.
works.method_zh: 多人 VR 模拟并录制团队语音；依据 NOTSS 设计的结构化提示词对行为分类并构建有向沟通图；在 SAGES 2024 上由 12 名外科专业人员试用。

paper.title: Integrating Virtual Reality and Large Language Models for Team-Based Non-Technical Skills Training and Evaluation in the Operating Room

works.title_zh: 融合虚拟现实与大语言模型，用于手术室团队非技术技能的训练与评估

works.title: ShapeR
works.description: Generates metric 3D shapes of the objects in a casually captured video, for example from Aria glasses, using SLAM points, posed views and machine-generated captions for each detected object; it comes with a benchmark of 178 in-the-wild objects across 7 real scenes.
works.description_zh: 从随手拍摄的视频（例如 Aria 眼镜录制的画面）中，为每个检测到的物体利用 SLAM 点、带位姿的视图和自动生成的描述，生成具有真实尺度的三维形状；并附带一个包含 7 个真实场景、178 个物体的基准。
works.idea_en: From 'one clean product photo' to 'walk through a real room wearing glasses': object generation that works on the messy captures people actually make in situ.
works.idea_zh: 从“一张干净的产品照”到“戴着眼镜在真实房间走一圈”：能处理人们在现场随手拍下的杂乱素材的物体生成。
works.method: Visual-inertial SLAM, 3D detection and VLM captioning extract per-object conditions; a rectified-flow transformer trained with compositional augmentations and an object-to-scene curriculum generates each shape.
works.method_zh: 用视觉惯性 SLAM、三维检测和视觉语言模型描述提取每个物体的条件；再由以组合式数据增强和“物体到场景”课程训练的整流流 Transformer 生成各个形状。

paper.title: ShapeR: Robust Conditional 3D Shape Generation from Casual Captures

works.title: PersonaPlex
works.description: An open full-duplex conversational model in which developers pick a voice and define any role in a text prompt (a customer-service agent, an astronaut, a fantasy character) while keeping Moshi-style interruptions, backchannels and conversational rhythm.
works.description_zh: 一个开源的全双工对话模型：开发者可以选择声音，并用文字提示定义任意角色（客服、宇航员、奇幻人物），同时保留 Moshi 式的打断、附和与对话节奏。
works.idea_en: Removes the trade-off between a configurable persona and full-duplex naturalness, which is what a scripted confederate in a behavioral study needs.
works.idea_zh: 消除了“可配置角色”与“全双工自然度”之间的取舍，这正是行为研究中按脚本行事的实验助手所需要的。
works.method: Moshi's 7B dual-stream architecture with hybrid voice-and-text system prompts, fine-tuned on Fisher conversations relabelled with LLM-written persona descriptions plus synthetic dialogues.
works.method_zh: 基于 Moshi 的 7B 双流架构，使用语音加文本的混合系统提示；在由大模型补写角色描述的 Fisher 对话以及合成对话上微调。

paper.title: PersonaPlex: Voice and Role Control for Full Duplex Conversational Speech Models

works.title: PixVerse R1
works.description: PixVerse's first real-time world model, which keeps generating a live audiovisual scene that viewers steer with prompts instead of waiting for a finished clip; later updates added 720p API access for partners, shared worlds and personalised avatars.
works.description_zh: PixVerse 的首个实时世界模型：持续生成一个带声音的实时场景，观看者用提示引导它，而不必等待成片；后续更新为合作伙伴开放 720p API，并加入共享世界与个性化虚拟形象。
works.idea_en: A consumer video app reframed as a live world: the shift from clips to sessions, at the cost of game-level control.
works.idea_zh: 一款消费级视频应用被重新定义为实时世界：从“片段”转向“会话”，但代价是缺少游戏级的操控。
works.method: PixVerse describes three parts: an 'Omni' native multimodal foundation model, autoregressive memory for continuous streaming, and an 'Instantaneous Response Engine' that cuts sampling cost for low latency.
works.method_zh: PixVerse 称其由三部分组成：原生多模态基础模型“Omni”、用于连续流式生成的自回归记忆，以及降低采样成本、实现低延迟的“即时响应引擎”。
works.title_zh: PixVerse R1（爱诗科技）

works.title: Total War: PHARAOH AI advisor (NVIDIA ACE demo)
works.description: A CES 2026 tech demo that adds a talking advisor to Creative Assembly's strategy game Total War: PHARAOH: players ask about the game's systems and their current campaign, and the advisor answers in voice.
works.description_zh: CES 2026 上的技术演示：为 Creative Assembly 的策略游戏《全面战争：法老》加入一位会说话的顾问；玩家询问游戏系统和当前战局，顾问用语音回答。
works.idea_en: An NPC whose job is to coach the player inside the game, a pattern that maps directly onto tutors in training simulations.
works.idea_zh: 一个在游戏内辅导玩家的 NPC，这一模式可以直接迁移到训练模拟中的导师角色。
works.method: NVIDIA ACE runs speech recognition, a small language model grounded in game data and current game state, and speech synthesis on the local RTX GPU.
works.method_zh: 英伟达 ACE 在本地 RTX GPU 上运行语音识别、基于游戏数据与当前游戏状态的小语言模型，以及语音合成。
works.title_zh: 《全面战争：法老》AI 顾问（NVIDIA ACE 演示）

works.title: NitroGen
works.description: An open vision-action foundation model for gaming agents, trained on 40,000 hours of public gameplay videos from more than 1,000 games, that plays 3D action games, 2D platformers and procedurally generated worlds from raw frames.
works.description_zh: 一个开放的游戏智能体视觉-动作基础模型，在 1,000 多款游戏、共 4 万小时的公开游戏视频上训练，能直接从画面游玩三维动作游戏、二维平台跳跃游戏和程序生成的世界。
works.idea_en: Internet gameplay video becomes training data for agents, the same way it is for video world models.
works.idea_zh: 互联网游戏视频成为智能体的训练数据，正如它是视频世界模型的训练数据一样。
works.method: Player actions are extracted automatically from on-screen controller overlays in gameplay videos, and a unified vision-action model is trained by large-scale behavior cloning; NVIDIA reports up to 52% relative improvement on unseen games over training from scratch.
works.method_zh: 从游戏视频画面中的手柄输入叠加层自动提取玩家动作，再以大规模行为克隆训练统一的视觉-动作模型；英伟达报告其在未见过的游戏上比从零训练最多提升 52%（相对值）。

paper.title: NitroGen: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Gaming Agents

works.title: Avatar Forcing
works.description: Avatar Forcing animates a head avatar that reacts in real time to the user's voice and visible behaviour (speech, nods, laughter) as well as its own speech, with about 500 ms latency on one GPU.
works.description_zh: Avatar Forcing 驱动的头部虚拟人能实时回应用户的声音和可见行为（说话、点头、笑声）以及它自己的语音，在单个 GPU 上延迟约 500 ms。
works.idea_en: Conditioning on the user's motion, not only audio, lets a portrait avatar react to what a participant does without speaking.
works.idea_zh: 以用户的动作（而不只是音频）为条件，让人像虚拟人能对参与者不说话时的行为作出反应。
works.method: Diffusion forcing over motion latents with causal, real-time multimodal conditioning on user audio and motion, plus preference optimization that uses samples with user conditions dropped as negatives.
works.method_zh: 在动作隐空间上做 diffusion forcing，以因果方式实时接收用户音频与动作等多模态条件；并用去掉用户条件的样本作为负例做偏好优化。
works.specs: ~500 ms latency · single H100 (14 GB) · 6.8× faster than baseline

paper.title: Avatar Forcing: Real-Time Interactive Head Avatar Generation for Natural Conversation

works.title_zh: Avatar Forcing：实时交互头部虚拟人

works.title: Decart API Platform
works.description: Decart's API streams real-time generative video: Lucy 2.5 edits or restyles a live camera feed (swapping characters, objects or backgrounds) over WebRTC, and the Oasis 3 Preview world model returns camera frames in response to driving actions over gRPC. Billing is per second of active generation, $0.01–0.04 per second at 720p as of October 2026.
works.description_zh: Decart 的 API 提供实时生成视频流：Lucy 2.5 通过 WebRTC 实时编辑或重绘摄像头画面（替换人物、物体或背景），Oasis 3 Preview 世界模型则通过 gRPC 根据驾驶动作返回相机画面。按实际生成时长计费，截至 2026 年 10 月，720p 每秒 0.01–0.04 美元。
works.idea_en: Real-time generation sold by the second makes a live, generatively altered surrounding something a lab can rent rather than train.
works.idea_zh: 按秒出售的实时生成，让“被生成式改写的实时环境”成了实验室可以租用、而不必自己训练的东西。
works.method: WebRTC (Lucy) and gRPC (Oasis) sessions to Decart-hosted autoregressive video models, with JavaScript and Python SDKs; Decart reports serving them on AWS Trainium 3.
works.method_zh: 通过 WebRTC（Lucy）与 gRPC（Oasis）会话连接 Decart 托管的自回归视频模型，提供 JavaScript 与 Python SDK；Decart 称其模型运行在 AWS Trainium 3 上。
works.specs: Lucy 2.5: 720p, $0.02/s ($0.04/s fast mode) · Lucy Restyle 2: $0.01/s · Oasis 3 Preview: $0.02/s

works.title: Gracia
works.description: Gracia captures performers and scenes as 4D Gaussian splat video and streams it to apps on Quest, Pico, Apple Vision Pro, desktop and the browser, where viewers can walk around the recorded moment.
works.description_zh: Gracia 把表演者和场景捕捉为 4D 高斯泼溅视频，并流式传输到 Quest、Pico、Apple Vision Pro、桌面和浏览器上的应用中，观众可以绕着录下的时刻走动。
works.idea_en: One of the first services to put streamed Gaussian video into consumer headsets (first 4DGS streaming in March 2026 and a free Apple Vision Pro app in June 2026, as reported by Radiancefields.com), so it shows where file size and bandwidth limit what can be shown.
works.idea_zh: 最早把流式高斯视频送进消费级头显的服务之一（据 Radiancefields.com 报道，2026 年 3 月首次实现 4DGS 流式传输，6 月推出免费的 Apple Vision Pro 应用），因此也能看出文件大小和带宽在哪里限制了可展示的内容。
works.method: Multi-camera captures are reconstructed into per-frame splat sequences and encoded as keyframes plus motion deltas for streaming (as described by Radiancefields.com); Unity and Unreal plug-ins and WebGPU playback are offered.
works.method_zh: 多相机捕捉被重建为逐帧泼溅序列，并编码为关键帧加运动增量以便流式传输（据 Radiancefields.com 介绍）；提供 Unity、Unreal 插件与 WebGPU 播放。
works.title_zh: Gracia 体积高斯视频

works.title: Immersive Web SDK (IWSDK)
works.description: Meta's open-source framework for WebXR apps built on Three.js: an entity-component runtime with grab interactions, locomotion, spatial audio, physics, scene understanding and HTML-like spatial UI, plus a Spatial Editor. As of October 2026 its site calls it 'AI-native': coding agents can take screenshots, send controller input and inspect the running XR scene to debug it.
works.description_zh: Meta 基于 Three.js 的开源 WebXR 应用框架：实体组件运行时，内置抓取交互、移动、空间音频、物理、场景理解与类 HTML 语法的空间界面，并配有 Spatial Editor。截至 2026 年 10 月，其官网称之为“AI 原生”：编程智能体可以截图、发送手柄输入、检查正在运行的 XR 场景并调试。
works.idea_en: Agent-operable XR scenes mean an LLM can build and test a study environment end to end, not only write the code for it.
works.idea_zh: XR 场景可由智能体直接操作，意味着大语言模型不仅能为研究环境写代码，还能从头到尾搭建并测试它。
works.method: Three.js renderer under an entity-component architecture, with UIKitML for spatial UI and an agent tool interface for scene inspection and simulated input.
works.method_zh: 实体组件架构之下的 Three.js 渲染器，用 UIKitML 编写空间界面，并提供供智能体检查场景、模拟输入的工具接口。
works.title_zh: Immersive Web SDK（沉浸式网页 SDK）

works.title: Echo
works.description: SpAItial's first world model: a single image or short text prompt becomes a metric-scale 3D Gaussian-splat environment that can be explored freely in real time in a web browser.
works.description_zh: SpAItial 的第一个世界模型：把一张图像或一句简短文字变成具有真实尺度的三维高斯泼溅环境，可在网页浏览器中实时自由探索。
works.idea_en: A second company, from the Munich 3D-vision community, now sells persistent splat worlds, so researchers are not tied to a single vendor's format.
works.idea_zh: 又一家来自慕尼黑三维视觉圈的公司开始提供持久的泼溅世界，研究者不必绑定单一厂商的格式。
works.method: SpAItial describes inferring one unified metric-scale scene representation of geometry and appearance from which every frame and depth map is rendered, displayed with 3D Gaussian splatting; the architecture is unpublished.
works.method_zh: SpAItial 称其先推断出统一的、具有真实尺度的几何与外观场景表示，每一帧画面和深度图都由它渲染，再用三维高斯泼溅显示；架构未公开。

works.title: TRELLIS.2
works.description: Successor to TRELLIS: a 4-billion-parameter image-to-3D model built on O-Voxel, a sparse voxel structure that encodes arbitrary topology (open, non-manifold and fully enclosed surfaces) together with PBR material attributes.
works.description_zh: TRELLIS 的后继：40 亿参数的图生三维模型，基于稀疏体素结构 O-Voxel，可同时编码任意拓扑（开放、非流形和完全封闭的表面）与 PBR 材质属性。
works.idea_en: Native handling of thin, open and nested surfaces such as cloth, leaves and interiors removes a common reason generated props look like closed plastic shells.
works.idea_zh: 原生支持布料、树叶、内部结构等薄、开放和嵌套的表面，消除了生成道具常像封闭塑料壳的一个原因。
works.method: A Sparse Compression VAE over O-Voxels gives a compact latent space; large flow-matching transformers (4B parameters) trained on public 3D datasets generate geometry and materials.
works.method_zh: 基于 O-Voxel 的稀疏压缩 VAE 提供紧凑的潜空间；在公开三维数据集上训练的大型流匹配 Transformer（40 亿参数）生成几何与材质。

paper.title: Native and Compact Structured Latents for 3D Generation

works.title: HY-Motion 1.0
works.description: Tencent's open-weight, billion-parameter text-to-motion model that generates 3D human motion for character animation from natural-language prompts across more than 200 motion categories, released with a Lite version and a Hugging Face demo.
works.description_zh: 腾讯开源权重的十亿参数文生动作模型，可由自然语言提示生成用于角色动画的三维人体动作，覆盖 200 多个动作类别，并发布了 Lite 版本和 Hugging Face 演示。
works.idea_en: Scaling reaches motion generation: much more data and a larger model give markedly better prompt following, narrowing the gap with text-to-video for bodies.
works.idea_zh: 规模化来到了动作生成：更多数据和更大模型显著提升了对提示的遵循，缩小了身体动作与文生视频之间的差距。
works.method: A Diffusion Transformer with flow matching, pretrained on 3,000+ hours of motion, fine-tuned on 400 hours of curated data, then aligned with reinforcement learning from human feedback and reward models.
works.method_zh: 基于流匹配的扩散 Transformer，先在 3000 多小时动作数据上预训练，再用 400 小时精选数据微调，最后用人类反馈与奖励模型做强化学习对齐。

paper.title: HY-Motion 1.0: Scaling Flow Matching Models for Text-To-Motion Generation

works.title_zh: 混元 HY-Motion 1.0

works.title: SoulX-FlashTalk
works.description: SoulX-FlashTalk streams a high-fidelity audio-driven avatar from a 14B model with sub-second start-up and real-time frame rate, for unbounded durations; weights are on Hugging Face.
works.description_zh: SoulX-FlashTalk 用一个 14B 模型流式生成高保真的音频驱动虚拟人，启动时间不到一秒，帧率达到实时，时长不受限；权重已发布在 Hugging Face。
works.idea_en: An open real-time avatar from a social-app company, used as a baseline by commercial full-duplex systems in 2026.
works.idea_zh: 一家社交应用公司开源的实时虚拟人，2026 年被商用全双工系统用作对比基线。
works.method: Self-correcting bidirectional distillation that keeps bidirectional attention within chunks, a multi-step retrospective self-correction mechanism, and hybrid sequence parallelism with parallel VAE decoding.
works.method_zh: 自校正双向蒸馏（在片段内保留双向注意力），配合多步回溯自校正机制，以及混合序列并行和并行 VAE 解码。

paper.title: SoulX-FlashTalk: Real-Time Infinite Streaming of Audio-Driven Avatars via Self-Correcting Bidirectional Distillation

works.title: Step inside an AI-generated movie scene
works.description: A browser WebXR proof of concept, recorded on Apple Vision Pro, lets the viewer enter the Dojo from The Matrix, teleport around generated characters in motion and ask questions to an AI agent inside the scene.
works.description_zh: 一个浏览器 WebXR 概念验证（在 Apple Vision Pro 上录制）让观者走进《黑客帝国》的道场，在运动中的生成角色之间瞬移，还能向场景里的 AI 智能体提问。
works.idea_en: Assembles a walkable film scene entirely from off-the-shelf generators, hinting at films that become explorable situations.
works.idea_zh: 完全用现成的生成工具拼出可走进的电影场景，预示电影可以变成可探索的情境。
works.method: Environment generated as a Gaussian splat from source footage with World Labs, characters converted from images to rigged 3D models with Tripo, motion from AI motion capture, and an embedded AI agent answering questions.
works.method_zh: 环境由 World Labs 从原片素材生成高斯泼溅，角色用 Tripo 从图像转换为绑骨三维模型，动作来自 AI 动作捕捉，场景里嵌入一个回答问题的 AI 智能体。
works.title_zh: 走进 AI 生成的电影场景

works.title: StereoPilot
works.description: StereoPilot (HKUST (Guangzhou) with Kuaishou's Kling team, 2025-12) converts monocular video to stereo for both parallel and converged camera setups in a single efficient pass, using generative video priors.
works.description_zh: StereoPilot（港科大（广州）与快手可灵团队，2025 年 12 月）借助生成式视频先验，一次高效推理即可把单目视频转换为平行式或会聚式两种立体格式。
works.idea_en: Fast, format-aware stereo conversion lets a lab deliver generated scenes to different headsets without re-rendering.
works.idea_zh: 快速且区分立体格式的转换，让实验室无需重新渲染就能把生成场景投放到不同头显上。
works.method: Unified feed-forward stereo conversion on a video-generation backbone, trained on a curated dataset covering parallel and converged stereo.
works.method_zh: 基于视频生成主干的统一前馈式立体转换，在涵盖平行与会聚两种立体格式的数据集上训练。

paper.title: StereoPilot: Learning Unified and Efficient Stereo Conversion via Generative Priors

works.title: HY-World 1.5 (WorldPlay)
works.description: An open-source, real-time interactive world model that streams a navigable world from an image or text and keeps its geometry consistent when the user returns to a place; later releases added a lightweight 5B variant, training code and RL post-training (WorldCompass).
works.description_zh: 开源的实时交互世界模型：从一张图像或一段文字流式生成可漫游的世界，用户回到原处时几何结构保持一致；后续版本加入了轻量的 5B 版本、训练代码以及强化学习后训练方法 WorldCompass。
works.idea_en: Combines real-time play with long-term geometric memory in an open model, so persistence can be studied rather than taken on trust.
works.idea_zh: 在开源模型中同时做到实时交互与长期几何记忆，使“持久性”可以被研究，而不只是听厂商宣称。
works.method: An autoregressive video model (8B, built on HunyuanVideo) with dual action representation, reconstituted context memory that re-selects past frames by geometry, and context-forcing distillation for real-time speed.
works.method_zh: 基于 HunyuanVideo 的 8B 自回归视频模型，采用双重动作表示、按几何关系重新挑选历史帧的“重构上下文记忆”，以及用于实时提速的上下文强制蒸馏。

paper.title: WorldPlay: Towards Long-Term Geometric Consistency for Real-Time Interactive World Modeling

works.title_zh: 混元世界 1.5（WorldPlay）

works.title: GWM-1
works.description: Runway's first general world model family, released as three post-trained variants: GWM Worlds for explorable environments, GWM Avatars for conversational characters and GWM Robotics for action-conditioned robot video, with a Robotics SDK.
works.description_zh: Runway 的首个通用世界模型系列，以三个后训练变体发布：用于可探索环境的 GWM Worlds、用于对话角色的 GWM Avatars，以及以机器人动作为条件生成视频的 GWM Robotics，并提供机器人 SDK。
works.idea_en: One video backbone serves places, people and robots, which hints at a single model for a whole situation, though the variants are still separate models.
works.idea_zh: 同一个视频骨干同时服务于场景、人物与机器人，预示着用一个模型承载整个情境的可能，尽管各变体目前仍是独立模型。
works.method: An autoregressive model built on Gen-4.5 that generates frame by frame and is conditioned on camera pose, robot commands or audio.
works.method_zh: 基于 Gen-4.5 的自回归模型，逐帧生成，以镜头位姿、机器人指令或音频为条件。

works.title: SHARP
works.description: Apple's open model that converts a single photo into a metric-scale 3D Gaussian representation in under a second on a standard GPU, which then renders photorealistic nearby views in real time.
works.description_zh: Apple 的开源模型：在普通 GPU 上不到一秒就把一张照片转换成具有真实尺度的三维高斯表示，随后可实时渲染出照片级的邻近视角。
works.idea_en: Sub-second, metric splats from one photo make 'step into this picture' cheap enough to do for every stimulus image, though only for small head movements.
works.idea_zh: 一秒之内从一张照片得到带真实尺度的泼溅，让“走进这张照片”便宜到可以对每张刺激图都这样做，不过只适用于小幅度的头部移动。
works.method: A single feed-forward network regresses the parameters of 3D Gaussians from one image with absolute scale; the authors report LPIPS 25–34% and DISTS 21–43% lower than the best prior model with three orders of magnitude less synthesis time.
works.method_zh: 单个前馈网络从一张图像直接回归具有绝对尺度的三维高斯参数；作者报告其 LPIPS 比此前最佳模型低 25–34%，DISTS 低 21–43%，合成时间缩短三个数量级。
works.specs: < 1 s per image on a standard GPU · metric-scale 3DGS · real-time rendering

paper.title: Sharp Monocular View Synthesis in Less Than a Second

works.title: Live Avatar
works.description: Live Avatar streams an audio-driven avatar from a 14B diffusion model in real time and for hours (over 10,000 seconds) without identity drift; its demos show live interaction with a voice agent.
works.description_zh: Live Avatar 用一个 14B 扩散模型实时流式生成音频驱动的虚拟人，可连续生成数小时（超过 10000 秒）而身份不漂移；演示展示了与语音智能体的实时互动。
works.idea_en: Shows that frontier-size video models can run as live avatars if the denoising steps are spread across GPUs.
works.idea_zh: 说明只要把去噪步骤分摊到多块 GPU 上，前沿规模的视频模型也能作为实时虚拟人运行。
works.method: Two-stage distillation of a bidirectional model into a causal few-step streamer, long-horizon anti-drift strategies, and Timestep-forcing Pipeline Parallelism (one denoising timestep per GPU).
works.method_zh: 两阶段地把双向模型蒸馏为因果、少步的流式模型，加上长时防漂移策略，以及时间步强制流水线并行（每块 GPU 负责一个去噪时间步）。
works.specs: 14B params · 45 fps · 1.21 s time to first frame on 5× H800 · >10,000 s stable

paper.title: Live Avatar: Streaming Real-time Audio-Driven Avatar Generation with Infinite Length

works.title_zh: Live Avatar：无限时长实时流式虚拟人

works.title: Gen-4.5
works.description: Gen-4.5 (2025-12-01) improves motion quality, physical weight and prompt adherence; Runway reported it ranked first on the Artificial Analysis text-to-video benchmark at launch with 1,247 Elo. Image-to-video followed in early 2026.
works.description_zh: Gen-4.5（2025-12-01）提升了动作质量、物体的重量感与提示遵循；Runway 称其发布时以 1247 Elo 位列 Artificial Analysis 文生视频榜首。图生视频功能于 2026 年初推出。
works.idea_en: The physical plausibility of bodies and objects, more than resolution, became the axis frontier models compete on.
works.idea_zh: 前沿模型竞争的重点从分辨率转向身体与物体的物理合理性。
works.method: Runway's next-generation video diffusion model, trained on NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell GPUs; details not published.
works.method_zh: Runway 新一代视频扩散模型，在 NVIDIA Hopper 与 Blackwell GPU 上训练；细节未公开。
works.specs: #1 Artificial Analysis T2V at launch · 1,247 Elo (Runway claim)

works.title: Kling O1
works.description: Kling O1 (2025-12-01), billed as the first unified video model, handles generation, reference-based creation and video editing (swapping subjects, restyling, changing shots) within one multimodal prompt.
works.description_zh: 可灵 O1（2025-12-01）号称首个统一视频模型，在一个多模态提示中同时完成生成、基于参考的创作和视频编辑（替换主体、改变风格、更换镜头）。
works.idea_en: A single model that both shoots and edits means a scene can be iterated by instruction while the characters stay fixed.
works.idea_zh: 一个模型同时负责“拍摄”和“剪辑”，场景可以按指令迭代，而角色保持不变。
works.method: Multimodal visual-language backbone driving a diffusion video generator, described in the Kling-Omni technical report.
works.method_zh: 多模态视觉-语言主干驱动扩散视频生成器，详见 Kling-Omni 技术报告。

paper.title: Kling-Omni Technical Report

works.title_zh: 可灵 O1

works.title: Life Stories × World Labs
works.description: A true memory collected by Liquid City's AI interviewer is turned into descriptions, then images, and finally an explorable 3D Gaussian-splat world made with World Labs' Marble, such as 'Night Lake'.
works.description_zh: Liquid City 的 AI 采访者收集一段真实回忆，先把它变成文字描述，再变成图像，最后用 World Labs 的 Marble 生成可漫游的三维高斯泼溅世界，例如《Night Lake》。
works.idea_en: A spoken memory becomes a place you can walk into, a route from oral history to an immersive situation.
works.idea_zh: 一段口述回忆变成可以走进去的地方，这是从口述史通往沉浸情境的一条路径。
works.method: Pipeline: AI interview, LLM scene description, image generation, then World Labs Marble image-to-world generation into Gaussian splats.
works.method_zh: 流程：AI 采访，大语言模型撰写场景描述，图像生成，再用 World Labs Marble 从图像生成高斯泼溅世界。
works.title_zh: 人生故事 × World Labs

works.title: LiveAvatar (Interactive Avatar)
works.description: LiveAvatar is HeyGen's real-time avatar streaming API, the successor to its Interactive Avatar: a half- or full-body 1080p avatar, cloned from an image or two minutes of footage, speaks a voice agent's replies over WebRTC. HeyGen reports under 300 ms median time to first frame and prices from about $0.01 per minute at volume.
works.description_zh: LiveAvatar 是 HeyGen 的实时虚拟人流式 API，接替了此前的 Interactive Avatar：一个由图像或两分钟视频克隆而来的半身或全身 1080p 虚拟人，通过 WebRTC 说出语音智能体的回复。HeyGen 称首帧中位时间低于 300 ms，大批量时约每分钟 0.01 美元。
works.idea_en: Real-time avatars became cheap enough to give every voice agent a face, which moves the open question from 'can it render' to 'does it behave'.
works.idea_zh: 实时虚拟人便宜到可以给每个语音智能体配一张脸，问题从“能不能渲染”转向“行为像不像”。
works.method: Avatar-only rendering streamed via LiveKit/WebRTC, driven either by HeyGen's managed ASR-LLM-TTS stack or by the developer's own voice agent.
works.method_zh: 仅负责虚拟人渲染，通过 LiveKit/WebRTC 推流；驱动它的可以是 HeyGen 托管的语音识别-大模型-语音合成流程，也可以是开发者自己的语音智能体。
works.specs: 1080p · <300 ms median time to first frame · unlimited concurrency
works.title_zh: LiveAvatar 实时虚拟人

works.title: Teammates
works.description: A playable first-person shooter level in which the player gives spoken orders to two AI squadmates, Pablo and Sofia, and to an in-game assistant, Jaspar, who can highlight enemies, explain lore, change settings or pause the game. It was playtested with a few hundred players.
works.description_zh: 一个可游玩的第一人称射击关卡：玩家用语音向两名 AI 队友 Pablo 与 Sofia，以及游戏内助手 Jaspar 下达指令；Jaspar 能标记敌人、讲解背景故事、调整设置或暂停游戏。该实验曾向数百名玩家开放测试。
works.idea_en: Moves generative NPCs from conversation to coordinated action: natural speech becomes the controller for teammates in a live combat situation.
works.idea_zh: 把生成式 NPC 从“聊天”推进到“协同行动”：在实时战斗情境中，自然语音成为指挥队友的操作方式。
works.method: Built on Ubisoft's Snowdrop engine; speech is transcribed and interpreted together with game-state context by an LLM layer (reported as Google Gemini with internal middleware) that selects squad behaviors and generates voiced replies.
works.method_zh: 基于育碧 Snowdrop 引擎；语音被转写后，与游戏状态上下文一起交给大语言模型层（据报道为 Google Gemini 与内部中间件）理解，由其选择小队行为并生成配音回复。
works.title_zh: Teammates（育碧 AI 队友实验）

works.title: HunyuanVideo 1.5
works.description: HunyuanVideo 1.5 (2025-11-20) is a lightweight 8.3-billion-parameter open model that produces 720p video (1080p with its super-resolution stage) and runs on consumer GPUs.
works.description_zh: HunyuanVideo 1.5（2025-11-20）是 83 亿参数的轻量开源模型，可生成 720p 视频（配合超分辨率阶段可达 1080p），能在消费级显卡上运行。
works.idea_en: The open-model race shifted to quality per parameter; a lab can run it without a cluster.
works.idea_zh: 开源模型的竞争转向“每个参数的质量”；实验室不需要集群就能运行。
works.method: DiT with selective and sliding tile attention (SSTA), glyph-aware bilingual text encoding and a video super-resolution network.
works.method_zh: 采用选择性滑动分块注意力（SSTA）的 DiT，配字形感知的中英文本编码和视频超分辨率网络。

paper.title: HunyuanVideo 1.5 Technical Report

works.title_zh: 混元视频 1.5

works.title: WorldGen
works.description: Meta Reality Labs' research system that turns a single text prompt into a traversable, fully textured 3D world (reported up to about 50 × 50 m) with a navigation mesh, ready to explore or edit in Unity or Unreal Engine. Research only as of October 2026.
works.description_zh: Meta Reality Labs 的研究系统：把一句文字变成可行走、完整贴图的三维世界（报道称最大约 50 × 50 米），自带导航网格，可直接在 Unity 或虚幻引擎中探索或编辑。截至 2026 年 10 月仍仅限研究。
works.idea_en: Walkability comes first: the layout and navmesh are planned before appearance, so the world works as a level, not only as a view.
works.idea_zh: 可行走性优先：先规划布局和导航网格，再决定外观，所以这个世界首先是一个“关卡”，而不只是一幅画面。
works.method: LLM-driven layout reasoning and procedural blockout produce a navmesh-aware scene plan, a reference image is generated, image-to-3D reconstruction builds the scene, and object-aware decomposition and per-object enhancement and texturing finish the world.
works.method_zh: 由语言模型推理布局并程序化生成白盒，得到考虑导航网格的场景规划；再生成参考图像，经图生三维重建出场景，最后进行按物体的分解、增强与贴图。
works.specs: scenes up to ~50 × 50 m (reported) · navmesh · Unity / Unreal export

paper.title: WorldGen: From Text to Traversable and Interactive 3D Worlds

works.title: SAM 3D (Objects and Body)
works.description: Meta's pair of open models that lift things in an ordinary photo into 3D: SAM 3D Objects reconstructs the geometry, texture and layout of selected objects even in clutter or under occlusion, and SAM 3D Body recovers a full-body human mesh including hands and feet, promptable with masks or keypoints.
works.description_zh: Meta 的一对开源模型，可把普通照片中的东西“抬升”为三维：SAM 3D Objects 即使在杂乱或遮挡情况下也能重建选中物体的几何、贴图和摆放位置；SAM 3D Body 恢复包括手脚在内的全身人体网格，可用遮罩或关键点进行提示。
works.idea_en: Grounds asset generation in real photographs: any snapshot of a room or a person becomes a source of 3D props and bodies for rebuilding that situation.
works.idea_zh: 把资产生成扎根于真实照片：任何一张房间或人物的快照，都能成为重建该情境所需的三维道具和人体的来源。
works.method: Objects: multi-stage training (synthetic pretraining, then real-world alignment) on data annotated with a human- and model-in-the-loop pipeline; Body: an encoder-decoder over the new Momentum Human Rig (MHR) parametric mesh.
works.method_zh: Objects：在人与模型协同标注的数据上进行多阶段训练（先合成数据预训练，再与真实世界对齐）；Body：基于新的参数化网格 Momentum Human Rig（MHR）的编码器—解码器。
works.specs: ≥5:1 human-preference win rate on real-world objects (Meta)

paper.title: SAM 3D: 3Dfy Anything in Images

works.title_zh: SAM 3D（物体与人体）

works.title: Depth Anything 3
works.description: Depth Anything 3 from ByteDance Seed predicts consistent depth and camera rays from one image or any number of views, and can output a 3D Gaussian scene for novel views.
works.description_zh: 字节跳动 Seed 的 Depth Anything 3 可从一张图像或任意数量的视角预测一致的深度与相机射线，并能输出用于新视角渲染的三维高斯场景。
works.idea_en: Collapses monocular depth, multi-view reconstruction and feed-forward splatting into one open model.
works.idea_zh: 把单目深度、多视角重建和前馈式泼溅合并到一个开源模型中。
works.method: A plain DINOv2 transformer with cross-view attention predicts a depth-ray representation, trained with a teacher-student scheme on synthetic and real data; a Gaussian head is added for rendering.
works.method_zh: 一个普通的 DINOv2 Transformer 加跨视角注意力，预测“深度-射线”表示，在合成与真实数据上以师生方式训练，并附加高斯预测头用于渲染。

paper.title: Depth Anything 3: Recovering the Visual Space from Any Views

works.title: SIMA 2
works.description: A Gemini-based game companion that reasons about goals, talks with the player, follows instructions given as text in several languages, emoji or images, and carries skills into games it has never seen, including 3D worlds generated on the fly by Genie 3.
works.description_zh: 基于 Gemini 的游戏伙伴：能推理目标、与玩家交谈，理解多种语言的文字、表情符号或图像形式的指令，并把技能带到从未见过的游戏中，包括 Genie 3 即时生成的三维世界。
works.idea_en: The first public pairing of a generalist agent with a world model: Genie 3 makes the world, SIMA 2 acts in it and improves there without new human data.
works.idea_zh: 首次公开把通用智能体与世界模型配对：Genie 3 生成世界，SIMA 2 在其中行动，并在不需要新人类数据的情况下自我提升。
works.method: A Gemini foundation model fine-tuned on human gameplay and Gemini-labelled data maps screen frames and instructions to keyboard-mouse actions; in a self-improvement loop Gemini proposes tasks and estimates rewards, and the agent's own trajectories train its next version.
works.method_zh: 在人类游戏数据与 Gemini 标注数据上微调的 Gemini 基础模型，把屏幕画面与指令映射为键鼠动作；在自我提升循环中，由 Gemini 提出任务并估计奖励，智能体自身的轨迹用于训练下一代版本。

paper.title: SIMA 2: A Generalist Embodied Agent for Virtual Worlds

works.title: Lumine
works.description: A vision-language agent that plays Genshin Impact in real time, finishing the five-hour Mondstadt main storyline at roughly human pace, and without fine-tuning completes 100-minute missions in Wuthering Waves and the first chapter of Honkai: Star Rail.
works.description_zh: 一个视觉语言智能体，能实时游玩《原神》，以接近人类的效率完成五小时的蒙德主线剧情；无需微调，还能完成《鸣潮》中 100 分钟的任务以及《崩坏：星穹铁道》第一章。
works.idea_en: Real-time, hours-long play in a commercial open world means an agent can now be a long-lived companion or test player inside 3D worlds.
works.idea_zh: 能在商业开放世界中实时、连续游玩数小时，意味着智能体可以在三维世界里成为长期陪伴者或测试玩家。
works.method: A vision-language model trained on a curriculum of 1,731 hours of human gameplay (action primitives), 200 hours of instruction-following data and 15 hours of reasoning data reads frames at 5 Hz, emits 30 Hz keyboard-mouse action chunks and calls on reasoning only when needed.
works.method_zh: 一个视觉语言模型按课程式训练：1,731 小时人类游戏录像（动作基元）、200 小时指令跟随数据与 15 小时推理数据，以 5 Hz 读取画面，输出 30 Hz 的键鼠动作块，并只在需要时调用推理。

paper.title: Lumine: An Open Recipe for Building Generalist Agents in 3D Open Worlds

works.title: Marble
works.description: World Labs' world-generation product: text, one or more photos, a video or a coarse 3D layout become a persistent 3D world that can be edited, expanded, stitched with others and exported as Gaussian splats, meshes or video. Beta from 2025-09-16, generally available from 2025-11-12; Marble 1.1 and 1.1 Plus (larger worlds) followed in 2026, and the World API opened it to developers on 2026-01-21.
works.description_zh: World Labs 的世界生成产品：文字、一张或多张照片、一段视频或粗略的三维布局，都能变成持久的三维世界，可以编辑、扩展、与其他世界拼接，并导出为高斯泼溅、网格或视频。2025 年 9 月 16 日开放测试，11 月 12 日全面上线；2026 年推出 Marble 1.1 与可生成更大世界的 1.1 Plus，并于 2026 年 1 月 21 日通过 World API 向开发者开放。
works.idea_en: A researcher can author a whole set from a prompt or a few photos and then keep, version and reload exactly the same world for every participant.
works.idea_zh: 研究者可以用一句提示词或几张照片搭出整个场景，之后为每位参与者保存、版本化并重新加载完全相同的世界。
works.method: A proprietary multimodal world model generates a 3D Gaussian-splat world (with optional mesh extraction) from the inputs; a layout editor (Chisel) separates coarse 3D structure from visual style, and worlds render on web, mobile and VR through World Labs' open-source Spark renderer.
works.method_zh: 专有的多模态世界模型根据输入生成三维高斯泼溅世界（可另行提取网格）；布局编辑器 Chisel 把粗略的三维结构与视觉风格分开控制；世界通过 World Labs 开源的 Spark 渲染器在网页、手机和 VR 中显示。
works.specs: text / image / multi-image / video / 3D layout in · Gaussian splats, mesh or video out · Marble 1.1 Plus for larger worlds

works.title: Steam Frame
works.description: Valve's standalone, streaming-first VR headset, announced on 2025-11-12 and sold from September 2026 ($1,059 for 256 GB, $1,299 for 1 TB). It runs SteamOS on a Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 and streams PC VR wirelessly with eye-tracked foveated streaming; it ships no generative features of its own but brings PC-rendered worlds to a wireless headset.
works.description_zh: Valve 的一体式、以串流为主的 VR 头显，2025-11-12 发布，2026 年 9 月开售（256 GB 版 1,059 美元，1 TB 版 1,299 美元）。它在骁龙 8 Gen 3 上运行 SteamOS，并通过眼动追踪注视点串流无线传输 PC VR 画面；它本身不带生成式功能，但能把 PC 渲染的世界送到无线头显上。
works.idea_en: Wireless PC streaming lets a headset show worlds generated on a desktop GPU, which matters while real-time world models still need workstation or datacenter hardware.
works.idea_zh: 无线 PC 串流让头显可以显示由台式机 GPU 生成的世界；在实时世界模型仍需工作站或数据中心硬件的阶段，这一点很重要。
works.method: Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 with 16 GB LPDDR5X, 2160×2160 LCD per eye, inside-out tracking, eye tracking, and a dedicated wireless adapter for PC streaming.
works.method_zh: 骁龙 8 Gen 3 与 16 GB LPDDR5X 内存，单眼 2160×2160 LCD，由内向外追踪与眼动追踪，并配有专用无线适配器用于 PC 串流。
works.specs: 2160×2160 LCD per eye · 72–144 Hz · Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 · 16 GB · $1,059 / $1,299

works.title: Game-TARS
works.description: A generalist game agent that controls any game through native keyboard and mouse input; ByteDance reports about twice the previous best success rate on open-world Minecraft tasks and near novice-human generality in unseen web 3D games.
works.description_zh: 一个通过原生键鼠输入操控任意游戏的通用游戏智能体；字节跳动称其在开放世界 Minecraft 任务上的成功率约为此前最佳模型的两倍，在未见过的网页三维游戏中接近新手玩家的泛化水平。
works.idea_en: One action space for every game lets agent training scale like language-model pretraining.
works.idea_zh: 所有游戏共用一个动作空间，让智能体训练可以像语言模型预训练一样扩展。
works.method: Continual pretraining on more than 500B tokens of multimodal trajectories across OS, web and game domains, with a decaying continual loss against causal confusion and a sparse-thinking strategy that reasons only at key steps.
works.method_zh: 在操作系统、网页与游戏领域超过 5,000 亿 token 的多模态轨迹上持续预训练，用衰减式持续损失缓解因果混淆，并采用只在关键步骤推理的稀疏思考策略。

paper.title: Game-TARS: Pretrained Foundation Models for Scalable Generalist Multimodal Game Agents

works.title: Odyssey-2
works.description: A world model that begins streaming video within seconds of a typed prompt and keeps changing it as the viewer types new instructions, for multi-minute sessions in a web app; it follows Odyssey-1 (May 2025) and was later offered through an API as Odyssey-2 Pro.
works.description_zh: 一个世界模型：输入提示几秒后便开始流式生成视频，观看者继续输入指令，画面随之改变，单次可持续数分钟，可在网页应用中体验；它是 Odyssey-1（2025 年 5 月）的后继，之后以 Odyssey-2 Pro 的形式开放 API。
works.idea_en: Makes video behave like a chat: you steer it by typing, which lowers the bar for authoring, but text is coarse compared with game controls.
works.idea_zh: 让视频像聊天一样运作：边打字边引导画面，降低了创作门槛，但与游戏操控相比，文字指令较为粗略。
works.method: A causal, autoregressive video model that generates each frame from past frames and the current text, producing a new frame every 50 ms.
works.method_zh: 因果自回归视频模型，根据此前的画面与当前文字生成每一帧，每 50 毫秒产出一帧。
works.specs: 20 fps · 50 ms per frame · multi-minute streams (developer-reported)

works.title: Storycaster
works.description: A projection room becomes a story space: a narrator agent guides participants, and by voice they co-create scenes that are projected on the walls with generated imagery, ambient audio and dialogue, while real objects in the room can turn into their story counterparts.
works.description_zh: 投影房间变成故事空间：叙述者智能体引导参与者，参与者用语音共同创作场景，墙面投出生成的图像，并配有生成的环境音与对白；房间里的真实物品也能变成故事中的对应物。
works.idea_en: A generative CAVE keeps people aware of the real room and of each other while the story around them changes.
works.idea_zh: 生成式 CAVE 让人在周围故事不断变化时，仍能感知真实房间与彼此。
works.method: Live camera feeds and cylindrical projection augment the walls; image, audio and dialogue generators, object-level editing of physical items and an LLM narrator respond to voice commands; a study with 13 participants.
works.method_zh: 通过实时摄像头画面与柱面投影增强墙面；图像、音频、对白生成器，对真实物品的物体级编辑，以及大语言模型叙述者共同回应语音指令；对 13 名参与者开展研究。

paper.title: Storycaster: An AI System for Immersive Room-based Storytelling

works.title: LTX-2
works.description: Lightricks' LTX-2 (announced 2025-10-23, weights released afterwards) generates synchronized audio and video at up to 4K and 50 fps; LTX-2.5 followed in August 2026 as a 22B open model with a family of control LoRAs.
works.description_zh: Lightricks 的 LTX-2（2025-10-23 发布，权重随后开放）可生成同步的音频与视频，最高 4K、50 fps；LTX-2.5 于 2026 年 8 月推出，是 220 亿参数的开源模型，配有一系列控制 LoRA。
works.idea_en: Open, version-pinnable audio-video generation at production resolution, with LoRA hooks for custom control.
works.idea_zh: 可锁定版本、达到生产级分辨率的开源音视频生成，并提供用于定制控制的 LoRA 接口。
works.method: Asymmetric dual-stream transformer that generates audio and video jointly through cross-modal attention (per the LTX-2 paper).
works.method_zh: 非对称双流 Transformer，通过跨模态注意力联合生成音频与视频（据 LTX-2 论文）。
works.specs: up to 4K · up to 50 fps · up to 20 s · synchronized audio

paper.title: LTX-2: Efficient Joint Audio-Visual Foundation Model

works.title: Seed3D 1.0
works.description: ByteDance Seed's image-to-3D foundation model aimed at simulation: it produces assets with accurate geometry, aligned textures and PBR materials that can be dropped into physics engines for robot manipulation training, and assembled into complete scenes.
works.description_zh: 字节跳动 Seed 面向仿真的图生三维基础模型：生成几何准确、贴图对齐并带 PBR 材质的资产，可直接放入物理引擎用于机器人操作训练，也能组装成完整场景。
works.idea_en: Frames generated assets as training environments rather than art: the test is whether an agent can interact with them in a physics simulator.
works.idea_zh: 把生成资产当作训练环境而不是美术素材：检验标准是智能体能否在物理仿真器中与之交互。
works.method: Diffusion-transformer geometry generation followed by multi-view texture and PBR material synthesis; individual objects are assembled into scenes for simulation.
works.method_zh: 先用扩散 Transformer 生成几何，再进行多视角贴图与 PBR 材质合成；单个物体再被组装成用于仿真的场景。

paper.title: Seed3D 1.0: From Images to High-Fidelity Simulation-Ready 3D Assets

works.title: CLiVR: Conversational Learning System in Virtual Reality with AI-Powered Patients
works.description: Meta Quest 3 system in which medical trainees hold spoken conversations with LLM-driven virtual patients; each case is generated from a syndrome-symptom database, and sentiment analysis gives feedback on the trainee's tone. Thirteen medical-school faculty rated it usable and realistic.
works.description_zh: 基于 Meta Quest 3 的系统，医学受训者可与由大语言模型驱动的虚拟病人进行语音对话；每个病例都从“综合征—症状”数据库动态生成，情感分析对受训者的语气给出反馈。13 位医学院教师评价其易用且逼真。
works.idea_en: Sampling cases from a structured database gives LLM patients variety with a handle on what varies, a practical answer to the control problem.
works.idea_zh: 从结构化数据库中抽样病例，让大语言模型病人既有多样性，又能把握“变的是什么”——这是对可控性问题的一个务实回答。
works.method: Unity application combining speech processing, an LLM conditioned on a generated case and 3D avatars; expert user study (n=13) on usability, realism and educational value.
works.method_zh: Unity 应用，结合语音处理、以生成病例为条件的大语言模型与三维化身；以专家用户研究（n=13）评估易用性、真实感与教学价值。

paper.title: CLiVR: Conversational Learning System in Virtual Reality with AI-Powered Patients

works.title_zh: CLiVR：配有 AI 病人的虚拟现实对话式学习系统

works.title: Real-time AI video restyling an XR room
works.description: A room seen in XR is repainted by a live video model, first as a 'modern, Ikea style room', then as an 'industrial loft', with updates synced slowly to avoid dizziness.
works.description_zh: 在 XR 中看到的房间被实时视频模型重绘，先是“现代宜家风格”，再变成“工业风阁楼”；为避免眩晕，画面更新被刻意放慢同步。
works.idea_en: Shows a comfort constraint of restyling live: the generated view must change slowly enough not to fight the wearer's motion.
works.idea_zh: 揭示实时重绘的一条舒适性约束：生成画面的变化必须足够缓慢，才不会与佩戴者的运动冲突。
works.method: Rendered XR views are passed through a real-time video-to-video model and the restyled result is blended back into the scene at a reduced update rate.
works.method_zh: 把渲染出的 XR 画面送入实时视频到视频模型，再以较低的更新频率把重绘结果混合回场景。
works.title_zh: 用实时 AI 视频重绘 XR 房间

works.title: Samsung Galaxy XR
works.description: The first Android XR headset, made by Samsung with Google and Qualcomm and launched on 2025-10-21 at $1,799.99. It ships Gemini as a multimodal assistant that sees what the wearer sees, Media Auto-Spatialization that turns 2D photos and videos into 3D, and immersive Google Maps.
works.description_zh: 首款 Android XR 头显，由三星与 Google、高通合作打造，2025-10-21 上市，售价 1,799.99 美元。它内置能看到佩戴者所见画面的多模态助手 Gemini、把二维照片和视频转成三维的媒体自动空间化功能，以及沉浸式 Google 地图。
works.idea_en: The first mass-market headset whose operating system generates spatial content from flat media by default.
works.idea_zh: 首款由操作系统默认把平面媒体生成为空间内容的大众市场头显。
works.method: Snapdragon XR2+ Gen 2 with micro-OLED displays, eye and hand tracking, and an external battery pack.
works.method_zh: 骁龙 XR2+ Gen 2，配 micro-OLED 显示屏、眼动与手势追踪，以及外置电池。
works.specs: Snapdragon XR2+ Gen 2 · micro-OLED, 3,552×3,840 per eye · $1,799.99 · launched 2025-10-21 (US, Korea)

works.title: FlashWorld
works.description: An open model that produces a 3D Gaussian-splat scene from a single image or a text prompt in about 5–10 seconds on one GPU, with a browser demo for viewing the result.
works.description_zh: 开源模型：在单张 GPU 上约 5–10 秒即可由一张图像或一句文字生成三维高斯泼溅场景，并提供网页演示查看结果。
works.idea_en: When a world takes seconds instead of minutes, scenes can be regenerated between trials or sampled in large numbers for a study.
works.idea_zh: 当生成一个世界只需几秒而不是几分钟，就可以在两次试验之间重新生成场景，或为研究批量采样。
works.method: A multi-view diffusion model built on a video-diffusion prior is pre-trained in two modes (multi-view images and direct 3D Gaussians) and then distilled so that the fast 3D-oriented mode matches the visual quality of the multi-view mode.
works.method_zh: 基于视频扩散先验的多视角扩散模型先在“多视角图像”和“直接输出三维高斯”两种模式下预训练，再通过跨模式蒸馏，让快速的三维输出模式达到多视角模式的画质。
works.specs: 5–10 s per scene on one GPU · authors report 10–100× faster than prior work

paper.title: FlashWorld: High-quality 3D Scene Generation within Seconds

works.title: RTFM
works.description: A 'Real-Time Frame Model' research preview that renders a world generated from a single image as you move through it in the browser, with reflections, gloss and shadows; World Labs reports it runs on one H100 and that the world 'will never be forgotten'.
works.description_zh: “实时帧模型”的研究预览：在浏览器中边走边渲染由单张图像生成的世界，包含反射、光泽与阴影；World Labs 称它只需一张 H100，且世界“永远不会被遗忘”。
works.idea_en: Treats a learned model as a renderer with spatial memory, a route to persistent worlds without building explicit 3D.
works.idea_zh: 把学习得到的模型当作带空间记忆的渲染器，是一条无需构建显式三维也能获得持久世界的路线。
works.method: An end-to-end autoregressive diffusion transformer over frames whose stored frames carry 3D poses; it retrieves nearby frames as context ('context juggling') to keep the world consistent.
works.method_zh: 端到端的逐帧自回归扩散 Transformer，存储的每一帧都带有三维位姿；通过调取附近帧作为上下文（“上下文轮换”）保持世界一致。

works.title: Apple Vision Pro (M5)
works.description: Apple's mixed-reality headset, upgraded on 2025-10-15 with the M5 chip, refresh rates up to 120 Hz and the Dual Knit Band, at $3,499. For generated content it ships visionOS 26 Spatial Scenes (generative depth that makes a 2D photo explorable), Personas for video calls, 180° / 360° and wide-FOV video playback, and Apple Immersive video.
works.description_zh: Apple 的混合现实头显，2025-10-15 升级为 M5 芯片，刷新率最高 120 Hz，配 Dual Knit 头带，售价 3,499 美元。在生成内容方面，它搭载 visionOS 26 的空间场景（用生成式深度让二维照片可被探索）、用于视频通话的 Persona、180° / 360° 与广角视频播放，以及 Apple Immersive 视频。
works.idea_en: The highest-fidelity mainstream display for generated scenes and video, with eye and hand tracking built in, at a price that limits lab fleets.
works.idea_zh: 展示生成场景与视频保真度最高的主流设备，内置眼动与手势追踪，但价格限制了实验室的采购数量。
works.method: Dual micro-OLED displays (23 million pixels in total) driven by M5 together with the R1 sensor chip, with eye, hand and room tracking.
works.method_zh: 双 micro-OLED 显示屏（共 2,300 万像素），由 M5 与 R1 传感芯片驱动，支持眼动、手势与空间追踪。
works.specs: M5 + R1 · micro-OLED, 23M pixels total · up to 120 Hz · $3,499 · on sale 2025-10-22

works.title: Krea Realtime 14B
