works.description_zh: StreamDiffusion（2023-12-19）可用 Stable Diffusion 实时重绘摄像头或屏幕画面，在单张 RTX 4090 上最高约 90 fps，成为许多 TouchDesigner 与现场表演装置的引擎；StreamDiffusionV2（2025 年 11 月）把它扩展到视频扩散模型。
works.idea_en: Per-frame diffusion on a live camera feed was the first practical way to change what a person sees as it happens.
works.idea_zh: 对实时摄像头画面逐帧扩散，是第一个能在当下改变人所见画面的实用方案。
works.method: Pipeline-level optimizations (stream batching of denoising steps, residual classifier-free guidance, a stochastic similarity filter) around few-step models such as SD-Turbo and LCM.
works.method_zh: 围绕 SD-Turbo、LCM 等少步模型的流水线级优化：去噪步的流式批处理、残差无分类器引导、随机相似度过滤。
works.specs: up to 91 fps img2img on RTX 4090 (reported)

paper.title: StreamDiffusion: A Pipeline-level Solution for Real-time Interactive Generation

works.title: pixelSplat
works.description: pixelSplat predicts a 3D Gaussian scene from just two photos in one network pass, with no per-scene optimisation, and renders new views between them.
works.description_zh: pixelSplat 只用两张照片、一次网络前向就预测出三维高斯场景，无需逐场景优化，并能渲染两者之间的新视角。
works.idea_en: An early sign that splat scenes could come out of a network instead of a training run.
works.idea_zh: 早期迹象之一：泼溅场景可以直接由网络输出，而不必经过一次训练。
works.method: An epipolar transformer encodes the image pair, and per-pixel depth distributions are sampled differentiably to place Gaussians.
works.method_zh: 对极 Transformer 编码图像对，并对逐像素的深度分布进行可微采样来放置高斯。

paper.title: pixelSplat: 3D Gaussian Splats from Image Pairs for Scalable Generalizable 3D Reconstruction

works.title: Holodeck
works.description: From a prompt such as 'a 1b1b apartment of a researcher who has a cat', Holodeck builds a complete interactive multi-room environment in AI2-THOR, with floor plan, materials, doors, windows and furnished objects that embodied agents can navigate.
works.description_zh: 输入“一位养猫研究者的一室一厅公寓”这样的提示，Holodeck 就会在 AI2-THOR 中搭建完整的、可交互的多房间环境，包括平面图、材质、门窗和摆放好的家具，具身智能体可以在其中导航。
works.idea_en: The language model writes the scene as constraints, so every generated room is an inspectable specification that can be logged, varied and rebuilt.
works.idea_zh: 语言模型把场景写成约束，因此每个生成的房间都是一份可检查的规格说明，可以记录、变化和重建。
works.method: GPT-4 proposes floor plans, materials and object lists with spatial-relation constraints; assets are retrieved from Objaverse and a constraint solver optimises the layout before the scene is loaded into the AI2-THOR simulator.
works.method_zh: GPT-4 提出平面图、材质和带空间关系约束的物体清单；从 Objaverse 检索资产，再由约束求解器优化布局，最后载入 AI2-THOR 模拟器。

paper.title: Holodeck: Language Guided Generation of 3D Embodied AI Environments

works.title: SMERF
works.description: SMERF streams house-sized radiance fields into a web browser and renders them in real time on laptops and phones, with quality close to the slow Zip-NeRF it is distilled from.
works.description_zh: SMERF 把房屋大小的辐射场流式加载到网页浏览器，在笔记本和手机上实时渲染，质量接近其所蒸馏自的、较慢的 Zip-NeRF。
works.idea_en: Shows that a large captured place can be explored in a browser tab without a dedicated GPU.
works.idea_zh: 说明一个大型捕捉场景无需专用 GPU，也能在浏览器标签页中被探索。
works.method: The scene is tiled into independent MERF submodels loaded by camera position, trained by distillation from a Zip-NeRF teacher.
works.method_zh: 场景被划分为按相机位置加载的独立 MERF 子模型，通过从 Zip-NeRF 教师模型蒸馏得到。

paper.title: SMERF: Streamable Memory Efficient Radiance Fields for Real-Time Large-Scene Exploration

works.title: SayMotion
works.description: DeepMotion's text-to-3D-animation tool: describe an action in words and get a 3D character animation that can be refined, looped or combined with motion captured from ordinary video, then exported to common 3D formats.
works.description_zh: DeepMotion 的文生三维动画工具：用文字描述动作即可得到三维角色动画，可继续细化、循环，或与从普通视频中捕捉的动作组合，再导出为常见三维格式。
works.idea_en: An early commercial example of animators typing motions instead of capturing them, useful for quickly blocking out what generated characters do.
works.idea_zh: 较早的商业实例：动画师用打字代替动作捕捉，适合快速为生成角色排出动作草稿。
works.method: Proprietary text-to-motion generation, likely combined with DeepMotion's markerless video motion capture (Animate 3D).
works.method_zh: 专有的文生动作模型，很可能结合了 DeepMotion 的无标记视频动作捕捉（Animate 3D）。

works.title: Concordia
works.description: An open-source Python library for generative agent-based models: researchers write characters and a scenario, and a 'Game Master' agent narrates what happens when the characters act, much like a tabletop role-playing game.
works.description_zh: 一个开源的 Python 生成式智能体建模库：研究者编写角色与情境，再由一个“游戏主持人”（Game Master）智能体叙述角色行动的后果，类似桌面角色扮演游戏。
works.idea_en: Separates who acts from what the world says happened, which gives social scientists one place to set, log and audit the rules of a simulated situation.
works.idea_zh: 把“谁在行动”与“世界判定发生了什么”分开，让社会科学研究者能在一个地方设定、记录和审查模拟情境的规则。
works.method: Agents are built from composable LLM components (memory, observation, plans, identity); the Game Master resolves free-text actions into events grounded in physical, social or digital state; v2.0 restructured the components, and the NeurIPS 2024 Concordia Contest used it for cooperation research.
works.method_zh: 智能体由可组合的 LLM 组件（记忆、观察、计划、身份）构成；游戏主持人把自由文本行动裁定为基于物理、社会或数字状态的事件；2.0 版重构了组件体系，NeurIPS 2024 的 Concordia Contest 用它研究合作行为。

paper.title: Generative agent-based modeling with actions grounded in physical, social, or digital space using Concordia

works.title: Relightable Gaussian Codec Avatars
works.description: Relightable Gaussian Codec Avatars render a drivable 3D head with individual hair strands, skin pores and eye reflections under any lighting, in real time, so the avatar fits the light of the scene it is placed in.
works.description_zh: 可重光照高斯 Codec Avatars 能在任意光照下实时渲染可驱动的三维头部，包括单根发丝、皮肤毛孔和眼睛反光，使化身与所处场景的光照一致。
works.idea_en: Lighting consistency is part of believability: a face that ignores the room's light reads as pasted in.
works.idea_zh: 光照一致是可信度的一部分：无视房间光线的脸看起来就像贴上去的。
works.method: 3D Gaussians attached to a deformable head model with learnable radiance transfer (diffuse spherical-harmonics and spherical-Gaussian specular), plus an explicit eye model, trained on light-stage multi-view capture.
works.method_zh: 把三维高斯附着在可变形头部模型上，学习辐射传输（漫反射球谐与球面高斯镜面反射），再加上显式的眼睛模型，在光场舞台多视角采集数据上训练。

paper.title: Relightable Gaussian Codec Avatars

works.title_zh: 可重光照高斯 Codec Avatars

works.title: WonderJourney
works.description: Starting from any image or text, WonderJourney generates a long sequence of connected 3D scenes, flying from a painting into a mountain range or a poem's landscape, rendered as a continuous camera journey.
works.description_zh: WonderJourney 从任意一张图像或一段文字出发，生成一长串彼此相连的三维场景，例如从一幅画飞入群山或诗中的风景，并渲染成一段连续的镜头旅程。
works.idea_en: Letting a language model write 'what comes next' turns scene generation into open-ended travel, but each step is only a short, view-dependent 3D patch.
works.idea_zh: 让语言模型来写“接下来是什么”，场景生成就变成了无尽的旅行；不过每一步都只是一小块依赖视角的三维片段。
works.method: An LLM proposes the next scene description, a text-to-image model with depth estimation builds a point-cloud scene, and a vision-language model checks the result before the camera moves on.
works.method_zh: 语言模型提出下一个场景的描述，文生图模型配合深度估计构建点云场景，再由视觉语言模型检查结果，镜头才继续前进。

paper.title: WonderJourney: Going from Anywhere to Everywhere

works.title: GaussianAvatars
works.description: GaussianAvatars builds a photoreal 3D head from multi-view video by binding 3D Gaussians to a FLAME face mesh, so the head can be re-animated with new expressions and poses and rendered in real time from any viewpoint.
works.description_zh: GaussianAvatars 把三维高斯绑定到 FLAME 人脸网格上，从多视角视频中构建照片级三维头部，可用新的表情和姿态重新驱动，并能从任意视角实时渲染。
works.idea_en: Rigging splats to a standard face model made Gaussian avatars drivable by the same parameters games and trackers already use.
works.idea_zh: 把高斯绑定到标准人脸模型上，让高斯化身可以用游戏和追踪器已在使用的参数来驱动。
works.method: 3D Gaussians parented to FLAME mesh triangles, moving with them, with binding inheritance during densification, optimized jointly with FLAME parameters on multi-view video.
works.method_zh: 三维高斯挂接在 FLAME 网格三角形上并随之运动，致密化时继承绑定关系，在多视角视频上与 FLAME 参数联合优化。

paper.title: GaussianAvatars: Photorealistic Head Avatars with Rigged 3D Gaussians

works.title_zh: GaussianAvatars：绑定三维高斯的照片级头部化身

works.title: LiveKit Agents
works.description: An open-source framework for real-time voice, video and physical-AI agents that join LiveKit WebRTC rooms as participants. It wires speech-to-text, LLM and text-to-speech (or speech-to-speech) models and avatar providers into one session, with turn detection, interruption handling, telephony and evaluation tools; 1.0 shipped on 2025-04-10 and 1.8.8 on 2026-10-15, and LiveKit Cloud hosts deployments.
works.description_zh: 开源的实时语音、视频与物理 AI 智能体框架，智能体以参与者身份加入 LiveKit WebRTC 房间。它把语音识别、大语言模型、语音合成（或语音到语音模型）以及虚拟人服务串进同一会话，并提供话轮检测、打断处理、电话接入与评测工具；1.0 版于 2025-04-10 发布，1.8.8 版于 2026-10-15 发布，LiveKit Cloud 负责托管部署。
works.idea_en: The plumbing that lets a researcher swap the voice, model or avatar of a virtual human while keeping the same room, logging and timing behavior.
works.idea_zh: 这套底层管线让研究者可以更换虚拟人的声音、模型或形象，同时保持同样的房间、日志与时序行为。
works.method: Python and Node.js workers connect to a LiveKit media server over WebRTC; a pipeline of plugins (STT, LLM, TTS, VAD and a transformer turn-detection model) or a realtime model handles each conversation.
works.method_zh: Python 与 Node.js 工作进程通过 WebRTC 连接 LiveKit 媒体服务器；每段对话由插件流水线（语音识别、大语言模型、语音合成、语音活动检测与 Transformer 话轮检测模型）或实时模型处理。

works.title: MoMask
works.description: Text-to-motion model that represents motion as hierarchical residual tokens and generates them with masked transformers, reaching higher fidelity on HumanML3D than diffusion baselines and supporting temporal inpainting.
works.description_zh: 把动作表示为分层残差词元、并用掩码 Transformer 生成的文生动作模型，在 HumanML3D 上的保真度高于扩散基线，并支持时间维度上的补全。
works.idea_en: Discrete, masked generation gave a large jump in motion quality and remains a strong open baseline for text-driven bodies.
works.idea_zh: 离散的掩码生成让动作质量大幅提升，至今仍是文字驱动身体的强力开源基线。
works.method: A residual VQ-VAE quantizes motion into a base layer and residual layers; a masked transformer predicts base tokens from text and a residual transformer fills the finer layers.
works.method_zh: 残差 VQ-VAE 把动作量化为基础层和若干残差层；掩码 Transformer 由文字预测基础层词元，残差 Transformer 补全更细的层。

paper.title: MoMask: Generative Masked Modeling of 3D Human Motions

works.title: VBench
works.description: A benchmark suite that scores text-to-video models on 16 dimensions such as subject consistency, motion smoothness, temporal flickering, dynamic degree and spatial relationship, each with its own prompt set and automatic evaluator checked against human preference. Its public leaderboard is cited by many video-model releases, and VBench++ (2024) adds image-to-video and trustworthiness tests.
works.description_zh: 一套视频生成评测基准，从主体一致性、运动平滑度、时间闪烁、动态程度、空间关系等 16 个维度为文生视频模型打分，每个维度都有专门的提示集与自动评估器，并以人类偏好标注加以校验。许多视频模型发布时都会引用它的公开排行榜；VBench++（2024）又加入了图生视频与可信度测试。
works.idea_en: Breaks 'video quality' into separately measurable dimensions, though high temporal-smoothness scores can reward videos that barely move.
works.idea_zh: 把“视频质量”拆成可以分别测量的维度；不过时间平滑度得分高，也可能是在奖励几乎不动的视频。
works.method: Per-dimension prompt suites scored by automatic metrics built on pretrained vision models (feature similarity, optical flow, detectors, aesthetic predictors), validated with human preference annotations per dimension.
works.method_zh: 按维度设计的提示集，由基于预训练视觉模型的自动指标打分（特征相似度、光流、检测器、美学预测器），并用逐维度的人类偏好标注加以验证。

paper.title: VBench: Comprehensive Benchmark Suite for Video Generative Models

works.title: Pika 1.0
works.description: Pika 1.0 (2023-11-28) turned the Discord-born Pika bot into a web 'idea-to-video' platform with text-to-video, image animation and in-video edits such as region modification and canvas expansion.
works.description_zh: Pika 1.0（2023-11-28）把起家于 Discord 的 Pika 机器人变成网页上的“想法生成视频”平台，提供文生视频、让图片动起来，以及局部修改、画面扩展等视频内编辑。
works.idea_en: An early sign that playful editing features, not raw quality, drive mass adoption of generative video.
works.idea_zh: 较早表明推动生成视频大众化的是好玩的编辑功能，而不只是画质。
works.method: Proprietary video diffusion model; later Pika 2.x versions added effects such as Pikaffects and scene ingredients.
works.method_zh: 自研视频扩散模型；后续 Pika 2.x 加入了 Pikaffects 特效和场景素材组合等功能。

works.title: Mip-Splatting
works.description: Mip-Splatting removes the shimmering and thin-line artefacts that appear when a Gaussian splat scene is zoomed in or out relative to how it was captured.
works.description_zh: Mip-Splatting 消除了高斯泼溅场景在放大或缩小（相对于拍摄尺度）时出现的闪烁与细线伪影。
works.idea_en: Matters for headsets, where people lean in and step back far more than a capture camera did.
works.idea_zh: 对头显很重要，因为人在头显里靠近和后退的幅度远大于拍摄相机。
works.method: A 3D smoothing filter bounds Gaussian size by the sampling rate of the training views, and a 2D Mip filter replaces screen-space dilation.
works.method_zh: 三维平滑滤波器依据训练视角的采样率限制高斯尺寸，二维 Mip 滤波器替代屏幕空间膨胀。

paper.title: Mip-Splatting: Alias-free 3D Gaussian Splatting

works.title: LucidDreamer
works.description: Generates a whole 3D Gaussian-splat scene, not a single object, from a text prompt or an image, in any style, by repeatedly imagining new views and stitching them into one point cloud.
works.description_zh: 根据一句文字或一张图像生成整片三维高斯泼溅场景（而不只是一个物体），风格不限：方法是反复想象新视角，再把它们拼进同一个点云。
works.idea_en: Inpainting plus depth was enough to grow a coherent splat scene from one prompt, the recipe many later world generators refined.
works.idea_zh: 图像补全加深度估计就足以从一句提示词“长出”连贯的泼溅场景，后来许多世界生成器都在完善这套做法。
works.method: 'Dreaming' alternates Stable Diffusion inpainting of a moved camera view with monocular depth lifting into a shared point cloud; 'alignment' merges the points, which initialise a 3D Gaussian splatting optimisation.
works.method_zh: “做梦”阶段交替进行：用 Stable Diffusion 补全移动后的视角，再用单目深度把它提升进共享点云；“对齐”阶段合并点云，并以此初始化三维高斯泼溅的优化。

paper.title: LucidDreamer: Domain-free Generation of 3D Gaussian Splatting Scenes

works.title: Stable Video Diffusion
works.description: Stable Video Diffusion (2023-11-21) was the first widely used open-weight image-to-video model, turning a still image into 14- or 25-frame clips; it also served as the base for multi-view 3D generators.
works.description_zh: Stable Video Diffusion（2023-11-21）是首个被广泛使用的开源图生视频模型，可把一张静态图变成 14 或 25 帧短片，也被用作多视角三维生成的基础模型。
works.idea_en: Gave researchers a video prior they could fine-tune; many later 3D and 4D generators start from SVD weights.
works.idea_zh: 为研究者提供了可微调的视频先验，后来许多三维、四维生成方法都从 SVD 权重起步。
works.method: Latent video diffusion with temporal layers added to Stable Diffusion 2.1, trained in three stages: image pretraining, curated video pretraining and high-quality fine-tuning.
works.method_zh: 在 Stable Diffusion 2.1 上加入时间层的潜空间视频扩散模型，分三阶段训练：图像预训练、精选视频预训练和高质量微调。

paper.title: Stable Video Diffusion: Scaling Latent Video Diffusion Models to Large Datasets

works.title: LRM: Large Reconstruction Model
works.description: A 500-million-parameter transformer that predicts a triplane NeRF of an object from one image in about five seconds, trained on roughly one million objects from Objaverse and MVImgNet.
works.description_zh: 一个 5 亿参数的 Transformer，约 5 秒即可从单张图像预测物体的三平面 NeRF，训练数据为来自 Objaverse 和 MVImgNet 的约一百万个物体。
works.idea_en: Replaced per-object optimization with a single feed-forward pass, moving image-to-3D from hours to seconds; TripoSR, InstantMesh and most production pipelines follow this template.
works.idea_zh: 用一次前馈推理取代逐物体优化，把图生三维从数小时缩短到数秒；TripoSR、InstantMesh 和多数生产流程都沿用了这一模板。
works.method: Learnable triplane tokens cross-attend to DINO image features in an image-to-triplane transformer decoder, trained end to end with rendering losses on multi-view data.
works.method_zh: 在图像到三平面的 Transformer 解码器中，可学习的三平面词元对 DINO 图像特征做交叉注意力，并用多视角数据上的渲染损失端到端训练。
works.specs: 500M parameters · ~5 s per object · ~1M training objects

paper.title: LRM: Large Reconstruction Model for Single Image to 3D

works.title_zh: LRM：大型重建模型

works.title: Sounding Bodies
works.description: Renders the full 3D sound field produced by a human body (speech, footsteps, claps, finger snaps) from headset microphone audio and tracked body pose, so a virtual person sounds right from any listening position. Developed with Meta Reality Labs Research.
works.description_zh: 根据头显麦克风音频和被追踪的身体姿态，渲染人体发出的完整三维声场（说话、脚步、拍手、打响指），让虚拟人从任何听音位置听起来都正确。与 Meta Reality Labs Research 合作完成。
works.idea_en: Spatially correct body sound is what makes a co-present avatar sound co-present; this model ties it to tracked pose.
works.idea_zh: 空间上正确的身体声音，才让“同在”的虚拟化身听起来真的同在；这个模型把它与被追踪的姿态联系起来。
works.method: Neural network that maps head-mounted microphone signals and 3D body pose to the sound field around the body, trained on multi-view captures recorded with a large spherical microphone array.
works.method_zh: 神经网络把头戴麦克风信号与三维身体姿态映射为身体周围的声场，训练数据来自大型球形麦克风阵列录制的多视角采集。

paper.title: Sounding Bodies: Modeling 3D Spatial Sound of Humans Using Body Pose and Audio

works.title_zh: Sounding Bodies：由身体姿态与音频建模人体三维空间声音

works.title: SuperSplat
works.description: SuperSplat is PlayCanvas's free, open-source browser editor for Gaussian splats, plus a hosting site, for cleaning, cropping, combining and publishing splat scenes; version 3.0 (September 2026) was rebuilt on WebGPU.
works.description_zh: SuperSplat 是 PlayCanvas 推出的免费开源浏览器高斯泼溅编辑器及托管网站，用于清理、裁剪、合并和发布泼溅场景；3.0 版（2026 年 9 月）基于 WebGPU 重建。
works.idea_en: The common place where captured splats are cleaned and shared, which makes it part of most capture pipelines.
works.idea_zh: 捕捉得到的泼溅通常在这里被清理与分享，因此它是大多数捕捉流程的一部分。
works.method: A web app on the PlayCanvas engine edits PLY/SOG splats with selection tools and exports compressed formats for viewers and engines.
works.method_zh: 基于 PlayCanvas 引擎的网页应用，用选择工具编辑 PLY/SOG 泼溅，并导出供查看器与引擎使用的压缩格式。

works.title: UniSim
works.description: A 'universal simulator' that predicts what a camera would see after a person or robot carries out an action described in text, such as 'cut the carrot' or 'open the drawer', so that planners and RL policies can be trained in simulation and then deployed on real robots.
works.description_zh: 一个“通用模拟器”：预测一个人或机器人执行文字描述的动作（如“切胡萝卜”“打开抽屉”）之后，摄像头会看到什么，从而让规划器和强化学习策略先在模拟中训练，再部署到真实机器人上。
works.idea_en: Reframes video generation as a simulator of real-world interaction, the conceptual step from 'video model' to 'world model'.
works.idea_zh: 把视频生成重新定义为真实世界交互的模拟器，这是从“视频模型”迈向“世界模型”的概念性一步。
works.method: A video diffusion model conditioned on past frames and text or low-level actions, trained on an orchestrated mix of image, video, robot and navigation datasets; it is rolled out autoregressively for long-horizon interaction.
works.method_zh: 以历史帧及文字或底层动作为条件的视频扩散模型，在精心组合的图像、视频、机器人与导航数据上训练，并通过自回归推演实现长时交互。

paper.title: Learning Interactive Real-World Simulators

works.title_zh: UniSim：可交互的真实世界模拟器

works.title: DreamSpace
works.description: Type a style such as 'Van Gogh' or 'cyberpunk' and a scanned room is re-textured end to end, with coherent textures across walls, floor and furniture that you can walk through in a VR headset.
works.description_zh: 输入“梵高”或“赛博朋克”等风格，扫描好的房间就会被整体重新贴图，墙面、地板与家具的纹理彼此连贯，戴上 VR 头显即可走进其中。
works.idea_en: Restyles a real room's geometry instead of replacing it, so the generated world keeps the layout your body already knows.
works.idea_zh: 重绘的是真实房间的外观而不是替换其几何，生成的世界保留了身体早已熟悉的布局。
works.method: A stylized 360-degree panorama is generated from the room's centre with coarse-to-fine diffusion and dual texture alignment, then propagated to the rest of the mesh by inpainting and an implicit imitation network for occluded parts.
works.method_zh: 先从房间中心用由粗到细的扩散模型和双重纹理对齐生成风格化 360° 全景纹理，再通过图像修补和隐式模仿网络，把纹理传播到网格其余部分及被遮挡区域。

paper.title: DreamSpace: Dreaming Your Room Space with Text-Driven Panoramic Texture Propagation

works.title: 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS)
works.description: 4D Gaussian Splatting represents a moving scene as one set of 3D Gaussians plus a learned deformation field, so recorded dynamic scenes play back from free viewpoints in real time.
works.description_zh: 4D 高斯泼溅把运动场景表示为一组三维高斯加上一个学习得到的形变场，使录制的动态场景能以自由视角实时回放。
works.idea_en: The reference point for treating recorded events, not just places, as something a viewer can walk around.
works.idea_zh: 把录下来的事件（而不仅是地点）当作观众可以绕着走的东西，这项工作是参照点。
works.method: A HexPlane spatio-temporal encoder feeds a small MLP that predicts per-Gaussian position, rotation and scale offsets at each timestamp.
works.method_zh: HexPlane 时空编码器为一个小型多层感知机提供特征，预测每个时间戳下每个高斯的位置、旋转与尺度偏移。
works.specs: 82 fps at 800×800 on RTX 3090 (paper, synthetic scenes)

paper.title: 4D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Dynamic Scene Rendering

works.title_zh: 4D 高斯泼溅（4DGS）

works.title: Animate Anything
works.description: Anything World's service that automatically rigs and animates uploaded 3D models, including animals, vehicles and other non-humanoid shapes, and returns engine-ready animated assets.
works.description_zh: Anything World 的服务：自动为上传的三维模型（包括动物、交通工具和其他非人形物体）绑定并制作动画，返回可直接用于引擎的动画资产。
works.idea_en: Extends auto-rigging beyond humanoids, so the animals and machines of a scene can move as well.
works.idea_zh: 把自动绑定扩展到人形之外，让场景中的动物和机械也能动起来。
works.method: Proprietary; the system likely classifies the model's category, places a category-specific skeleton, computes skinning and applies a matching animation set.
works.method_zh: 专有系统；很可能先识别模型类别，再放置对应类别的骨架、计算蒙皮，并套用相应的动画集。
works.title_zh: Animate Anything（万物动画）

works.title: DreamGaussian
works.description: Generates a textured mesh from one image (or a text prompt) in about two minutes by optimizing 3D Gaussians with score distillation, then extracting a mesh and refining its UV texture.
works.description_zh: 通过分数蒸馏优化三维高斯，再提取网格并细化 UV 贴图，约两分钟即可由一张图像（或一句文字提示）生成带贴图的网格。
works.idea_en: Brought Gaussian splatting into generation and cut optimization-based image/text-to-3D from hours to minutes, a step toward explicit 3D representations in asset models.
works.idea_zh: 把高斯泼溅引入生成任务，将基于优化的图生 / 文生三维从数小时缩短到几分钟，是资产模型走向显式三维表示的一步。
works.method: Progressive densification of 3D Gaussians under SDS guidance (Zero-1-to-3 for images, Stable Diffusion for text), followed by mesh extraction and texture refinement in UV space.
works.method_zh: 在 SDS 指导下（图像用 Zero-1-to-3，文字用 Stable Diffusion）逐步加密三维高斯，随后提取网格并在 UV 空间细化贴图。

paper.title: DreamGaussian: Generative Gaussian Splatting for Efficient 3D Content Creation

works.title: Polycam Gaussian Splatting
works.description: Polycam, a widely used phone and web 3D scanning app, added Gaussian splat processing so uploaded photos or video become splat scenes viewable at high frame rates in a browser.
works.description_zh: Polycam 是一款广泛使用的手机与网页三维扫描应用，加入了高斯泼溅处理，上传的照片或视频会变成可在浏览器中高帧率观看的泼溅场景。
works.idea_en: Put splat capture in the same app people already used for photogrammetry and LiDAR scans.
works.idea_zh: 把泼溅捕捉放进人们已经在用的摄影测量与 LiDAR 扫描应用里。
works.method: Photos or video are processed in the cloud into 3D Gaussians alongside mesh and point-cloud outputs, with in-browser editing and export.
works.method_zh: 照片或视频在云端处理为三维高斯，同时提供网格与点云输出，支持浏览器内编辑和导出。
works.title_zh: Polycam 高斯泼溅

works.title: LLMR
works.description: Type or say 'make a timer out of a rotating cube' or 'recolor the scene for a color-blind user' and LLMR writes, checks and runs the Unity code that changes the live mixed-reality world.
works.description_zh: 输入或说出“用旋转的立方体做一个计时器”或“为色盲用户重新配色”，LLMR 就会编写、检查并运行 Unity 代码，直接改变正在运行的混合现实世界。
works.idea_en: Makes the behaviour of an immersive world, not just its look, something a person can ask for in plain language.
works.idea_zh: 让沉浸世界的行为（而不只是外观）变成可以用日常语言提出的要求。
works.method: An orchestration of GPT-4 modules for scene understanding, task planning, code building, self-debugging and memory runs inside Unity; the authors report a 4x lower average error rate than plain GPT-4 and a usability study (N=11).
works.method_zh: 在 Unity 中编排多个 GPT-4 模块，分别负责场景理解、任务规划、代码生成、自我调试与记忆；作者报告其平均错误率比直接使用 GPT-4 低 4 倍，并做了可用性研究（N=11）。
works.specs: Unity · 4x lower error rate vs GPT-4 (reported) · N=11

paper.title: LLMR: Real-time Prompting of Interactive Worlds using Large Language Models

works.title: CityDreamer
works.description: Generates unbounded 3D cities, street layouts, buildings and background, that can be flown through with a consistent camera, learned from Google Earth imagery and OpenStreetMap layouts.
works.description_zh: 生成无边界的三维城市——街道布局、建筑与背景——可以用连贯的镜头飞越其中，训练数据为 Google Earth 影像与 OpenStreetMap 布局。
works.idea_en: City scale is where situations like crowds, traffic and getting lost live; CityDreamer shows generated layout and appearance can be separated at that scale.
works.idea_zh: 人群、交通、迷路这类情境都发生在城市尺度；CityDreamer 表明在这个尺度上可以把生成的布局与外观分开控制。
works.method: An unbounded layout generator produces a semantic and height map; separate neural-field generators render buildings (instance-wise) and background, composed with compact bird's-eye-view scene representations.
works.method_zh: 无边界布局生成器先输出语义图与高度图；再由分别负责建筑（逐实例）和背景的神经场生成器渲染，并以紧凑的鸟瞰图场景表示组合起来。

paper.title: CityDreamer: Compositional Generative Model of Unbounded 3D Cities

works.title: AI Town
works.description: A deployable, MIT-licensed town in the browser where LLM characters walk around, start conversations and remember them; a visitor can join as a character and chat with the residents.
works.description_zh: 一个可部署、MIT 许可的浏览器小镇：LLM 角色四处走动、主动搭话并记住对话；访客也可以作为一个角色加入，与居民聊天。
works.idea_en: Turned the generative-agents paper into a template people fork for their own simulated communities and games.
works.idea_zh: 把生成式智能体论文变成一个模板，人们可以复刻它来搭建自己的模拟社群与游戏。
works.method: A TypeScript game loop on the Convex reactive database stores world state, agent memories and embeddings, and calls a hosted or local LLM (OpenAI, Together or Ollama) for conversations and memory summaries.
works.method_zh: 基于 Convex 响应式数据库的 TypeScript 游戏循环保存世界状态、智能体记忆与向量嵌入，并调用托管或本地大语言模型（OpenAI、Together 或 Ollama）生成对话与记忆摘要。

works.title: Tulpamancer
works.description: Visitors answer questions about their lives at an old computer terminal, then put on a VR headset and are led by their 'tulpa' through uniquely generated scenes about their past and possible futures; each work is deleted after viewing.
works.description_zh: 观众先在一台旧电脑终端前回答关于自己人生的问题，再戴上 VR 头显，由自己的“图帕”带领穿过专门生成的场景，回望过去、设想未来；每件作品在观看后即被删除。
works.idea_en: A personal VR journey generated from one person's answers, made once and then discarded.
works.idea_zh: 根据一个人的回答生成的私人 VR 旅程，只做一次，看完即弃。
works.method: A machine-learning pipeline, likely language and image generation, turns each participant's answers into a sequence of virtual scenes and narration before the headset session.
works.method_zh: 机器学习流程（很可能结合语言与图像生成）在佩戴头显之前，把每位参与者的回答变成一系列虚拟场景与旁白。

works.title: Dynamic 3D Gaussians
works.description: Dynamic 3D Gaussians reconstructs multi-camera recordings of people juggling or playing sports as Gaussians that move over time, so every point is tracked through the sequence as it is rendered from new views.
works.description_zh: Dynamic 3D Gaussians 把多相机录制的人物抛接、运动等片段重建为随时间移动的高斯，在从新视角渲染的同时，每个点在整段序列中都被追踪。
works.idea_en: Tracking comes for free with the reconstruction, so captured motion can drive or be compared with other content.
works.idea_zh: 追踪随重建一起得到，因此捕捉到的运动可以用来驱动其他内容或与之比较。
works.method: Gaussians keep fixed colour, size and opacity and only move and rotate per timestep, regularised by local rigidity, rotation-similarity and isometry losses.
works.method_zh: 高斯保持颜色、尺寸与不透明度不变，只在每个时间步移动和旋转，并用局部刚性、旋转相似性与等距约束进行正则。

paper.title: Dynamic 3D Gaussians: Tracking by Persistent Dynamic View Synthesis

works.title_zh: 动态 3D 高斯

works.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting
works.description: 3D Gaussian Splatting represents a captured scene as millions of small coloured, semi-transparent 3D Gaussians that are rasterised rather than ray-marched, giving photoreal novel views at real-time frame rates.
works.description_zh: 3D 高斯泼溅把拍摄的场景表示为数以百万计的彩色半透明三维高斯，用光栅化而不是光线步进来渲染，以实时帧率得到照片级的新视角。
works.idea_en: Made photoreal captured places fast enough for headsets, and its explicit primitives can be edited, streamed, and later animated in time.
works.idea_zh: 让照片级的捕捉场景快到足以在头显中使用，而且它的显式基元可以被编辑、流式传输，之后还能随时间运动。
works.method: Gaussians are initialised from structure-from-motion points and optimised with adaptive densification through a differentiable tile-based rasteriser.
works.method_zh: 高斯从运动恢复结构得到的点云初始化，通过基于图块的可微光栅化器优化，并自适应地增删高斯。
works.specs: ≥30 fps at 1080p · per-scene training in tens of minutes (paper)

paper.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering

works.title_zh: 3D 高斯泼溅

works.title: Virtual Reality for Criminologists: A Road Map
works.description: Essay in Crime and Justice that reviews VR studies in criminogenic contexts and related fields, explains the technology's features, limits and ethical challenges, and argues that VR may become 'the criminological equivalent of the petri dish'.
works.description_zh: 发表于 Crime and Justice 的长文，回顾犯罪相关情境中的 VR 研究及相关领域成果，阐述这项技术的特点、局限与伦理挑战，并认为 VR 可能成为“犯罪学的培养皿”。
works.idea_en: Criminology's case for VR rests on observing behavior in situations that are illegal or unsafe to create, the class of situation generative tools could make cheaper to vary.
works.idea_zh: 犯罪学之所以需要 VR，是因为它能在违法或不安全、无法真实创设的情境中观察行为——而生成工具恰好能让这类情境的变化成本更低。
works.method: Review and research agenda covering ecological validity, theory testing, ethics and practical design choices for VR criminology.
works.method_zh: 综述与研究议程，涵盖 VR 犯罪学的生态效度、理论检验、伦理与实际设计选择。

paper.title: Virtual Reality for Criminologists: A Road Map

works.title_zh: 写给犯罪学家的虚拟现实：一份路线图

works.title: Objaverse-XL
works.description: An open dataset of more than 10 million deduplicated 3D objects (hand-modeled objects, photogrammetry scans and professional scans of historic artifacts) gathered from public sources by the Allen Institute for AI. It is a main pretraining corpus for image-to-3D and multi-view diffusion models; the paper trains Zero123-XL on more than 100 million renders from it.
works.description_zh: 艾伦人工智能研究所从公开来源收集的开放数据集，包含 1,000 多万个去重的三维物体（手工建模物体、摄影测量扫描以及历史文物的专业扫描）。它是图生三维与多视角扩散模型的主要预训练语料之一；论文用其中超过 1 亿张渲染图训练了 Zero123-XL。
works.idea_en: The asset generators that furnish generated worlds learned their sense of objects largely from this corpus, including its biases and uneven licenses.
works.idea_zh: 为生成世界提供道具的资产生成器，对物体的理解很大程度上来自这一语料，也继承了它的偏差与参差不齐的授权。
works.method: Crawling and deduplicating public 3D repositories, with metadata and rendering scripts; licenses vary per object.
works.method_zh: 爬取并去重公开三维资源库，附带元数据与渲染脚本；每个物体的授权各不相同。

paper.title: Objaverse-XL: A Universe of 10M+ 3D Objects

works.title: MVDiffusion
works.description: Generates a seamless 360° panorama from text by producing eight overlapping perspective views at once that agree with each other; the same idea also textures a scanned room mesh consistently.
works.description_zh: 通过一次性生成八张相互重叠且彼此一致的透视视图，根据文字合成无缝的 360° 全景图；同样的思路也能一致地为扫描的房间网格上色。
works.idea_en: Treating a panorama as many views that must agree, rather than one wide image, removes seams and drift at the wrap-around edge.
works.idea_zh: 把全景图视为多个必须彼此一致的视角，而不是一张宽幅图像，从而消除了接缝和首尾相接处的漂移。
works.method: Correspondence-aware attention layers inserted into a pretrained Stable Diffusion model share features between pixel-correspondent locations of the views, which are denoised in parallel.
works.method_zh: 在预训练的 Stable Diffusion 中插入对应关系感知的注意力层，使各视图中像素对应的位置共享特征，所有视图并行去噪。

paper.title: MVDiffusion: Enabling Holistic Multi-view Image Generation with Correspondence-Aware Diffusion

works.title: Volcano Engine Ark / BytePlus ModelArk
works.description: ByteDance's model-as-a-service platform (Volcano Engine Ark in China, BytePlus ModelArk internationally) serves the Doubao language models and the Seedance video models through an API. BytePlus added first- and last-frame control for Seedance 1.0 Pro on ModelArk in 2025 and lists Seedance 2.0 and 2.5 in 2026.
works.description_zh: 字节跳动的模型即服务平台（国内为火山方舟，海外为 BytePlus ModelArk）通过 API 提供豆包大语言模型与 Seedance 视频模型。2025 年 BytePlus 在 ModelArk 上为 Seedance 1.0 Pro 加入首尾帧控制，2026 年又上架 Seedance 2.0 与 2.5。
works.idea_en: The official route to ByteDance's Seedance models, with enterprise terms that matter when a study needs a stable endpoint it can contract for.
works.idea_zh: 调用字节跳动 Seedance 模型的官方途径；当研究需要一个可签约、稳定的接口时，企业级条款很关键。
works.method: Managed inference endpoints with REST APIs, model versions and quotas; video jobs run asynchronously and return hosted MP4 files.
works.method_zh: 托管推理接口，提供 REST API、模型版本与配额管理；视频任务异步执行，返回托管的 MP4 文件。
works.specs: launched 2023-06-28 (China) · Seedance 1.0 Pro first/last-frame control (2025) · Seedance 2.0 / 2.5 (2026)
works.title_zh: 火山方舟 / BytePlus ModelArk

works.title: MotionGPT
works.description: Treats human motion as a foreign language: motion is tokenized and a language model is trained on mixed text and motion tokens, so one model can generate motion from text, caption motion, and predict or in-between motion.
works.description_zh: 把人体动作当作一门外语：先把动作分词，再让语言模型在文字与动作混合的词元上训练，于是一个模型就能由文字生成动作、为动作写描述，以及预测或补间动作。
works.idea_en: Puts body motion into the same token stream as language, the step that lets later conversational agents speak and move from one model.
works.idea_zh: 让身体动作和语言处在同一个词元序列中，后来的对话智能体由此可以用一个模型同时说话和动作。
works.method: A VQ-VAE motion tokenizer plus a T5 language model pre-trained on a motion–language corpus and instruction-tuned on prompt-based motion tasks.
works.method_zh: VQ-VAE 动作分词器，加上在动作—语言语料上预训练、并在基于提示的动作任务上做指令微调的 T5 语言模型。

paper.title: MotionGPT: Human Motion as a Foreign Language

works.title: Infinigen
works.description: An open-source procedural generator that creates unlimited photorealistic natural worlds, terrain, plants, animals, weather, entirely from code in Blender, with exact ground truth for depth, segmentation and geometry. Infinigen Indoors (CVPR 2024) extended it to furnished rooms, followed by articulated simulation-ready assets (2025) and the ProcFunc abstractions (2026).
works.description_zh: 开源的程序化生成器，完全在 Blender 中用代码创造无限多的照片级自然世界——地形、植物、动物和天气，并附带深度、分割和几何的精确真值。Infinigen Indoors（CVPR 2024）把它扩展到布置好的室内房间，随后又加入可铰接、可用于仿真的资产（2025）和 ProcFunc 抽象（2026）。
works.idea_en: Procedural generation gives what learned generators cannot: every parameter of a scene is known, seedable and reproducible.
works.idea_zh: 程序化生成能给出学习式生成器做不到的东西：场景的每个参数都已知、可设种子、可复现。
works.method: Every asset, from geometry to materials, is generated by randomised mathematical rules (no external assets), composed into scenes by constraint-based arrangement and rendered with Blender's path tracer.
works.method_zh: 从几何到材质，每个资产都由随机化的数学规则生成（不依赖外部资产），再通过基于约束的摆放组成场景，并用 Blender 路径追踪渲染。
works.specs: fully procedural · no external assets · ground-truth depth, normals, segmentation

paper.title: Infinite Photorealistic Worlds using Procedural Generation

works.title: MetaHuman Animator
works.description: MetaHuman Animator turns an actor's performance filmed on an iPhone or stereo head-mounted camera into high-fidelity facial animation on any MetaHuman within minutes; later versions add animation from a webcam or from audio alone, and Unreal Engine 5.8 (2026) adds markerless body capture of one actor from a single webcam or phone camera.
works.description_zh: MetaHuman Animator 能在几分钟内把用 iPhone 或立体头戴相机拍摄的演员表演，转换为任意 MetaHuman 上的高保真面部动画；后续版本支持仅用网络摄像头或仅用音频生成动画，Unreal Engine 5.8（2026）又加入了用单个网络摄像头或手机摄像头对单名演员做无标记身体捕捉的功能。
works.idea_en: Performance capture for everyone, the authored-but-recorded route to believable virtual-human behaviour.
works.idea_zh: 人人可用的表演捕捉，一条“人工制作但基于真实录制”的可信虚拟人行为路线。
works.method: A 4D solver fits a person-specific MetaHuman identity from a few frames, then tracks the captured video and depth to transfer the performance onto the standard facial rig.
works.method_zh: 4D 求解器先用少量帧拟合出该演员的 MetaHuman 身份，再追踪采集的视频与深度，把表演迁移到标准面部绑定上。

works.title: Meta Quest 3 / Quest 3S
works.description: Meta's standalone mixed-reality headsets: Quest 3 (announced 2023-06-01, launched 2023-10-10 at $499) and the cheaper Quest 3S (2024-09-25, from $299.99), both on Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 with color passthrough. They are widely used in VR research labs, and Horizon OS gives apps passthrough-camera access for AI and runs Meta's Hyperscape photoreal captures.
works.description_zh: Meta 的一体式混合现实头显：Quest 3（2023-06-01 发布，2023-10-10 上市，售价 499 美元）与更便宜的 Quest 3S（2024-09-25，起价 299.99 美元），均采用骁龙 XR2 Gen 2 与彩色透视。它们在 VR 研究实验室中使用广泛；Horizon OS 允许应用访问透视摄像头以运行 AI，并支持 Meta 的 Hyperscape 照片级场景采集。
works.idea_en: The default delivery device for VR studies: cheap enough to deploy in numbers, with camera access that lets generated content respond to the participant's real room.
works.idea_zh: VR 研究默认的交付设备：价格低到可以批量部署，摄像头访问又能让生成内容回应被试所在的真实房间。
works.method: Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 with inside-out tracking, hand tracking and color passthrough; pancake lenses and a depth sensor on Quest 3, Fresnel lenses on Quest 3S.
works.method_zh: 骁龙 XR2 Gen 2，具备由内向外追踪、手势追踪与彩色透视；Quest 3 采用 pancake 透镜并配有深度传感器，Quest 3S 采用菲涅耳透镜。
works.specs: Quest 3: 2064×2208 per eye, $499 at launch · Quest 3S: 1832×1920 per eye, from $299.99

works.title: NVIDIA ACE for Games: Kairos demo
works.description: In a ray-traced Unreal Engine 5 ramen shop, the player speaks to Jin, the owner, and he answers in voice with lip-synced facial animation, staying within his backstory. Shown in the Computex 2023 keynote.
works.description_zh: 在光线追踪的 Unreal Engine 5 拉面店里，玩家开口与店主 Jin 交谈，他用语音回答并带有口型同步的面部动画，且始终符合自己的背景设定。在 Computex 2023 主题演讲中展示。
works.idea_en: The demo that set the template for voice-in, voice-and-face-out game characters: speech recognition, an LLM with a persona, speech synthesis and audio-driven facial animation in one loop.
works.idea_zh: 确立了“语音输入、语音加面部输出”游戏角色模板的演示：语音识别、带人设的大语言模型、语音合成与音频驱动面部动画串成一个循环。
works.method: Convai's character platform runs on NVIDIA ACE modules: Riva speech recognition and synthesis, a NeMo language model given Jin's backstory with guardrails, and Audio2Face generating facial animation from the synthesized voice.
works.method_zh: Convai 的角色平台基于英伟达 ACE 模块运行：Riva 语音识别与合成、注入 Jin 背景故事并带护栏的 NeMo 语言模型，以及根据合成语音生成面部动画的 Audio2Face。
works.title_zh: NVIDIA ACE 游戏演示：Kairos

works.title: Voyager
works.description: A GPT-4 agent that plays Minecraft without human input: it proposes its own next goals, writes JavaScript to reach them, and saves working code as reusable skills, going from punching trees to mining diamonds.
works.description_zh: 一个无需人工干预、自己玩 Minecraft 的 GPT-4 智能体：它自行提出下一个目标，编写 JavaScript 代码去完成，并把有效代码存为可复用技能，从徒手砍树一路做到挖出钻石。
works.idea_en: An agent that stores what it learns as code can keep growing in an open world, a pattern later NPC and world-agent systems reuse.
works.idea_zh: 把学到的东西存成代码的智能体，能在开放世界里持续成长；后来的 NPC 与世界智能体系统也沿用了这一模式。
works.method: An automatic curriculum, an iterative prompting loop with environment feedback, execution errors and self-verification, and a vector-indexed skill library drive GPT-4 through the Mineflayer API; the authors report 3.3x more unique items and up to 15.3x faster tech-tree progress than prior methods.
works.method_zh: 由自动课程、结合环境反馈与执行报错和自我验证的迭代提示循环，以及向量索引的技能库，通过 Mineflayer API 驱动 GPT-4；作者报告获取的独特物品数为此前方法的 3.3 倍，科技树进度最快提升 15.3 倍。

paper.title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models

works.title: LayoutGPT
works.description: Shows that a text-only language model, prompted with CSS-style examples, can write numeric layouts: bounding boxes for images and object positions and sizes for 3D indoor rooms.
works.description_zh: 表明只懂文字的语言模型，在类似 CSS 的示例提示下，就能写出带数值的布局：为图像给出包围框，为三维室内房间给出物体的位置与尺寸。
works.idea_en: Layout written as text is the most controllable layer of a generated scene: it can be read, edited and diffed before anything is rendered.
works.idea_zh: 以文字写成的布局是生成场景中最可控的一层：在渲染之前就能阅读、编辑和比对。
works.method: In-context learning with retrieved exemplars in a CSS-like format lets GPT-3.5/4 output layouts, which condition a layout-to-image model or place furniture in 3D-FRONT rooms.
works.method_zh: 用检索到的示例，以类似 CSS 的格式进行上下文学习，让 GPT-3.5/4 输出布局，再用于驱动布局到图像的模型，或在 3D-FRONT 房间中摆放家具。

paper.title: LayoutGPT: Compositional Visual Planning and Generation with Large Language Models

works.title: Generative Agents (Smallville)
works.description: Twenty-five LLM-driven characters live in Smallville, a pixel-art town: they wake, work, gossip, form opinions and remember each other. Seeded with one agent's wish to host a Valentine's Day party, the others spread invitations, ask each other on dates and show up at the right time.
works.description_zh: 25 个由大语言模型驱动的角色生活在像素风小镇 Smallville：起床、工作、闲聊、形成看法，并记得彼此。研究者只给一个角色设定“想办情人节派对”的念头，其他角色便自发传播邀请、互相约会，并在约定时间到场。
works.idea_en: Memory, reflection and planning on top of an LLM are enough to make a small society that coordinates over days without a script.
works.idea_zh: 在大语言模型之上加入记忆、反思与计划，就足以让一个小社会在没有脚本的情况下跨越数天彼此协调。
works.method: Each agent keeps a natural-language memory stream; retrieval by recency, importance and relevance feeds GPT-3.5 prompts that write reflections and hierarchical day plans, which a sandbox game engine turns into movement and dialogue; believability was rated by human evaluators against ablations.
works.method_zh: 每个智能体保存一条自然语言记忆流；按时间近度、重要性与相关性检索记忆，输入 GPT-3.5 生成反思与分层的日程计划，再由沙盒游戏引擎转化为移动与对话；可信度由人类评估者与消融版本对比打分。

paper.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior

works.title_zh: 生成式智能体（Smallville 小镇）

works.title: Text2Room
works.description: From a text prompt, Text2Room builds a complete, textured 3D room mesh that can be walked around, by painting the room view by view with an image model.
works.description_zh: Text2Room 根据一句文字搭建出完整的、带纹理的三维房间网格，可以在其中走动：方法是用图像模型逐个视角“画”出整个房间。
works.idea_en: It was an early proof that a 2D image model plus depth can furnish an entire enterable room.
works.idea_zh: 它是早期的证明：二维图像模型加上深度估计，就能布置出一个可以走进去的完整房间。
works.method: Iterative text-conditioned inpainting along a chosen camera trajectory, with monocular depth estimation and depth alignment, fuses each new view into a single mesh; a second pass fills holes from additional viewpoints.
works.method_zh: 沿选定的镜头轨迹进行以文字为条件的迭代补全，结合单目深度估计与深度对齐，把每个新视角融合进同一个网格；第二轮再从更多视角补洞。

paper.title: Text2Room: Extracting Textured 3D Meshes from 2D Text-to-Image Models

works.title_zh: Text2Room：用文生图模型生成带纹理的房间网格

works.title: Gen-2
works.description: Runway's Gen-2 (2023-03-20) was the first commercially available text-to-video model, turning a prompt or an image into four-second clips inside a web editor used by filmmakers.
works.description_zh: Runway 的 Gen-2（2023-03-20）是首个商用文生视频模型，可在面向影视创作者的网页编辑器中把一句提示或一张图变成 4 秒短片。
works.idea_en: Put prompt-to-clip generation in the hands of non-engineers two years before it became photorealistic.
works.idea_zh: 在视频生成达到照片级真实之前两年，就把“用提示生成片段”交到了非工程师手中。
works.method: Latent video diffusion that extends Runway's Gen-1 structure-and-content model with text and image conditioning.
works.method_zh: 潜空间视频扩散模型，在 Runway Gen-1（结构与内容引导）的基础上加入文本和图像条件。

works.title: Zero-1-to-3
works.description: Fine-tunes Stable Diffusion to render an object from a new viewpoint given one photo and a relative camera rotation; the generated views can then be lifted into a 3D model with score distillation.
works.description_zh: 微调 Stable Diffusion，使其根据一张照片和相对相机旋转，生成同一物体在新视角下的图像；这些视图再通过分数蒸馏提升为三维模型。
works.idea_en: Turned a 2D image model into a viewpoint-controllable object renderer, which made a single photo the default input for 3D asset generation.
works.idea_zh: 把二维图像模型变成可控视角的物体渲染器，从此一张照片成为三维资产生成的默认输入。
works.method: A latent diffusion model conditioned on the input image and the relative camera pose, fine-tuned on renderings of Objaverse objects; 3D reconstruction by score distillation into a neural field.
works.method_zh: 以输入图像和相对相机位姿为条件的潜扩散模型，在 Objaverse 物体渲染图上微调；再用分数蒸馏把结果重建为神经场。

paper.title: Zero-1-to-3: Zero-shot One Image to 3D Object

works.title: MAV3D (Make-A-Video3D)
works.description: Meta's MAV3D generated short dynamic 3D scenes, such as an animated corgi viewable from any angle, from a text prompt alone, by distilling a text-to-video model.
works.description_zh: Meta 的 MAV3D 仅凭文字提示就能生成短小的动态三维场景（例如可从任意角度观看的动画柯基），方法是蒸馏一个文生视频模型。
works.idea_en: The first text-to-4D system; it set the template of borrowing motion from video models.
works.idea_zh: 第一个文本到 4D 系统，确立了“从视频模型借用运动”的范式。
works.method: A HexPlane dynamic NeRF is optimised with score distillation from Make-A-Video, using a static-to-dynamic schedule and super-resolution fine-tuning.
works.method_zh: 用 Make-A-Video 的分数蒸馏优化一个 HexPlane 动态 NeRF，采用由静态到动态的训练日程并进行超分辨率微调。

paper.title: Text-To-4D Dynamic Scene Generation

works.title_zh: MAV3D 文本生成 4D 动态场景

works.title: Automated virtual reality therapy to treat agoraphobic avoidance and distress in patients with psychosis (gameChange): a multicentre, parallel-group, single-blind, randomised, controlled trial in England with mediation and moderation analyses
works.description: Multicentre randomized trial across nine NHS trusts of gameChange, automated VR therapy in which a virtual coach guides people with psychosis through everyday situations they avoid, such as a café, a bus or a shop, at graded difficulty; it reduced avoidance and distress, most clearly for people with severe agoraphobia.
works.description_zh: 在英格兰九个 NHS 机构开展的多中心随机试验：自动化 VR 疗法 gameChange 由一位虚拟教练引导精神病患者，按难度分级进入他们回避的日常情境（如咖啡馆、公交车、商店）；疗法减少了回避与痛苦，对重度广场恐惧者效果最明显。
works.idea_en: Therapy can run without a therapist in the room once the situation and the coach are automated; this trial standard is what generated therapies will have to match.
works.idea_zh: 当情境与教练都实现自动化后，治疗无需治疗师在场即可进行；这一试验标准正是生成式疗法需要达到的。
works.method: Single-blind RCT (gameChange plus usual care vs. usual care alone) with graded VR exposure led by a pre-recorded virtual coach, plus mediation and moderation analyses.
works.method_zh: 单盲随机对照试验（gameChange 加常规护理 vs. 仅常规护理），由预先录制的虚拟教练引导分级 VR 暴露，并进行中介与调节分析。

paper.title: Automated virtual reality therapy to treat agoraphobic avoidance and distress in patients with psychosis (gameChange): a multicentre, parallel-group, single-blind, randomised, controlled trial in England with mediation and moderation analyses

works.title_zh: gameChange：用自动化虚拟现实疗法治疗精神病患者的广场回避与痛苦（多中心随机对照试验）

works.title: Imagen Video
works.description: Google Research's Imagen Video (2022-10-05) generated 5.3-second clips at 1280×768 and 24 fps from text, the highest-fidelity text-to-video results of its time; it was never released.
works.description_zh: Google Research 的 Imagen Video（2022-10-05）可从文字生成 5.3 秒、1280×768、24 fps 的片段，是当时保真度最高的文生视频结果，但从未公开发布。
works.idea_en: Cascaded diffusion showed high resolution was reachable, at the cost of chaining seven models.
works.idea_zh: 级联扩散证明了高分辨率可以实现，代价是串联七个模型。
works.method: Cascade of seven video diffusion models (a base model plus three spatial and three temporal super-resolution stages) conditioned on a T5-XXL text encoder.
works.method_zh: 由七个视频扩散模型组成的级联（基础模型加 3 个空间超分和 3 个时间超分阶段），以 T5-XXL 文本编码为条件。

paper.title: Imagen Video: High Definition Video Generation with Diffusion Models

works.title: Instant Neural Graphics Primitives (Instant NeRF)
works.description: NVIDIA's instant-ngp trains a NeRF from a handful of photos in seconds to minutes and lets you fly through the result in an interactive viewer while it is still training.
works.description_zh: NVIDIA 的 instant-ngp 能在几秒到几分钟内用少量照片训练出 NeRF，并允许在训练过程中就用交互式查看器在结果里穿行。
works.idea_en: Made capturing a radiance field feel like taking a photo rather than running a batch job.
works.idea_zh: 让捕捉辐射场的体验更像拍照，而不像跑一个批处理任务。
works.method: A multiresolution hash table of trainable feature vectors replaces most of the MLP, and fully fused CUDA kernels train and render on one GPU.
works.method_zh: 用多分辨率哈希表存储可训练特征向量，替代了大部分多层感知机，并通过完全融合的 CUDA 内核在单张 GPU 上训练与渲染。
works.specs: NeRF training in seconds; 1920×1080 rendering in tens of milliseconds (paper)

paper.title: Instant Neural Graphics Primitives with a Multiresolution Hash Encoding

works.title_zh: Instant NGP 即时神经图形基元

works.title: Luma 3D Capture
works.description: Luma's phone app guided people through filming an object or place and returned a NeRF, later a Gaussian-splat 'interactive scene' that could be embedded on the web or exported to game engines.
works.description_zh: Luma 的手机应用引导用户拍摄物体或地点，并返回 NeRF 结果，后来改为可嵌入网页或导出到游戏引擎的高斯泼溅“交互场景”。
works.idea_en: Brought radiance-field capture to ordinary phones before most people had heard of NeRF.
works.idea_zh: 在大多数人听说 NeRF 之前，就把辐射场捕捉带到了普通手机上。
works.method: A guided capture UI collects video around the subject; cloud reconstruction trains a NeRF or 3D Gaussian scene with meshes and exports for Unreal and other tools.
works.method_zh: 引导式拍摄界面采集围绕主体的视频，由云端重建训练 NeRF 或三维高斯场景，并提供网格与 Unreal 等工具的导出。
works.title_zh: Luma 三维捕捉

works.title: Make-A-Video
works.description: Meta AI's Make-A-Video (2022-09-29) was one of the first text-to-video systems, producing short, low-resolution clips such as a teddy bear painting a portrait, learned without paired text-video data.
works.description_zh: Meta AI 的 Make-A-Video（2022-09-29）是最早的文生视频系统之一，可生成低分辨率短片（如泰迪熊画肖像），且不需要成对的文本-视频数据。
works.idea_en: Showed that motion can be learned from unlabeled video and appearance from captioned images, a recipe many later models reused.
works.idea_zh: 证明可以从无标注视频中学习运动、从带字幕的图像中学习外观，这一配方被后来许多模型沿用。
works.method: Extends a text-to-image diffusion model with spatiotemporal convolution and attention layers, frame interpolation and super-resolution.
works.method_zh: 在文生图扩散模型上加入时空卷积与注意力层，并配合插帧与超分辨率。

paper.title: Make-A-Video: Text-to-Video Generation without Text-Video Data

works.title: Mip-NeRF 360
works.description: Mip-NeRF 360 extends anti-aliased NeRF to unbounded real scenes captured by walking around an object, with a nine-scene dataset that became the standard test for splatting methods.
works.description_zh: Mip-NeRF 360 把抗锯齿 NeRF 扩展到绕物体一周拍摄的无界真实场景，并发布了一个九场景数据集，后来成为高斯泼溅方法的标准测试。
works.idea_en: Defined what a full walk-around capture of a real place should look like, including the far background.
works.idea_zh: 定义了一次完整绕行拍摄的真实场景应达到的效果，包括远处背景。
works.method: A non-linear scene contraction maps unbounded space into a bounded ball, an online proposal network distils density for sampling, and a distortion regulariser suppresses floaters.
works.method_zh: 非线性场景收缩把无界空间映射进有界球体，在线提议网络蒸馏密度以指导采样，畸变正则项抑制漂浮伪影。

paper.title: Mip-NeRF 360: Unbounded Anti-Aliased Neural Radiance Fields

works.title: Nerfstudio
works.description: Nerfstudio is an open-source framework and web viewer for training and comparing radiance fields and Gaussian splats (via gsplat) from your own captures.
works.description_zh: Nerfstudio 是一个开源框架与网页查看器，可用自己的捕捉数据训练并比较辐射场与高斯泼溅（通过 gsplat）。
works.idea_en: A shared, versioned codebase makes reconstruction choices reportable and repeatable across labs.
works.idea_zh: 共享、有版本的代码库，让重建中的各种选择可以在不同实验室之间被报告和复现。
works.method: Modular PyTorch components (data parsers, samplers, fields, renderers) with the Nerfacto and Splatfacto methods and a browser viewer.
works.method_zh: 模块化的 PyTorch 组件（数据解析、采样器、场、渲染器），内置 Nerfacto 与 Splatfacto 方法和浏览器查看器。

paper.title: Nerfstudio: A Modular Framework for Neural Radiance Field Development

works.title: Phenaki
works.description: Phenaki (Google, 2022-10-05) generated videos of variable length, up to minutes, from a sequence of prompts that change over time, for example a story told shot by shot.
works.description_zh: Phenaki（Google，2022-10-05）可根据随时间变化的一串提示生成可变长度、最长数分钟的视频，例如逐镜讲述一个故事。
works.idea_en: The first sketch of a story-driven, prompt-switching video stream, an idea later made interactive by real-time models such as LongLive.
works.idea_zh: 首次勾勒出由故事驱动、可切换提示的视频流，这一想法后来被 LongLive 等实时模型做成了交互式。
works.method: C-ViViT tokenizer that compresses video into discrete tokens, plus a bidirectional masked transformer conditioned on text that generates autoregressively in time.
works.method_zh: 用 C-ViViT 把视频压缩为离散 token，再由以文本为条件的双向掩码 Transformer 在时间维度上自回归生成。

paper.title: Phenaki: Variable Length Video Generation From Open Domain Textual Description

works.title: Text2Light
works.description: Generates high-resolution HDR 360° panoramas from a text description, usable both as an immersive backdrop and as physically based lighting for rendering 3D scenes.
works.description_zh: 根据文字描述生成高分辨率的 HDR 360° 全景图，既可作为沉浸式背景，也可作为三维场景渲染时基于物理的光照。
works.idea_en: A generated environment can also light the scene, so virtual people and objects look as if they belong in it.
works.idea_zh: 生成的环境还能为场景提供光照，让虚拟人物和物体看起来真的身处其中。
works.method: Zero-shot two-stage pipeline: a text-driven low-resolution LDR panorama is generated with CLIP guidance and hierarchical codebooks, then upscaled by a structure-aware super-resolution network and lifted to HDR.
works.method_zh: 零样本两阶段流程：先借助 CLIP 引导与分层码本生成文字驱动的低分辨率 LDR 全景图，再由结构感知的超分辨率网络放大并提升为 HDR。

paper.title: Text2Light: Zero-Shot Text-Driven HDR Panorama Generation

works.title: EDGE
works.description: Generates dance choreography from music with a diffusion model, with editing controls such as joint-wise constraints, in-betweening and continuation to arbitrary length.
works.description_zh: 用扩散模型由音乐生成舞蹈编排，并提供按关节约束、补间和任意长度续写等编辑控制。
works.idea_en: Audio-driven body generation with editable constraints: music (and by extension speech or sound) drives the body while chosen poses stay pinned.
works.idea_zh: 可加编辑约束的音频驱动身体生成：音乐（进而语音或声音）驱动身体，同时可以固定选定的姿态。
works.method: A transformer diffusion model conditioned on Jukebox music embeddings, with a contact-consistency loss for foot physics and a new Physical Foot Contact score; trained on AIST++.
works.method_zh: 以 Jukebox 音乐嵌入为条件的 Transformer 扩散模型，加入足部接触一致性损失并提出新的物理足部接触评分；在 AIST++ 上训练。

paper.title: EDGE: Editable Dance Generation From Music

works.title: DreamFusion
works.description: Text-to-3D method from Google Research that optimizes a NeRF from scratch using a frozen 2D text-to-image diffusion model (Imagen) as its only guide; a prompt yields a relightable 3D object after a long per-object optimization.
works.description_zh: 谷歌研究院的文生三维方法：以冻结的二维文生图扩散模型（Imagen）作为唯一指导，从零优化一个神经辐射场（NeRF）；输入一句提示词，经过较长的逐物体优化后得到可重新打光的三维物体。
works.idea_en: Showed that 3D objects can be pulled out of a 2D image model with no 3D training data, the starting point of the text-to-3D lineage, at the cost of a slow optimization per object.
works.idea_zh: 证明了无需任何三维训练数据就能从二维图像模型中“提取”出三维物体，是文生三维路线的起点，代价是每个物体都要缓慢优化。
works.method: Score Distillation Sampling: a randomly initialised NeRF is rendered from random viewpoints and updated with gradients from Imagen's denoising loss, with shading terms that encourage real geometry.
works.method_zh: 分数蒸馏采样（SDS）：从随机视角渲染随机初始化的 NeRF，用 Imagen 去噪损失的梯度更新它，并加入着色项以促使形成真实几何。

paper.title: DreamFusion: Text-to-3D using 2D Diffusion

works.title: MDM: Human Motion Diffusion Model
works.description: Diffusion model that generates human motion from text or action labels and supports editing such as in-betweening and body-part completion without retraining.
works.description_zh: 由文字或动作标签生成人体动作的扩散模型，无需重新训练即可完成补间、身体部位补全等编辑。
works.idea_en: Brought diffusion to motion and made it editable: keyframes or parts of the body can be fixed while the rest is generated, a basic form of experimental control over a generated body.
works.idea_zh: 把扩散模型带入动作生成并让其可编辑：可以固定关键帧或部分身体，其余部分由模型生成——这是对生成身体的一种基本实验控制。
works.method: A transformer-encoder diffusion model over pose sequences that predicts the clean sample instead of the noise, enabling geometric losses on foot contact and velocity; CLIP text conditioning; trained on HumanML3D and KIT-ML.
works.method_zh: 在姿态序列上运行的 Transformer 编码器扩散模型，直接预测干净样本而非噪声，从而可以加入足部接触和速度等几何损失；以 CLIP 编码文字条件；在 HumanML3D 和 KIT-ML 上训练。

paper.title: Human Motion Diffusion Model

works.title_zh: MDM：人体动作扩散模型

works.title: HumanML3D
works.description: Dataset of 14,616 human motion clips paired with 44,970 text descriptions (28.59 hours, drawn from AMASS and HumanAct12), released with a text-to-motion baseline; it is the standard benchmark for text-to-motion.
works.description_zh: 包含 14,616 段人体动作与 44,970 条文字描述的数据集（共 28.59 小时，来自 AMASS 和 HumanAct12），并附带一个文生动作基线模型；是文生动作的标准基准。
works.idea_en: Nearly every text-to-motion model since 2022 is trained and scored on it, so its coverage (everyday solo actions, little social interaction) shapes what generated bodies can do.
works.idea_zh: 2022 年以来几乎所有文生动作模型都在它上面训练和评测，因此它的覆盖范围（以日常单人动作为主，社交互动很少）决定了生成身体能做什么。
works.method: Crowd-sourced text annotations of AMASS and HumanAct12 motion clips, plus a temporal VAE that predicts motion length from text and then generates the motion.
works.method_zh: 对 AMASS 和 HumanAct12 动作片段进行众包文字标注，并提供一个先由文字预测动作长度、再生成动作的时序 VAE。

paper.title: Generating Diverse and Natural 3D Human Motions From Text

works.title: Learning to Listen
works.description: Learning to Listen generates the facial reactions of a listener (nods, smiles, frowns) from the speaker's words, voice and face, producing several plausible listener responses for the same speaker turn.
works.description_zh: Learning to Listen 根据说话者的话语、声音和面部，生成倾听者的面部反应（点头、微笑、皱眉），并能为同一段发言生成多种合理的倾听反应。
works.idea_en: Treats listening as a generative, non-deterministic behaviour, the missing half of a conversational virtual human.
works.idea_zh: 把倾听当作一种非确定的、可生成的行为，补上了对话虚拟人缺失的另一半。
works.method: A VQ-VAE codebook of listener motion and a transformer that autoregressively predicts listener codes from multimodal speaker input, trained on in-the-wild dyadic interview video.
works.method_zh: 用 VQ-VAE 码本表示倾听者动作，再用 Transformer 根据说话者的多模态输入自回归地预测倾听者编码，训练数据为真实场景中的双人访谈视频。

paper.title: Learning to Listen: Modeling Non-Deterministic Dyadic Facial Motion

works.title_zh: 学会倾听：非确定性双人面部动作建模

works.title: Unreal Engine 5
works.description: Epic's real-time engine behind many high-fidelity VR studies and virtual-production stages, with Nanite geometry, Lumen lighting and MetaHuman digital humans. Unreal Engine 5.8 (2026-06-23) added MetaHuman Collections for crowds of hundreds, full-body markerless MetaHuman capture from a webcam, open-source OpenRigLogic (MIT) and an experimental MCP plugin that lets any LLM inspect and drive the editor.
works.description_zh: Epic 的实时引擎，许多高保真 VR 研究与虚拟制片舞台都用它，具备 Nanite 几何、Lumen 光照与 MetaHuman 数字人。Unreal Engine 5.8（2026-06-23）加入了可生成数百人群的 MetaHuman Collections、用网络摄像头即可完成的全身无标记 MetaHuman 动捕、以 MIT 许可开源的 OpenRigLogic，以及一个实验性 MCP 插件，让任意大语言模型都能查看并操控编辑器。
works.idea_en: Gives generated content a photoreal, deterministic runtime: the generative layer can sit in MetaHumans and scripts while the engine keeps timing and logging exact.
works.idea_zh: 为生成内容提供照片级、可确定复现的运行环境：生成层可以放在 MetaHuman 与脚本里，时序与日志则由引擎精确保证。
works.method: C++ engine with Blueprint visual scripting; Nanite virtualized geometry and Lumen global illumination render in real time, and MetaHuman tools rig and animate scanned or generated characters.
works.method_zh: C++ 引擎，配有 Blueprint 可视化脚本；Nanite 虚拟化几何与 Lumen 全局光照实时渲染，MetaHuman 工具为扫描或生成的角色绑定骨骼并驱动动画。
works.specs: UE 5.0 released 2022-04-05 · UE 5.8 released 2026-06-23 · free, 5% royalty above $1M gross for games

works.title: dGSLM (Generative Spoken Dialogue Language Modeling)
works.description: A textless model that generates two-channel spoken dialogue directly from audio, including overlapping speech, laughter and backchannels between two speakers. Given the start of a real conversation, it continues both sides as audio.
works.description_zh: 一个不依赖文本的模型，直接从音频生成双声道口语对话，包括两位说话人之间的重叠发言、笑声和附和语。给它一段真实对话的开头，它会以音频形式同时续写双方。
works.idea_en: Showed that turn-taking, overlap and 'mm-hm' can be learned from raw two-channel audio: the conceptual ancestor of full-duplex voice agents.
works.idea_zh: 证明了轮流说话、重叠发言和“嗯嗯”这类附和可以直接从双声道原始音频中学到，是全双工语音智能体在概念上的前身。
works.method: Discrete HuBERT units per speaker channel, modelled by a dual-tower Transformer with cross-attention and trained on about 2,000 hours of Fisher telephone conversations.
works.method_zh: 为每个说话人的声道提取离散 HuBERT 单元，用带交叉注意力的双塔 Transformer 建模，在约 2000 小时的 Fisher 电话对话上训练。

paper.title: Generative Spoken Dialogue Language Modeling

works.title_zh: dGSLM（生成式口语对话语言模型）

works.title: Neural 3D Video Synthesis (DyNeRF)
works.description: Meta Reality Labs' DyNeRF reconstructs short multi-camera recordings of people cooking, with flames and moving hands, as a radiance field you can replay from new viewpoints and at new moments.
works.description_zh: Meta Reality Labs 的 DyNeRF 把多相机录制的短视频（人在做饭，有火焰与移动的手）重建为辐射场，可以从新的视角、在新的时刻回放。
works.idea_en: Its multi-view kitchen recordings became the shared yardstick for every later 4D Gaussian method.
works.idea_zh: 它的多视角厨房录制成了此后所有 4D 高斯方法共用的衡量标准。
works.method: A NeRF conditioned on a compact learned latent code per frame is trained with hierarchical keyframe sampling and ray importance sampling over about 20 synchronised cameras.
works.method_zh: 以每帧一个紧凑可学习隐编码为条件的 NeRF，在约 20 台同步相机上用分层关键帧采样与光线重要性采样训练。

paper.title: Neural 3D Video Synthesis from Multi-view Video

works.title_zh: 神经三维视频合成（DyNeRF）

works.title: RelieVRx
works.description: Prescription home VR program for chronic low back pain that teaches pain-management skills such as breathing, relaxation and attention shifting through short daily sessions; it received FDA De Novo authorization in 2021.
works.description_zh: 用于慢性下背痛的处方型居家 VR 项目，通过每日简短课程教授呼吸、放松、注意力转移等疼痛管理技巧；2021 年获美国 FDA De Novo 授权。
works.idea_en: Scripted VR became a regulated medical device; any generative or adaptive successor will have to clear the same evidence bar.
works.idea_zh: 脚本化 VR 已成为受监管的医疗器械；任何生成式或自适应的后继者都要跨过同样的证据门槛。
works.method: Pre-built modules grounded in cognitive behavioral therapy and mindfulness, delivered on a standalone headset at home and evaluated in randomized trials against sham VR.
works.method_zh: 基于认知行为疗法与正念的预制模块，在家中通过一体机头显交付，并在与假 VR 对照的随机试验中接受评估。

works.title: Replicate
works.description: Runs thousands of open and proprietary models behind one API, each addressed by a version id, and lets developers publish their own models packaged with the open-source Cog container format. Replicate announced on 2025-11-17 that it is joining Cloudflare; it keeps its brand and its API.
works.description_zh: 通过一个 API 运行数千个开源与闭源模型，每个模型都以版本 ID 调用；开发者也可以用开源的 Cog 容器格式打包并发布自己的模型。Replicate 于 2025-11-17 宣布并入 Cloudflare，品牌与 API 保持不变。
works.idea_en: Version ids per model make it one of the easier hosts on which to pin the exact generator a study used.
works.idea_zh: 每个模型都有版本 ID，在这里锁定研究所用的确切生成器相对容易。
works.method: Models packaged as Cog containers run on Replicate's GPU fleet; each prediction is an HTTP job addressed by a model version.
works.method_zh: 以 Cog 容器打包的模型运行在 Replicate 的 GPU 集群上；每次预测都是一个按模型版本寻址的 HTTP 任务。
works.specs: thousands of models · per-second GPU or per-output billing · joining Cloudflare (announced 2025-11-17)

works.title: Talespin CoPilot Designer
works.description: No-code tool for building VR soft-skills simulations with virtual humans, branching dialogue and feedback; by 2023 it had added generative AI for drafting content. Talespin's site now redirects to Cornerstone's immersive-learning platform, which advertises role play with AI-powered virtual humans.
works.description_zh: 无代码工具，用于搭建含虚拟人、分支对话与反馈的 VR 软技能模拟；到 2023 年已加入用于起草内容的生成式 AI。Talespin 官网现已跳转至 Cornerstone 的沉浸式学习平台，后者宣传与 AI 驱动的虚拟人进行角色扮演。
works.idea_en: Generative AI entered VR training first as an authoring aid, drafting branches that humans review, before it ran characters live.
works.idea_zh: 生成式 AI 最早以创作辅助的身份进入 VR 训练：先起草由人审阅的分支对话，之后才去实时驱动角色。
works.method: Flow editor for branching dialogue with animated virtual humans, extended with generative content tools, delivered on headsets and desktop.
works.method_zh: 基于流程编辑器编写分支对话并驱动动画虚拟人，后加入生成式内容工具，可在头显与桌面端交付。

works.title: The Cognitive Affective Model of Immersive Learning (CAMIL): a Theoretical Research-Based Model of Learning in Immersive Virtual Reality
works.description: Model that explains learning in immersive VR through two affordances, presence and agency, which act on learning through six affective and cognitive factors such as interest, self-efficacy, embodiment and cognitive load.
works.description_zh: 解释沉浸式 VR 学习的理论模型：临场感与能动性两种特性，通过兴趣、自我效能、具身化、认知负荷等六个情感与认知因素影响学习。
works.idea_en: More presence is not automatically more learning: a generated training scenario helps only when its realism and interactivity serve the learning goal instead of overloading the learner.
works.idea_zh: 临场感更强并不自动意味着学得更好：生成的训练情境只有当其真实感与交互性服务于学习目标、而非让学习者超载时才有帮助。
works.method: Theoretical synthesis by Makransky and Petersen of empirical work on immersive learning into a causal model with testable predictions.
works.method_zh: Makransky 与 Petersen 把沉浸式学习的实证研究整合为一个可检验的因果模型。

paper.title: The Cognitive Affective Model of Immersive Learning (CAMIL): a Theoretical Research-Based Model of Learning in Immersive Virtual Reality

works.title_zh: 沉浸式学习的认知情感模型（CAMIL）

works.title: XLand: Open-Ended Learning Agents
works.description: Agents trained in XLand, a procedurally generated universe of 3D worlds and multiplayer games, learn general behaviors such as experimenting, cooperating and using objects, and then play held-out games like hide-and-seek and capture the flag without further training.
works.description_zh: 在 XLand（一个由程序生成的三维世界与多人游戏构成的宇宙）中训练的智能体，学会了尝试、合作、利用物体等通用行为，随后无需再训练就能玩捉迷藏、夺旗等未见过的游戏。
works.idea_en: A precursor of SIMA and of agents in generated worlds: generality came from training across a generated space of situations rather than one handcrafted task.
works.idea_zh: SIMA 与“生成世界中的智能体”的先声：通用性来自在生成的情境空间中训练，而不是单一的人工任务。
works.method: Deep reinforcement learning with population-based training and a dynamic curriculum that generates worlds, goals and co-players matched to each agent's current ability, evaluated zero-shot on held-out tasks.
works.method_zh: 采用基于种群的深度强化学习，并以动态课程按每个智能体当前能力生成世界、目标与同伴，在留出的任务上进行零样本评估。

paper.title: Open-Ended Learning Leads to Generally Capable Agents

works.title_zh: XLand：开放式学习智能体

works.title: Project Starline
works.description: Google's Project Starline prototype is a booth in which two people talk across a light-field display that shows each other life-size and in 3D, captured and transmitted in real time.
works.description_zh: Google 的 Project Starline 原型是一个通话隔间：两个人隔着光场显示屏交谈，彼此以真人大小的三维形象出现，实时捕捉并传输。
works.idea_en: Eye contact and depth cues at life size, tested with users, make it a reference for what remote social presence can feel like.
works.idea_zh: 真人尺寸的眼神接触与深度线索，并经过用户测试，使它成为远程社交临场感的参照。
works.method: Several colour and depth cameras feed a real-time fusion and compression pipeline; a head-tracked autostereoscopic display renders the remote person with spatial audio.
works.method_zh: 多台彩色与深度相机接入实时融合与压缩流程，头部追踪的裸眼立体显示屏配合空间音频渲染远端的人。

paper.title: Project Starline: A high-fidelity telepresence system

works.title: MetaHuman Creator
works.description: MetaHuman Creator lets anyone design a realistic, fully rigged digital human in minutes by blending scanned faces and adjusting skin, hair and body, ready to animate in Unreal Engine; since Unreal Engine 5.6 (2025) it runs inside the engine and accepts mesh or scan input.
works.description_zh: MetaHuman Creator 让任何人通过混合扫描人脸并调整皮肤、头发和体型，在几分钟内设计出逼真且完整绑定的数字人，可直接在 Unreal Engine 中驱动；自 Unreal Engine 5.6（2025）起，它在引擎内运行并接受网格或扫描输入。
works.idea_en: The non-generative baseline: authored, rigged, controllable humans whose every parameter can be logged, which generative avatars still struggle to match on control.
works.idea_zh: 非生成式的基线：人工制作、完整绑定、可控，每个参数都能记录；在可控性上，生成式虚拟人仍难以企及。
works.method: Parametric blending over a database of scanned faces and bodies (from 3Lateral and Cubic Motion), with a standard facial rig and LODs for real-time rendering.
works.method_zh: 在扫描人脸与身体数据库（来自 3Lateral 和 Cubic Motion）上做参数化混合，配有标准面部绑定和用于实时渲染的多级细节（LOD）。

works.title: 3D Photography using Context-aware Layered Depth Inpainting
works.description: Turns a single RGB-D photo (depth from a phone or a depth estimator) into a '3D photo' with real parallax, synthesising the color and depth hidden behind foreground objects so the camera can move slightly.
works.description_zh: 把一张 RGB-D 照片（深度来自手机或深度估计）变成具有真实视差的“三维照片”，并合成前景物体背后被遮挡的颜色与深度，让镜头可以小幅移动。
works.idea_en: The lineage anchor for today's spatial scenes: one photo plus inpainted hidden layers already gives a convincing sense of depth.
works.idea_zh: 今天“空间场景”的源头：一张照片加上补全的隐藏图层，就已经能带来令人信服的纵深感。
works.method: The photo is converted to a layered depth image; learned color and depth inpainting networks fill the occluded regions locally around depth discontinuities, and the result is rendered as a mesh.
works.method_zh: 先把照片转换为分层深度图像，再由学习得到的颜色与深度补全网络，在深度不连续处局部填补被遮挡区域，最后以网格形式渲染。

paper.title: 3D Photography using Context-aware Layered Depth Inpainting

works.title_zh: 基于上下文感知分层深度补全的三维摄影

works.title: Agence
works.description: A short 'dynamic film' about small creatures on a tiny planet whose behaviour is driven by AI agents; viewers can watch, or reach in and change their world, and the story plays out differently each time.
works.description_zh: 一部短篇“动态电影”：小星球上的小生物由 AI 智能体驱动；观众可以旁观，也可以伸手改变它们的世界，每次故事走向都不同。
works.idea_en: An early precursor: a story whose characters are trained agents rather than animation, so viewer interference has consequences.
works.idea_zh: 早期先例：故事里的角色是训练出来的智能体而不是动画，所以观众的干预会带来后果。
works.method: Characters run reinforcement-learning policies in real time within a game-engine film, and viewer interactions change their environment (co-produced with the National Film Board of Canada).
works.method_zh: 角色在游戏引擎构建的电影中实时运行强化学习策略，观众的交互会改变它们的环境（与加拿大国家电影局联合制作）。
works.title_zh: Agence 动态电影

works.title: An Embodied Perspective as a Victim of Sexual Harassment in Virtual Reality Reduces Action Conformity in a Later Milgram Obedience Scenario
works.description: Sixty men saw a group of men sexually harass a woman in a virtual bar, either only as one of the group or also from the woman's body; those who had been embodied as the victim later conformed less with the group in a Milgram-style scenario.
works.description_zh: 60 名男性在虚拟酒吧中目睹一群男性对一名女性的性骚扰，有人只以群体成员之一的身份在场，有人还以受害女性的身体体验了这一幕；后者在随后的米尔格拉姆式情境中更少随群体行动。
works.idea_en: Situations can be chained: one embodied experience changes behavior in the next, so a generated sequence of scenes is itself an experimental manipulation.
works.idea_zh: 情境可以串联：一次具身体验会改变下一个情境中的行为，因此一组生成的场景序列本身就是一种实验操纵。
works.method: Three groups of 20 (group member only, also embodied as the woman, empty-bar control) followed by a virtual Milgram task under group pressure.
works.method_zh: 三组各 20 人（仅作为群体成员、还以女性身体体验、只经历空酒吧的对照组），随后在群体压力下完成虚拟米尔格拉姆任务。

paper.title: An Embodied Perspective as a Victim of Sexual Harassment in Virtual Reality Reduces Action Conformity in a Later Milgram Obedience Scenario

works.title_zh: 在虚拟现实中以性骚扰受害者视角具身体验，可降低随后米尔格拉姆服从情境中的行动从众

works.title: HoloSuite (HoloEdit / HoloStream)
works.description: Arcturus HoloSuite is a production toolset for editing, compressing and streaming volumetric video of people into games, AR and web players; the company has since moved into Gaussian-splat replays of live sports.
works.description_zh: Arcturus HoloSuite 是一套制作工具，用于编辑、压缩体积视频中的人物，并将其流式传输到游戏、AR 与网页播放器中；该公司后来转向基于高斯泼溅的体育赛事回放。
works.idea_en: The editing and delivery layer volumetric capture needs before it can be dropped into an experience.
works.idea_zh: 体积捕捉在被放进一段体验之前，需要的正是这样的编辑与交付层。
works.method: Captured mesh sequences are cleaned, re-timed, retargeted (e.g. head gaze) and encoded into adaptive streams with plug-ins for Unity and Unreal.
works.method_zh: 对捕捉得到的网格序列进行清理、重定时、重定向（例如头部朝向），并编码为自适应码流，提供 Unity 与 Unreal 插件。
works.title_zh: HoloSuite 体积视频套件

works.title: Infinite Nature
works.description: From a single landscape photo, Infinite Nature generates an arbitrarily long video of a drone-like flight into the scene, inventing new coastline and mountains as the camera advances.
works.description_zh: Infinite Nature 从一张风景照片出发，生成任意长度的“无人机飞入画面”视频，镜头前进时不断创造新的海岸线与山峦。
works.idea_en: The lineage anchor for explorable worlds: it showed endless novel terrain from one image, and also how it falls apart without a persistent 3D memory.
works.idea_zh: 可探索世界这一脉的源头：它展示了从一张图像生成无尽的新地形，也暴露了没有持久三维记忆时世界会如何崩坏。
works.method: Render-refine-repeat: the current frame and its disparity are warped to the next camera pose, and a network inpaints and refines the result, trained on aerial nature videos.
works.method_zh: “渲染—修补—重复”：把当前画面及其视差变换到下一个相机位姿，再由网络补全和修饰，训练数据为航拍自然视频。

paper.title: Infinite Nature: Perpetual View Generation of Natural Scenes from a Single Image

works.title_zh: Infinite Nature：从单张图像无限生成自然风景

works.title: NeRF
works.description: Neural Radiance Fields represent a scene as a small neural network that returns colour and density for any point and viewing direction, so new photoreal views of a captured object or room can be rendered from about a hundred photos.
works.description_zh: 神经辐射场把场景表示为一个小型神经网络：给定任意位置和视角，它返回颜色与密度，因此只需大约一百张照片，就能为拍摄的物体或房间渲染出照片级的新视角。
works.idea_en: The point where a set of photos became a place you can look around in, at the cost of a day of training per scene and slow rendering.
works.idea_zh: 从这里开始，一组照片变成了可以环顾的地方，代价是每个场景要训练一天、渲染也很慢。
works.method: An MLP with positional encoding maps 5D coordinates to radiance and density, trained per scene by differentiable volume rendering against posed photos.
works.method_zh: 带位置编码的多层感知机把五维坐标映射为辐射与密度，通过可微体渲染与带位姿照片对比，逐场景训练。
works.specs: ~100 posed photos · per-scene training about 1–2 days on one V100 (paper)

paper.title: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis

works.title_zh: NeRF 神经辐射场

works.title: Wav2Lip
works.description: Wav2Lip re-syncs the lips of any talking face in a video to a new audio track, for arbitrary identities and languages, without per-speaker training.
works.description_zh: Wav2Lip 能把任意视频中说话人的唇形重新对齐到一段新的音频上，适用于任何身份和语言，无需针对说话人训练。
works.idea_en: The lineage's precursor: once lips could follow any voice, a face could be paired with a synthetic speaker, and its lip-sync metrics (LSE-C/D) are still used to score avatars in 2026.
works.idea_zh: 这一谱系的前身：一旦唇形能跟随任何声音，人脸就能与合成语音配对；它的唇形同步指标（LSE-C/D）在 2026 年仍被用来给虚拟人打分。
works.method: A GAN-based lip generator trained against a frozen, pre-trained lip-sync expert discriminator (SyncNet) that penalises out-of-sync mouth shapes.
works.method_zh: 基于 GAN 的唇形生成器，训练时用一个冻结的、预训练好的唇形同步专家判别器（SyncNet）惩罚不同步的口型。

paper.title: A Lip Sync Expert Is All You Need for Speech to Lip Generation In The Wild

works.title_zh: Wav2Lip 唇形同步

works.title: GameGAN
works.description: A generative model that learned to re-create a playable PAC-MAN purely from 50,000 recorded episodes of screen frames and key presses, without access to the game engine; NVIDIA released it for the game's 40th anniversary.
works.description_zh: 一个生成模型，仅凭 5 万局游戏录像（画面与按键）就学会重建可玩的《吃豆人》，完全不接触游戏引擎；英伟达在该游戏 40 周年之际发布了它。
works.idea_en: The first widely shown neural game engine: a game's rules and graphics can both be learned from play data.
works.idea_zh: 第一个被广泛展示的神经游戏引擎：游戏的规则与画面都可以从游玩数据中学出来。
works.method: A GAN with a dynamics engine, an external memory module that keeps the maze consistent, and a rendering engine that separates static background from moving agents.
works.method_zh: 由动力学引擎、保持迷宫一致的外部记忆模块，以及把静态背景与运动角色分开的渲染引擎组成的 GAN。

paper.title: Learning to Simulate Dynamic Environments with GameGAN

works.title: RigNet
works.description: Neural network that predicts a skeleton and skinning weights for an arbitrary articulated character mesh, the first learned auto-rigging method for diverse shapes beyond humanoids.
works.description_zh: 一个神经网络，可为任意关节角色网格预测骨架和蒙皮权重，是首个适用于人形之外多样形体的学习式自动绑定方法。
works.idea_en: The starting point of the 'generate a character, then make it move' lineage without a rigging artist.
works.idea_zh: “先生成角色、再让它动起来”且无需绑定师这一路线的起点。
works.method: Graph neural networks over the mesh predict joint locations, then bone connectivity via a minimum spanning tree over learned edge probabilities, then skinning weights; trained on about 2,700 rigged characters.
works.method_zh: 在网格上运行的图神经网络先预测关节位置，再通过对学习到的边概率求最小生成树得到骨骼连接，最后预测蒙皮权重；训练数据为约 2700 个已绑定角色。

paper.title: RigNet: Neural Rigging for Articulated Characters

works.title: Bodyswaps
works.description: Soft-skills training in VR and the browser in which learners hold role-play conversations with AI avatars, for example a nurse talking with a patient, then get a transcript and feedback from an AI coach on what they said and how they said it.
works.description_zh: 在 VR 与浏览器中进行的软技能训练：学习者与 AI 化身进行角色扮演对话（例如护士与病人交谈），之后获得完整对话记录，以及 AI 教练就说话内容与方式给出的反馈。
works.idea_en: Commercial training has moved from branching scripts to open AI role-play with automated scoring; whether that scoring is valid is the open research question.
works.idea_zh: 商业培训已从分支脚本转向开放式 AI 角色扮演与自动评分；这种评分是否有效，是尚待研究的问题。
works.method: AI avatar dialogue with speech input (likely LLM-based) on VR headsets, desktop and mobile, with automated analysis of speech content and nonverbal cues such as eye contact.
works.method_zh: 以语音输入与 AI 化身对话（很可能基于大语言模型），支持 VR 头显、桌面与移动端，并自动分析说话内容以及眼神交流等非语言线索。

works.title: Learning on the job: Studying expertise in residential burglars using virtual environments
works.description: Fifty-six incarcerated burglars, 50 other offenders and 55 non-offenders each carried out a mock burglary in a virtual neighborhood; the burglars scoped the area and searched houses in ways that showed domain expertise.
works.description_zh: 56 名在押入室盗窃犯、50 名其他罪犯和 55 名非罪犯各自在虚拟街区中完成一次模拟盗窃；入室盗窃犯侦察街区、搜索房屋的方式体现出专业技能。
works.idea_en: A virtual scene validated by expert behavior (burglars act like burglars) sets the bar any generated crime scenario should meet.
works.idea_zh: 以专家行为来检验虚拟场景（盗窃犯的行为像盗窃犯）——任何生成的犯罪情境都应达到这一标准。
works.method: Quasi-experiment comparing the three groups on routes, time allocation and target selection during a virtual burglary, interpreted through cognitive expertise theory.
works.method_zh: 准实验，比较三组人在虚拟盗窃中的路线、时间分配与目标选择，并以认知专长理论解释。

paper.title: Learning on the job: Studying expertise in residential burglars using virtual environments

works.title_zh: 在“工作”中学习：用虚拟环境研究入室盗窃者的专长

works.title: Multi-Agent Hide and Seek
works.description: Teams of hiders and seekers trained by reinforcement learning in a 3D physics world discover, over hundreds of millions of games, how to build forts from boxes, use ramps to climb walls and exploit physics glitches.
works.description_zh: 在三维物理世界中通过强化学习训练的躲藏者与寻找者队伍，在数亿局游戏中自己学会用箱子搭堡垒、用坡道翻墙，甚至利用物理引擎漏洞。
works.idea_en: A precursor of agents in worlds: competition alone produced a sequence of strategies nobody designed.
works.idea_zh: “世界中的智能体”的先声：仅靠对抗，就产生了一连串没人设计过的策略。
works.method: Multi-agent self-play with PPO and entity-centric attention policies in a MuJoCo environment; six phases of emergent strategy were identified and compared with intrinsic-motivation baselines.
works.method_zh: 在 MuJoCo 环境中，用 PPO 与以实体为中心的注意力策略进行多智能体自我博弈；识别出六个阶段的涌现策略，并与内在动机基线对比。

paper.title: Emergent Tool Use From Multi-Agent Autocurricula

works.title_zh: 多智能体捉迷藏

works.title: SHOTPROS: VR training for police decision-making under stress
works.description: EU Horizon 2020 project in which police organizations, psychologists and VR developers built and field-tested VR scenarios for training decision-making and acting under stress, with physiological monitoring and trainer controls.
works.description_zh: 欧盟“地平线 2020”项目：警务机构、心理学家与 VR 开发者共同构建并实地测试 VR 情境，用于训练警员在压力下的决策与行动，配有生理监测与教官控制。
works.idea_en: Stress becomes a controllable training parameter that trainers dial up or down, a natural slot for adaptive generation.
works.idea_zh: 压力成为可由教官调高调低的训练参数——这正是自适应生成可以接入的位置。
works.method: Requirements from police trainers, human-factors studies and multi-country field trials over three years, summarized as tools and guidelines by Zechner et al. (2023).
works.method_zh: 历时三年，收集警务教官需求、开展人因研究并在多国实地试验，成果由 Zechner 等人（2023）总结为工具与指南。

paper.title: Enhancing Operational Police Training in High Stress Situations with Virtual Reality: Experiences, Tools and Guidelines

works.title_zh: SHOTPROS：面向压力下警务决策的 VR 训练

works.title: WebXR Device API
works.description: The W3C web standard that lets a page open immersive VR and AR sessions on headsets and phones, with pose tracking, controller and hand input, and AR modules for hit testing, anchors and depth.
