Chromium browsers (including Meta Quest Browser and Chrome on Android XR) and Safari on visionOS implement it; the core spec is a W3C Candidate Recommendation Draft, latest dated 2026-06-09.
works.description_zh: W3C 的网页标准，让网页可以在头显和手机上开启沉浸式 VR 与 AR 会话，提供位姿追踪、手柄与手势输入，以及用于命中测试、锚点和深度的 AR 模块。Chromium 系浏览器（包括 Meta Quest 浏览器与 Android XR 上的 Chrome）以及 visionOS 上的 Safari 都已实现；核心规范为 W3C 候选推荐草案，最新版本日期为 2026-06-09。
works.idea_en: The lowest-friction delivery path for a generated scene: a URL that opens in a headset, which also makes remote and large-sample XR studies feasible.
works.idea_zh: 生成场景门槛最低的交付方式：一个能在头显中打开的网址，这也让远程与大样本 XR 研究变得可行。
works.method: A JavaScript API that supplies per-frame viewer and input poses and an XR-compatible WebGL / WebGPU layer to render into; feature modules add AR capabilities.
works.method_zh: 一个 JavaScript API，逐帧提供观察者与输入设备的位姿，以及可供渲染的 XR 兼容 WebGL / WebGPU 图层；功能模块补充 AR 能力。
works.specs: W3C Candidate Recommendation Draft (2026-06-09) · editors from Google and Meta
works.title_zh: WebXR 设备 API

works.title: Codec Avatars
works.description: Codec Avatars are Meta's photorealistic 3D avatars of real people, captured in multi-camera studios and driven live by cameras inside a VR headset, so two people in headsets see each other's faces in 3D. The best-known public demonstration was the 2023 Lex Fridman interview with Mark Zuckerberg held entirely between Codec Avatars.
works.description_zh: Codec Avatars 是 Meta 为真人打造的照片级三维化身：在多相机影棚中采集，由 VR 头显内部的摄像头实时驱动，让戴着头显的两个人能看到对方的三维面孔。最著名的公开演示是 2023 年 Lex Fridman 与扎克伯格完全通过 Codec Avatars 进行的访谈。
works.idea_en: Set the target that later Gaussian, phone-scan and feed-forward avatars chase: telepresence where a face is encoded, sent and decoded like a codec.
works.idea_zh: 确立了后来的高斯化身、手机扫描化身和前馈化身所追赶的目标：像编解码器一样编码、传输、解码一张脸的远程临场。
works.method: A deep appearance model (variational autoencoder) learns a person-specific latent code of face geometry and view-dependent texture from studio capture; headset cameras regress the code in real time and a decoder renders it.
works.method_zh: 深度外观模型（变分自编码器）从影棚采集数据中学习个人专属的面部几何与视角相关纹理的隐编码；头显摄像头实时回归该编码，再由解码器渲染。

paper.title: Deep appearance models for face rendering

works.title_zh: Codec Avatars 照片级远程临场化身

works.title: AVATAR therapy for auditory verbal hallucinations in people with psychosis: a single-blind, randomised controlled trial
works.description: People who hear persecutory voices created a digital face and voice for their main voice, then held dialogues with it while a therapist spoke as the avatar through a voice transformer and gradually made it less hostile; voices became less severe than with supportive counselling.
works.description_zh: 受迫害性幻听困扰的人为自己听到的主要“声音”创建一张数字面孔和一种声音，然后与它对话；治疗师通过变声器以化身的身份说话，并让它逐渐变得不那么敌意。与支持性咨询相比，幻听的严重程度有所下降。
works.idea_en: A personalized, human-voiced avatar of a patient's tormentor is a clinical use of virtual humans that LLMs could scale but must not let drift.
works.idea_zh: 为患者的“折磨者”定制、由真人配音的化身，是虚拟人的一种临床用途；大语言模型可以让它规模化，但绝不能让它失控偏离。
works.method: Single-blind RCT of AVATAR therapy (invented by Julian Leff in 2008) vs. supportive counselling, with avatars built from patients' descriptions and voiced live by the therapist; the larger AVATAR2 trial followed in 2024.
works.method_zh: 单盲随机对照试验，比较 AVATAR 疗法（由 Julian Leff 于 2008 年提出）与支持性咨询；化身依患者描述制作，由治疗师实时配音。规模更大的 AVATAR2 试验于 2024 年发表。

paper.title: AVATAR therapy for auditory verbal hallucinations in people with psychosis: a single-blind, randomised controlled trial

works.title_zh: AVATAR 疗法治疗精神病患者的言语性幻听：单盲随机对照试验

works.title: Automated psychological therapy using immersive virtual reality for treatment of fear of heights: a single-blind, parallel-group, randomised controlled trial
works.description: Randomized trial in which adults with fear of heights received about six 30-minute VR sessions over two weeks guided by an animated virtual coach, with no therapist present; fear of heights fell substantially compared with usual care.
works.description_zh: 随机试验：恐高的成年人在两周内接受约六次、每次 30 分钟的 VR 治疗，全程由一位动画虚拟教练引导，无需治疗师在场；与常规护理相比，恐高程度明显下降。
works.idea_en: Early rigorous evidence that a fully automated virtual coach can deliver psychological therapy, the precedent for LLM-guided therapy in VR.
works.idea_zh: 早期的严格证据：全自动的虚拟教练也能实施心理治疗，为 VR 中由大语言模型引导的治疗开了先例。
works.method: Single-blind RCT of automated cognitive VR therapy (virtual coach animated from an actor's motion and voice capture) on consumer headsets vs. usual care, with the Heights Interpretation Questionnaire as outcome.
works.method_zh: 单盲随机对照试验：在消费级头显上进行自动化认知 VR 治疗（虚拟教练由演员的动作与声音捕捉驱动），对照为常规护理，以恐高解释问卷为结局指标。

paper.title: Automated psychological therapy using immersive virtual reality for treatment of fear of heights: a single-blind, parallel-group, randomised controlled trial

works.title_zh: 用沉浸式虚拟现实进行自动化心理治疗以治疗恐高：单盲平行组随机对照试验

works.title: Axon VR Training
works.description: VR training for police from the maker of TASER and body cameras. It began in October 2018 with a 360-degree empathy scenario about schizophrenia, followed in 2019 by autism and suicide scenarios; today officers progress from empathy and crisis-response modules to de-escalation, tactical decision-making and simulator drills with replica TASERs and handguns.
works.description_zh: TASER 与执法记录仪制造商 Axon 推出的警务 VR 训练：2018 年 10 月以一个关于精神分裂症的 360° 共情情境起步，2019 年又加入自闭症与自杀相关情境；如今警员从共情与危机应对模块开始，逐步进阶到降级处置、战术决策，以及使用仿真 TASER 和手枪的模拟训练。
works.idea_en: De-escalation is now trained in headsets at police-department scale; Axon says some scenarios adapt in real time, a claim worth testing against scripted branching.
works.idea_zh: 降级处置训练如今已在警局规模上通过头显进行；Axon 称部分情境可实时调整，这一说法值得与脚本分支方案对照检验。
works.method: Authored live-action and CG scenarios on standalone headsets with tracked weapon replicas and instructor controls; adaptivity is developer-reported.
works.method_zh: 在一体机头显上运行的实拍与 CG 编写情境，配有可追踪的仿真武器与教官控制；“自适应”为开发方的说法。

works.title: Building long-term empathy: A large-scale comparison of traditional and virtual reality perspective-taking
works.description: Two experiments compared 'Becoming Homeless', a VR experience of losing one's job and home, with traditional perspective-taking; over eight weeks VR participants held more positive, longer-lasting attitudes toward homeless people and were more likely to sign a petition supporting affordable housing.
works.description_zh: 两项实验把 VR 体验《Becoming Homeless》（经历失业、失去住所）与传统换位思考任务相比较；在八周内，VR 组对无家可归者的态度更积极、更持久，也更愿意签署支持可负担住房的请愿书。
works.idea_en: Embodied perspective-taking can outlast the session; long follow-ups, not post-session ratings, are the right test for a generated empathy scenario.
works.idea_zh: 具身的换位思考可以延续到体验结束之后；检验生成的共情情境，应看长期追踪，而不是体验后的即时评分。
works.method: Large-sample experiments comparing VR, narrative perspective-taking and control conditions (and desktop vs. headset in Study 2), with attitude scales and a petition-signing behavioral measure over eight weeks.
works.method_zh: 大样本实验，比较 VR、叙事式换位思考与对照条件（研究二另比较桌面与头显），在八周内测量态度量表与签署请愿这一行为指标。

paper.title: Building long-term empathy: A large-scale comparison of traditional and virtual reality perspective-taking

works.title_zh: 建立长期共情：传统换位思考与虚拟现实换位思考的大规模比较

works.title: Offenders become the victim in virtual reality: impact of changing perspective in domestic violence
works.description: Male domestic-violence offenders and non-violent controls were embodied in a woman's virtual body while a virtual man verbally abused her; afterwards the offenders recognized fear in female faces better than before.
works.description_zh: 男性家暴罪犯和无暴力史的对照者被赋予一具女性虚拟身体，同时一名虚拟男性对“她”进行言语虐待；体验之后，罪犯识别女性面孔中恐惧情绪的能力有所提高。
works.idea_en: Swapping an offender into the victim's body is an intervention only VR can stage; generation could tailor the abuser, setting and script to each case.
works.idea_zh: 让罪犯换位进入受害者的身体，是只有 VR 才能布置的干预；生成技术可以按个案定制施暴者、场景与台词。
works.method: Full-body ownership illusion through a head-mounted display and motion capture, with emotion-recognition tests before and after the virtual abuse scene.
works.method_zh: 通过头显与动作捕捉诱发全身拥有错觉，并在虚拟施暴场景前后施测情绪识别。

paper.title: Offenders become the victim in virtual reality: impact of changing perspective in domestic violence

works.title_zh: 在虚拟现实中让施暴者成为受害者：家庭暴力中视角转换的影响

works.title: Participant concerns for the Learner in a Virtual Reality replication of the Milgram obedience study
works.description: Forty participants went through a VR version of the Milgram paradigm; compared with 20 controls, they tried to help the virtual Learner by stressing the correct word when reading the test items, a sign of concern for the victim rather than pure obedience.
works.description_zh: 40 名参与者经历了 VR 版米尔格拉姆范式；与 20 名对照者相比，他们在朗读测试题时会刻意加重正确选项来帮助虚拟学习者——这说明他们关心受害者，而非单纯服从。
works.idea_en: Logging fine-grained behavior inside a virtual replication can test theories, here the 'agentic state', that the original paradigm could only argue about.
works.idea_zh: 在虚拟复现中记录细粒度行为，可以检验原范式只能争论的理论（此处为“代理状态”）。
works.method: VR replication with acoustic analysis of how participants read the word pairs, compared with a control group not taken through the simulation.
works.method_zh: VR 复现实验，对参与者朗读词对的语音进行声学分析，并与未经历模拟的对照组比较。

paper.title: Participant concerns for the Learner in a Virtual Reality replication of the Milgram obedience study

works.title_zh: 米尔格拉姆服从实验 VR 复现中参与者对“学习者”的关切

works.title: RealEstate10K
works.description: A dataset of camera trajectories for about 10 million frames from some 80,000 clips of YouTube real-estate walkthrough videos, released by Google with the Stereo Magnification paper. It became the standard testbed for novel-view synthesis and, later, camera-controlled video generation.
works.description_zh: 约 8 万段 YouTube 房产看房视频片段、约 1,000 万帧的相机轨迹数据集，由 Google 随 Stereo Magnification 论文发布。它成为新视角合成、以及后来镜头可控视频生成的标准测试集。
works.idea_en: Ordinary walkthrough footage with recovered camera paths is what taught view-synthesis and camera-controlled video models how indoor space unfolds as you move.
works.idea_zh: 普通的看房视频加上恢复出的镜头路径，让新视角合成与镜头可控视频模型学会了人在室内移动时空间如何展开。
works.method: SLAM and bundle adjustment on walkthrough footage recover per-frame camera intrinsics and poses; the dataset ships poses and video ids, not the videos.
works.method_zh: 对看房视频进行 SLAM 与光束法平差，恢复逐帧相机内参与位姿；数据集提供位姿与视频 ID，不包含视频本身。

paper.title: Stereo Magnification: Learning View Synthesis using Multiplane Images

works.title: Why and how to use virtual reality to study human social interaction: The challenges of exploring a new research landscape
works.description: Review in the British Journal of Psychology on using VR to study face-to-face social interaction: what virtual characters let researchers control, and what is lost when the partner is not a real person.
works.description_zh: 发表于 British Journal of Psychology 的综述，讨论如何用 VR 研究面对面的社会互动：虚拟角色让研究者能控制什么，以及当互动对象不是真人时会失去什么。
works.idea_en: Virtual partners buy precise, repeatable social stimuli at the cost of two-way realism, the gap LLM-driven characters now try to close.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟互动对象以牺牲双向真实感为代价，换来精确、可重复的社会刺激；这正是由大语言模型驱动的角色如今试图弥合的缺口。
works.method: Narrative review with Antonia Hamilton of VR social-interaction paradigms, covering character realism, interaction loops and validity.
works.method_zh: 与 Antonia Hamilton 合作的叙述性综述，涵盖 VR 社会互动范式中的角色真实感、互动回路与效度问题。

paper.title: Why and how to use virtual reality to study human social interaction: The challenges of exploring a new research landscape

works.title_zh: 为何以及如何用虚拟现实研究人类社会互动：探索新研究版图的挑战

works.title: World Models
works.description: An interactive paper in which an agent learns a compressed model of a car-racing game and of VizDoom, then trains entirely inside its own generated 'dream' and transfers the learned policy back to the real game; readers can play inside the dream in the browser.
works.description_zh: 一篇交互式论文：智能体先学会赛车游戏和 VizDoom 的压缩模型，然后完全在自己生成的“梦境”中训练，再把学到的策略迁回真实游戏；读者可以在浏览器里进入这个梦境游玩。
works.idea_en: The lineage starts here: a learned simulator can stand in for the real environment, and its flaws can be exploited by whoever acts inside it.
works.idea_zh: 这条谱系从这里开始：学习得到的模拟器可以替代真实环境，而它的缺陷也可能被身处其中的行动者利用。
works.method: A VAE compresses frames, a mixture-density RNN predicts the next latent state from action, and a small controller is evolved with CMA-ES inside the RNN's rollouts.
works.method_zh: 用 VAE 压缩画面，用混合密度 RNN 根据动作预测下一潜在状态，再在 RNN 的推演中用 CMA-ES 进化一个小型控制器。

paper.venue: NeurIPS 2018 (as 'Recurrent World Models Facilitate Policy Evolution')
paper.title: World Models

works.title_zh: 世界模型（World Models）

works.title: Virtual Burglary: Exploring the Potential of Virtual Reality to Study Burglary in Action
works.description: Seventy-seven male undergraduates walked a virtual neighborhood in a headset and were asked to burgle one house; the system logged their route, the items they stole and their heart rate, while an alarm and beliefs about the chance of being caught were varied.
works.description_zh: 77 名男性本科生戴着头显在虚拟街区中行走，并被要求入室盗窃其中一户；系统记录了他们的路线、偷走的物品和心率，同时操纵是否响起警报以及他们对被抓概率的认知。
works.idea_en: Crime becomes an observable, logged behavior instead of a self-report, the kind of situational reach generated environments could extend to many more offences and settings.
works.idea_zh: 犯罪从自我报告变成了可观察、可记录的行为——生成环境有望把这种情境可达性扩展到更多罪行与场景。
works.method: Free-roaming VR burglary task with experimentally varied alarm and perceived-risk conditions, behavioral logs, heart rate and dispositional measures (self-control, sensation seeking).
works.method_zh: 可自由走动的 VR 盗窃任务，实验操纵警报与感知风险，记录行为日志与心率，并测量自我控制、感觉寻求等个体特质。

paper.venue: Journal of Research in Crime and Delinquency 54(1)
paper.title: Virtual Burglary: Exploring the Potential of Virtual Reality to Study Burglary in Action

works.title_zh: 虚拟入室盗窃：探索用虚拟现实研究“进行中”的盗窃

works.title: Crowd behaviour during high-stress evacuations in an immersive virtual environment
works.description: Groups of real participants, each controlling an avatar in a shared 3D virtual building, reproduced known crowd patterns during normal egress, and a high-stress evacuation condition showed how crowd movement changes under pressure.
works.description_zh: 多组真实参与者在共享的三维虚拟建筑中各自操控一个化身；常规疏散时重现了已知的人群模式，高压疏散条件则展示了人群移动在压力下如何变化。
works.idea_en: Multi-user virtual environments make crowd emergencies experimentally reachable; generated layouts and hazards could extend such tests far beyond one building.
works.idea_zh: 多人虚拟环境让人群紧急情况可以被实验研究；生成的建筑布局与险情可以把这类测试扩展到远不止一栋建筑。
works.method: Networked multi-participant experiments comparing virtual crowd patterns with real-world observations, plus a high-stress evacuation condition.
works.method_zh: 联网的多人实验，把虚拟人群模式与真实世界观察相比较，并加入高压疏散条件。

paper.venue: Journal of the Royal Society Interface 13(122)
paper.title: Crowd behaviour during high-stress evacuations in an immersive virtual environment

works.title_zh: 沉浸式虚拟环境中高压疏散时的人群行为

works.title: Enhancing Our Lives with Immersive Virtual Reality
works.description: Long review in Frontiers in Robotics and AI that surveys how immersive VR has been used in neuroscience, psychology, clinical therapy, training, education and entertainment, sets out its distinctive affordances and adds ethical cautions.
works.description_zh: 发表于 Frontiers in Robotics and AI 的长篇综述，回顾沉浸式 VR 在神经科学、心理学、临床治疗、训练、教育与娱乐中的应用，概括其独特能力，并提出伦理上的提醒。
works.idea_en: VR's value lies in situations that are impossible, dangerous or unethical in reality, including inhabiting another body, which generation could make much cheaper to build.
works.idea_zh: VR 的价值在于现实中不可能、危险或不合伦理的情境——包括进入另一具身体——而生成技术可能大幅降低构建这些情境的成本。
works.method: Narrative review with Maria V. Sanchez-Vives organized around presence, body ownership and application areas.
works.method_zh: 与 Maria V. Sanchez-Vives 合作的叙述性综述，围绕临场感、身体拥有感与应用领域展开。

paper.title: Enhancing Our Lives with Immersive Virtual Reality

works.title_zh: 用沉浸式虚拟现实改善我们的生活

works.title: Conversations between self and self as Sigmund Freud—A virtual body ownership paradigm for self counselling
works.description: Participants explained a personal problem to a virtual counsellor, then swapped into the counsellor's body and answered themselves, hearing their own voice transformed; being embodied as Sigmund Freud when giving the advice improved mood more than counselling from a copy of their own body.
works.description_zh: 参与者先向一位虚拟咨询者讲述个人困扰，再换到咨询者的身体里回答自己，并听到经变声处理的自己的声音；与以“另一个自己”的身体提供建议相比，化身为西格蒙德·弗洛伊德时心情改善更明显。
works.idea_en: The counsellor can be the participant in another body, a design that later work extends with AI agents nudging the self-dialogue.
works.idea_zh: 咨询者可以是换了身体的参与者本人——后续研究在此基础上加入了推动自我对话的 AI 智能体。
works.method: Embodiment experiment with full-body tracking, alternating first-person perspective between participant and counsellor avatars with voice transformation, comparing a Freud body with a self-copy body.
works.method_zh: 具身实验，使用全身追踪，在参与者化身与咨询者化身之间切换第一人称视角并进行变声，比较弗洛伊德身体与“自我复制”身体两种条件。

paper.title: Conversations between self and self as Sigmund Freud—A virtual body ownership paradigm for self counselling

works.title_zh: 以西格蒙德·弗洛伊德身份进行的自我对话：一种用于自我咨询的虚拟身体拥有范式

works.title: High-Quality Streamable Free-Viewpoint Video
works.description: Microsoft's capture-stage system records performers with a dome of synchronised cameras and turns them into streamable textured 3D meshes that can be placed in AR, VR or film.
works.description_zh: 微软的捕捉舞台系统用一圈同步相机录制表演者，并把他们转换为可流式传输的带纹理三维网格，用于 AR、VR 或电影。
works.idea_en: The studio volumetric-video pipeline that preceded Gaussian video, and the baseline it is judged against.
works.idea_zh: 这是高斯视频出现之前的影棚体积视频流程，也是评价高斯视频时的基线。
works.method: Multi-view RGB and infrared stereo give point clouds that are meshed, tracked for temporal coherence, texture-mapped and compressed for streaming.
works.method_zh: 多视角 RGB 与红外立体得到点云，再经网格化、为时间一致性进行追踪、纹理映射并压缩以便流式传输。

paper.title: High-quality streamable free-viewpoint video

works.title_zh: 高质量可流式自由视角视频

works.title: Strivr
works.description: Enterprise VR training that grew out of Stanford's VHIL: 360-degree video and interactive modules let workers rehearse situations such as store rushes or difficult customers, and Walmart deployed it in its training academies. In 2026 its site leads with AI quality assurance on smart glasses while still offering the VR platform.
works.description_zh: 源自斯坦福 VHIL 的企业 VR 培训：员工借助 360° 视频与交互模块演练购物高峰、难缠顾客等情境，沃尔玛在其培训学院中部署了它。截至 2026 年，其官网主推基于智能眼镜的 AI 质检，同时仍提供 VR 平台。
works.idea_en: Filmed 360-degree situations took VR rehearsal to a large retail workforce; the company's next step was AI that watches real work through glasses.
works.idea_zh: 实拍的 360° 情境把 VR 演练带给了庞大的零售员工群体；这家公司的下一步，是让 AI 透过眼镜观察真实工作。
works.method: Captured 360-degree video and authored interactive scenarios delivered on standalone headsets, with analytics on trainee responses.
works.method_zh: 以实拍 360° 视频和人工编写的交互情境在一体机头显上交付，并对受训者的反应进行数据分析。

works.title: It's only a computer: Virtual humans increase willingness to disclose
works.description: People interviewed by the SimSensei virtual human reported less fear of self-disclosure, managed their impressions less and showed sadness more openly when they believed it was fully automated than when they believed a human was operating it.
works.description_zh: 接受 SimSensei 虚拟人访谈的人，若相信对方是全自动的，比相信有人在后台操控时，对自我暴露的顾虑更少、印象管理更少，也更坦然地流露悲伤。
works.idea_en: Believing no human is watching makes people more open, so what participants are told about an AI interlocutor is itself a variable to control.
works.idea_zh: 相信没有真人在看会让人更坦诚——因此告诉参与者对面的 AI 是什么，本身就是需要控制的变量。
works.method: 2x2 design crossing framing (computer vs. human operator) with actual control (automated vs. Wizard-of-Oz), measuring fear of disclosure, impression management and coded emotional expression.
works.method_zh: 2×2 设计，交叉操纵“告知”（计算机 vs. 真人操作）与“实际控制方式”（自动 vs. 绿野仙踪），测量自我暴露顾虑、印象管理与编码后的情绪表达。

paper.title: It's only a computer: Virtual humans increase willingness to disclose

works.title_zh: “它只是台计算机”：虚拟人提高人们的自我披露意愿

works.title: Mursion
works.description: Simulation platform where employees and teachers rehearse difficult conversations with avatars; trained simulation specialists voice and steer the avatars live, and by 2026 Mursion presents itself as an AI-powered upskilling platform.
works.description_zh: 一个让员工与教师和化身演练艰难对话的模拟平台：经过训练的模拟专员实时为化身配音并操控其行为；截至 2026 年，Mursion 把自己定位为 AI 驱动的技能提升平台。
works.idea_en: A human-in-the-loop virtual human shows what full reactivity looks like at scale; LLM agents are measured against this Wizard-of-Oz baseline.
works.idea_zh: 人在回路的虚拟人展示了大规模下“全面反应性”是什么样子；大语言模型智能体正是以这条“绿野仙踪”基线来衡量的。
works.method: Avatars puppeteered in real time by a trained human operator (voice, expression, behavior) following scenario guides and coaching; the company now also advertises AI-powered simulations.
works.method_zh: 由受过训练的真人操作员按情境指引实时操控化身（声音、表情、行为）并配合教练反馈；公司如今也宣传 AI 驱动的模拟。

works.title: PlayCanvas Engine
works.description: An MIT-licensed web graphics runtime (WebGL, WebGPU, WebXR, glTF) that has become one of the main browser renderers for Gaussian splats; PlayCanvas, owned by Snap, also builds the SuperSplat editor. Engine 2.20 (June 2026) added splat relighting, soft shadows and depth of field, streaming of scenes with billions of splats, and WebXR on WebGPU.
works.description_zh: 以 MIT 许可开源的网页图形运行时（WebGL、WebGPU、WebXR、glTF），已成为浏览器中渲染高斯泼溅的主要引擎之一；隶属 Snap 的 PlayCanvas 还开发了 SuperSplat 编辑器。引擎 2.20 版（2026 年 6 月）加入了泼溅重打光、软阴影与景深、数十亿泼溅点场景的流式加载，以及基于 WebGPU 的 WebXR。
works.idea_en: Generated worlds can ship as a link: a participant opens a splat scene in a desktop or headset browser with nothing to install.
works.idea_zh: 生成的世界可以以链接形式交付：被试在电脑或头显浏览器中直接打开泼溅场景，无需安装任何东西。
works.method: JavaScript / TypeScript engine with an entity-component system, a GPU splat renderer that sorts and rasterizes Gaussians, and WebXR session support.
works.method_zh: JavaScript / TypeScript 引擎，采用实体组件系统，带有在 GPU 上排序并光栅化高斯的泼溅渲染器，并支持 WebXR 会话。
works.specs: MIT · ~17k GitHub stars (Oct 2026) · v2.20 (2026-06) · billions of splats via streaming (PlayCanvas claim)

works.title: Reconsidering Fidelity in Simulation-Based Training
works.description: Commentary in Academic Medicine arguing that 'fidelity' should be replaced by physical resemblance and functional task alignment, and that learning is driven by engagement and correspondence with the task rather than surface realism.
works.description_zh: 发表于 Academic Medicine 的评论文章，主张用“物理相似性”与“功能任务一致性”取代笼统的“保真度”，并指出推动学习的是投入度以及与任务的对应，而非表面真实感。
works.idea_en: Generated realism is not the goal: a training scenario needs the cues that matter for the task, which is cheaper and more testable than photorealism.
works.idea_zh: 生成的真实感本身不是目标：训练情境需要的是对任务有意义的线索——这比照片级真实更便宜，也更容易检验。
works.method: Conceptual analysis of the simulation-training literature by Hamstra, Brydges, Hatala, Zendejas and Cook.
works.method_zh: Hamstra、Brydges、Hatala、Zendejas 与 Cook 对模拟训练文献的概念分析。

paper.title: Reconsidering Fidelity in Simulation-Based Training

works.title_zh: 重新审视模拟训练中的保真度

works.title: SimSensei Kiosk: a virtual human interviewer for healthcare decision support
works.description: Virtual human interviewer 'Ellie' who asks people about their lives and wellbeing while the MultiSense module tracks face, gaze, posture and voice; she gives listening feedback and follow-up questions, and the system extracts indicators of depression, anxiety and PTSD.
works.description_zh: 虚拟人访谈者“Ellie”询问受访者的生活与身心状况，同时 MultiSense 模块追踪面部、视线、姿态与语音；她会给出倾听反馈并追问，系统据此提取抑郁、焦虑与 PTSD 的指标。
works.idea_en: Built in three cycles, from face-to-face data to Wizard-of-Oz to full automation, the method a generative interviewer would still need to follow.
works.idea_zh: 经过三轮开发：从面对面访谈数据，到“绿野仙踪”原型，再到全自动——生成式访谈者仍然需要走这条方法路线。
works.method: Analysis of human interviews, a Wizard-of-Oz prototype with two operators choosing speech and gestures, then an automated system with multimodal perception, rule-based dialogue policies and authored utterances.
works.method_zh: 先分析真人访谈，再做由两名操作员选择话语与手势的“绿野仙踪”原型，最后实现具备多模态感知、基于规则的对话策略与预编写话语的全自动系统。

paper.title: SimSensei Kiosk: a virtual human interviewer for healthcare decision support

works.title_zh: SimSensei Kiosk：用于医疗决策支持的虚拟人访谈者

works.title: Virtual Reality Job Interview Training in Adults with Autism Spectrum Disorder
works.description: Randomized trial of Virtual Reality Job Interview Training, in which adults with autism repeatedly interview with a virtual hiring manager ('Molly Porter') whose difficulty can be raised and who gives feedback; trainees improved their role-play interview performance compared with controls.
works.description_zh: 虚拟现实求职面试训练（VR-JIT）的随机试验：自闭症成年人反复与虚拟招聘经理“Molly Porter”面试，难度可逐级提高并附带反馈；与对照组相比，受训者的模拟面试表现有所提升。
works.idea_en: Graded difficulty and endless repetition with a virtual interviewer already worked with branching scripts; generation removes the authoring ceiling, not the need for trials.
works.idea_zh: 分级难度加上与虚拟面试官的无限次重复，在分支脚本时代就已奏效；生成技术解除的是编写上限，而不是对试验验证的需要。
works.method: Randomized controlled efficacy trial of SIMmersion's branching-dialogue simulator, assessed with role-play interviews before and after training.
works.method_zh: 对 SIMmersion 分支对话模拟器的随机对照疗效试验，在训练前后以模拟面试评估。

paper.venue: Journal of Autism and Developmental Disorders 44
paper.title: Virtual Reality Job Interview Training in Adults with Autism Spectrum Disorder

works.title_zh: 自闭症谱系障碍成人的虚拟现实求职面试训练

works.title: Babylon.js
works.description: Microsoft's open-source (Apache-2.0) JavaScript rendering and game engine for the web, with WebXR, WebGPU and Gaussian-splat support. Babylon.js 9.0 shipped on 2026-03-26.
works.description_zh: 微软以 Apache-2.0 许可开源的网页 JavaScript 渲染与游戏引擎，支持 WebXR、WebGPU 与高斯泼溅。Babylon.js 9.0 于 2026-03-26 发布。
works.idea_en: A second mature open web engine for splat and WebXR delivery, useful when a study needs browser-based 3D without lock-in to one vendor.
works.idea_zh: 另一款成熟的开源网页引擎，可交付泼溅与 WebXR 内容；当研究需要在浏览器中呈现三维内容、又不想绑定单一厂商时很有用。
works.method: TypeScript engine with a node-based material editor, physics, WebXR experience helpers and a splat renderer, running on WebGL2 or WebGPU.
works.method_zh: TypeScript 引擎，带节点式材质编辑器、物理、WebXR 体验辅助工具与泼溅渲染器，运行于 WebGL2 或 WebGPU。

works.title: Bystander Responses to a Violent Incident in an Immersive Virtual Environment
works.description: Forty male Arsenal supporters watched an argument in a virtual bar escalate into violence; they intervened more often when the victim was a fellow Arsenal supporter, supporting a social-identity account of bystander behavior.
works.description_zh: 40 名男性阿森纳球迷在虚拟酒吧中目睹一场争执升级为暴力；当受害者也是阿森纳球迷时，他们更常出手干预，支持了用社会认同解释旁观者行为的观点。
works.idea_en: Violence that cannot be staged becomes a controlled 2x2 experiment, the template for generating many variants of a dangerous social scene.
works.idea_zh: 无法真实布置的暴力场景被变成可控的 2×2 实验——为生成大量危险社会场景的变体提供了样板。
works.method: Two-factor between-groups design (victim in-group vs. out-group x victim looks or does not look at the participant) with life-size virtual characters; interventions coded from recordings.
works.method_zh: 双因素组间设计（受害者为同群体 vs. 外群体 × 受害者是否望向参与者），使用真人大小的虚拟角色，并根据录像编码干预行为。

paper.title: Bystander Responses to a Violent Incident in an Immersive Virtual Environment

works.title_zh: 沉浸式虚拟环境中旁观者对暴力事件的反应

works.title: Putting yourself in the skin of a black avatar reduces implicit racial bias
works.description: Light-skinned participants embodied in a dark-skinned virtual body that moved with them showed lower implicit racial bias afterwards than participants in the other body conditions.
works.description_zh: 肤色较浅的参与者被赋予一具随自己动作而动的深肤色虚拟身体后，其内隐种族偏见低于其他身体条件下的参与者。
works.idea_en: Full-body ownership of a different identity measurably shifts attitudes, a strong and ethically loaded manipulation for any generated-avatar study.
works.idea_zh: 对另一种身份的全身拥有感能可测地改变态度——对任何使用生成化身的研究而言，这都是一种强效且有伦理分量的操纵。
works.method: Between-groups embodiment experiment with full-body motion capture and a virtual mirror; Implicit Association Test before and after exposure.
works.method_zh: 组间具身实验，使用全身动作捕捉与虚拟镜子，在体验前后施测内隐联想测验。

paper.title: Putting yourself in the skin of a black avatar reduces implicit racial bias

works.title_zh: 进入黑人化身的皮肤可降低内隐种族偏见

works.title: Increasing Saving Behavior Through Age-Progressed Renderings of the Future Self
works.description: Participants who met an age-progressed avatar of themselves in a virtual mirror, and in later studies on screen, put more money into a hypothetical retirement account than those who saw their current-age avatar.
works.description_zh: 在虚拟镜子中（后续研究中也在屏幕上）见到自己“变老”化身的参与者，比看到当前年龄化身的人，向假想的退休账户投入了更多钱。
works.idea_en: A generated self from another point in time can shift a real economic decision, an early case of synthetic faces used as a behavioral intervention.
works.idea_zh: 一个来自另一时间点的“生成的自己”就能改变真实的经济决策——这是把合成面孔用作行为干预的早期案例。
works.method: Series of experiments with Stanford VHIL using age-morphed 3D avatars, measuring hypothetical savings allocations.
works.method_zh: 与斯坦福 VHIL 合作的系列实验，使用经年龄变形的三维化身，测量假想储蓄的分配。

paper.title: Increasing Saving Behavior Through Age-Progressed Renderings of the Future Self

works.title_zh: 以年龄增长后的“未来自我”形象提升储蓄行为

works.title: Virtual Reality as an Adjunctive Non-pharmacologic Analgesic for Acute Burn Pain During Medical Procedures
works.description: Review of SnowWorld, the University of Washington VR world in which burn patients throw snowballs at snowmen and penguins during wound care; patients report 35-50% less procedural pain while immersed, and fMRI shows lower pain-related brain activity.
works.description_zh: 关于 SnowWorld 的综述：在这个华盛顿大学开发的 VR 世界里，烧伤患者在换药时向雪人和企鹅扔雪球；患者报告沉浸期间操作疼痛降低 35%–50%，功能磁共振成像也显示与疼痛相关的脑活动下降。
works.idea_en: Immersion itself works like a dose: attention drawn into a virtual world is attention taken from pain, so stronger immersion can mean stronger effect.
works.idea_zh: 沉浸本身就像一种剂量：被虚拟世界吸引走的注意力，就是从疼痛那里拿走的注意力，因此沉浸越强，效果可能越强。
works.method: Review of clinical and laboratory studies by Hoffman's group, including water-friendly and robot-arm-mounted headsets for hydrotank wound care.
works.method_zh: 回顾 Hoffman 团队的临床与实验室研究，包括可用于水疗换药的防水头显与机械臂支架头显。

paper.title: Virtual Reality as an Adjunctive Non-pharmacologic Analgesic for Acute Burn Pain During Medical Procedures

works.title_zh: SnowWorld：虚拟现实作为医疗操作中急性烧伤疼痛的非药物辅助镇痛

works.title: Place illusion and plausibility can lead to realistic behaviour in immersive virtual environments
works.description: Theory paper that splits presence into place illusion (the sense of being there, set by sensorimotor contingencies) and plausibility illusion (the sense that what happens is really happening), and argues that the two together produce realistic behavior.
works.description_zh: 理论论文，把临场感拆分为“地点错觉”（身处其中之感，由感觉运动的一致性决定）与“似真错觉”（觉得正在发生的事是真的），并论证二者结合才会引发真实的行为反应。
works.idea_en: Rendering quality buys place illusion; plausibility comes from credible events that respond to you, which is what generative agents and world models have to supply.
works.idea_zh: 渲染质量换来地点错觉；似真错觉则来自会回应你且可信的事件——这正是生成式智能体与世界模型必须提供的。
works.method: Conceptual analysis drawing on earlier presence experiments, defining immersion as the set of valid sensorimotor actions a system supports.
works.method_zh: 基于以往临场感实验的概念分析，把“沉浸”定义为系统所支持的有效感觉运动动作的集合。

paper.venue: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B (2009)
paper.title: Place illusion and plausibility can lead to realistic behaviour in immersive virtual environments

works.title_zh: 地点错觉与似真错觉可在沉浸式虚拟环境中引发真实行为

works.title: Building Interactive Virtual Humans for Training Environments
works.description: I/ITSEC paper from USC ICT describing the architecture of interactive virtual humans for training: speech recognition, language understanding, dialogue management, emotion modeling, nonverbal behavior generation and rendering, with examples from ICT's negotiation and virtual-patient trainers.
works.description_zh: USC ICT 在 I/ITSEC 发表的论文，介绍训练用交互式虚拟人的架构：语音识别、语言理解、对话管理、情绪建模、非语言行为生成与渲染，并以 ICT 的谈判训练与虚拟病人系统为例。
works.idea_en: The pre-LLM blueprint: every module of a training virtual human was hand-built and authored, the cost that generative models now remove and the control they put at risk.
works.idea_zh: 大语言模型之前的蓝图：训练用虚拟人的每个模块都需手工构建与编写——这正是生成模型如今省去的成本，也是它们可能削弱的可控性。
works.method: System overview of ICT's integrated virtual human architecture and the authoring work behind its training applications.
works.method_zh: 对 ICT 集成式虚拟人架构及其训练应用背后的内容编写工作的系统性介绍。

paper.title: Building Interactive Virtual Humans for Training Environments

works.title_zh: 为训练环境构建交互式虚拟人

works.title: The Proteus Effect: The Effect of Transformed Self-Representation on Behavior
works.description: Two VR experiments: participants given more attractive avatars walked closer to a confederate and disclosed more, and participants given taller avatars behaved more confidently in a negotiation, independent of how others saw them.
works.description_zh: 两项 VR 实验：被分配到更有吸引力化身的参与者与实验助手站得更近、自我披露更多；被分配到更高化身的参与者在谈判中表现得更自信——与他人如何看待他们无关。
works.idea_en: The body you are given is an experimental variable: generated avatars change behavior, not just appearance.
works.idea_zh: 你被赋予的身体本身就是实验变量：生成的化身改变的不只是外观，还有行为。
works.method: Between-subjects head-mounted-display studies manipulating avatar attractiveness (Study 1) and height (Study 2), measuring interpersonal distance, self-disclosure and negotiation outcomes.
works.method_zh: 使用头显的被试间实验，分别操纵化身吸引力（研究一）与身高（研究二），测量人际距离、自我披露与谈判结果。
keywords: Stanford news video on VHIL avatar research

paper.title: The Proteus Effect: The Effect of Transformed Self-Representation on Behavior

works.title_zh: 普罗透斯效应：变换后的自我呈现对行为的影响

works.title: The validity of a virtual human experience for interpersonal skills education
works.description: Thirty-three second-year medical students interviewed a life-size virtual patient in a Virtual Objective Structured Clinical Examination (VOSCE) and were graded on interview skills; their scores were compared with an exam using a human standardized patient.
works.description_zh: 33 名二年级医学生在“虚拟客观结构化临床考试”（VOSCE）中问诊一位真人大小的虚拟病人并接受问诊技能评分，其成绩与面对真人标准化病人的考试成绩进行了比较。
works.idea_en: Validation against the real-world exam is the step most LLM virtual-patient papers still skip.
works.idea_zh: 以真实考试作为效度标准——这正是多数大语言模型虚拟病人论文至今仍跳过的一步。
works.method: Comparison of interview performance with a projected life-size virtual human (speech-recognition dialogue) and with a human standardized patient, as part of a medical-school course requirement.
works.method_zh: 作为医学院课程要求的一部分，比较学生面对投影的真人大小虚拟人（语音识别对话）与面对真人标准化病人时的问诊表现。

paper.title: The validity of a virtual human experience for interpersonal skills education

works.title_zh: 虚拟人体验用于人际技能教育的效度

works.title: Virtual Standardized Patients (Justin, Justina)
works.description: Life-size virtual patients from USC ICT, such as an adolescent with conduct disorder and a young woman with PTSD after sexual assault, that clinicians in training interview by speaking; the patient answers with authored lines chosen by a language-understanding module.
works.description_zh: USC ICT 开发的真人大小虚拟病人，例如患有品行障碍的青少年、遭受性侵后患 PTSD 的年轻女性；受训临床人员直接开口问诊，病人从预先编写的台词中作答，由语言理解模块挑选。
works.idea_en: Standardized patients that never tire and never drift: the consistency LLM-driven patients trade for breadth.
works.idea_zh: 永不疲倦、从不走样的标准化病人：大语言模型驱动的病人正是以牺牲这种一致性换取应答广度。
works.method: Statistical classification of trainee questions into authored response sets, animated with ICT's virtual human technology and evaluated with psychiatry residents and social-work students.
works.method_zh: 把受训者的提问统计分类到预先编写的应答集合中，以 ICT 的虚拟人技术驱动动画，并由精神科住院医师与社会工作专业学生参与评估。

paper.venue: Journal of Virtual Reality and Broadcasting 8 (2011)
paper.title: Intelligent Virtual Patients for Training Clinical Skills

works.title_zh: 虚拟标准化病人（Justin、Justina）

works.title: A Virtual Reprise of the Stanley Milgram Obedience Experiments
works.description: Participants gave word-association tests to a female virtual Learner and administered 'shocks' for wrong answers while she protested; those who could see and hear her showed stress responses and some withdrew, although everyone knew she was not real.
works.description_zh: 参与者对一位女性虚拟“学习者”进行词语联想测试，并在她答错时施以“电击”，她会出声抗议。能看见、听见她的参与者出现了应激反应，有些人中途退出——尽管所有人都知道她不是真人。
works.idea_en: Proof that people respond to extreme virtual social situations as if they were real, which makes ethically impossible paradigms studiable and means generated situations need ethical review too.
works.idea_zh: 证明人们会把极端的虚拟社会情境当真来反应：原本因伦理而无法开展的范式由此可以研究，也意味着生成的情境同样需要伦理审查。
works.method: Between-groups experiment (Learner seen and heard vs. text-only interaction) in a CAVE-like projection system, with skin conductance, heart rate and behavioral measures, following Milgram's procedure.
works.method_zh: 组间实验（能看见并听见学习者 vs. 仅文字交互），在类 CAVE 投影系统中按米尔格拉姆的程序进行，测量皮肤电、心率与行为指标。

paper.title: A Virtual Reprise of the Stanley Milgram Obedience Experiments

works.title_zh: 米尔格拉姆服从实验的虚拟重现

works.title: Bravemind
works.description: VR exposure therapy for combat-related PTSD that grew out of 'Virtual Iraq': a clinician places the patient in customizable Iraq and Afghanistan scenes and adds sounds, smells, explosions and vibration step by step as the patient recounts the trauma.
works.description_zh: 针对战争相关 PTSD 的 VR 暴露疗法，脱胎于“Virtual Iraq”：临床医生把患者带入可定制的伊拉克和阿富汗场景，随着患者讲述创伤，逐步加入声音、气味、爆炸与震动。
works.idea_en: A clinician who adjusts stimuli in real time is the original adaptive immersive situation; generation would widen the scene library each clinician can draw on.
works.idea_zh: 由临床医生实时调整刺激，是最早的自适应沉浸情境；生成技术能扩大每位医生可调用的场景库。
works.method: Prolonged exposure therapy delivered with a head-mounted display, a clinician control panel for stimulus onset and multisensory add-ons, evaluated in open trials and randomized trials.
works.method_zh: 以头显实施延长暴露疗法，配有供临床医生控制刺激出现的面板和多感官装置，并经开放试验与随机试验评估。

paper.title: Clinical Virtual Reality tools to advance the prevention, assessment, and treatment of PTSD

works.title: An Experiment on Public Speaking Anxiety in Response to Three Different Types of Virtual Audience
works.description: People gave five-minute talks to an audience of eight virtual men that stayed neutral, behaved warmly, or showed boredom and hostility; the negative audience produced anxiety even though speakers knew the audience was virtual.
works.description_zh: 参与者向八名虚拟男性听众做五分钟演讲，听众或保持中性，或表现友善，或显出厌倦与敌意；尽管演讲者知道听众是虚拟的，负面听众仍引发了焦虑。
works.idea_en: Even low-fidelity virtual characters evoke social threat when their behavior signals judgement, the basis of every virtual-audience trainer since.
works.idea_zh: 只要表现出评判意味，即便是低保真的虚拟角色也会引发社会威胁感——此后所有虚拟听众训练系统都以此为基础。
works.method: Between-groups experiment (neutral, positive, negative audience) with self-reported anxiety and speaker-confidence measures, run at University College London.
works.method_zh: 在伦敦大学学院进行的组间实验（中性、积极、消极听众），测量自评焦虑与演讲自信。

paper.title: An Experiment on Public Speaking Anxiety in Response to Three Different Types of Virtual Audience

works.title_zh: 面对三种虚拟听众时的公开演讲焦虑实验

works.title: Immersive Virtual Environment Technology as a Methodological Tool for Social Psychology
works.description: Target article in Psychological Inquiry proposing immersive virtual environments as a social-psychology method: experimenters can hold a realistic situation constant across participants, replicate it exactly, and use virtual humans in place of confederates.
works.description_zh: 发表于 Psychological Inquiry 的靶文章，提出把沉浸式虚拟环境作为社会心理学研究方法：实验者可以让每位参与者面对同样逼真的情境，精确复现实验，并用虚拟人代替实验助手。
works.idea_en: The founding claim of the field: VR eases the trade-off between experimental control and realism, and generated situations keep the method only if they keep that control.
works.idea_zh: 这一领域的奠基主张：VR 缓解了实验控制与真实感之间的取舍；生成式情境只有保住这种可控性，才算保住了这一方法。
works.method: Conceptual target article reviewing early immersive-VR studies and the method's advantages and limits, followed by peer commentaries in the same issue.
works.method_zh: 概念性靶文章，回顾早期沉浸式 VR 研究，阐述这一方法的优势与局限，同期附有同行评论。

paper.title: Immersive Virtual Environment Technology as a Methodological Tool for Social Psychology

works.title_zh: 沉浸式虚拟环境技术：社会心理学的方法论工具

works.title: Effectiveness of computer-generated (virtual reality) graded exposure in the treatment of acrophobia
works.description: Early controlled study of VR exposure therapy: students with fear of heights rode a virtual glass elevator, crossed bridges and stood on balconies at increasing heights in a head-mounted display, and showed less anxiety and avoidance than a waiting-list group.
works.description_zh: VR 暴露疗法的早期对照研究：恐高的大学生戴上头显，在逐渐升高的位置乘坐虚拟玻璃电梯、走过桥梁、站上阳台，与候补组相比焦虑和回避都有所减轻。
works.idea_en: Graded exposure needs only a believable ladder of situations, which is why VR therapy worked with 1995 graphics and why generation's contribution is breadth and personalization.
works.idea_zh: 分级暴露只需要一组可信的情境阶梯——这就是 1995 年的图形也能奏效的原因，而生成技术的贡献在于广度与个性化。
works.method: Controlled comparison of graded VR exposure with a waiting-list control, with anxiety, avoidance and attitude measures, by Rothbaum, Hodges and colleagues at Emory University and Georgia Tech.
works.method_zh: 埃默里大学与佐治亚理工学院的 Rothbaum、Hodges 等人进行的对照比较：分级 VR 暴露 vs. 候补对照，测量焦虑、回避与态度。

paper.title: Effectiveness of computer-generated (virtual reality) graded exposure in the treatment of acrophobia

works.title_zh: 计算机生成（虚拟现实）分级暴露治疗恐高症的疗效

works.title: The role of deliberate practice in the acquisition of expert performance
works.description: Psychological Review paper showing that expert musicians differ from less accomplished peers mainly in accumulated hours of deliberate practice: effortful, goal-directed practice with immediate feedback and repetition, designed to improve performance.
works.description_zh: 发表于 Psychological Review 的论文，表明顶尖音乐家与水平较低的同侪的主要差别在于累计的刻意练习时长——即有明确目标、伴随即时反馈与重复、专门用于提升表现的费力练习。
works.idea_en: Training value comes from many targeted repetitions with feedback at the edge of ability, which adaptive generated scenarios can offer at scale.
works.idea_zh: 训练的价值来自大量有针对性、带反馈、处在能力边缘的重复——这正是自适应生成情境可以规模化提供的。
works.method: Theoretical framework plus retrospective diary and interview studies of violinists and pianists at a Berlin music academy.
works.method_zh: 理论框架，加上对柏林一所音乐学院小提琴与钢琴学生的回溯性日记与访谈研究。

paper.title: The role of deliberate practice in the acquisition of expert performance

works.title_zh: 刻意练习在获得专家级表现中的作用

works.title: Defining Virtual Reality: Dimensions Determining Telepresence
works.description: Paper in the Journal of Communication that defines virtual reality by the experience of telepresence rather than by hardware, and names two technology variables that determine it: vividness (breadth and depth of sensory information) and interactivity (speed, range and mapping of user control).
works.description_zh: 发表于 Journal of Communication 的论文，以“远程临场”这种体验而非硬件来定义虚拟现实，并提出决定它的两个技术维度：生动性（感官信息的广度与深度）与交互性（用户控制的速度、范围与映射）。
works.idea_en: Vividness and interactivity are still the two axes generative systems are judged on: how rich the generated world is, and how fast and how widely it answers back.
works.idea_zh: 生动性与交互性仍是评判生成系统的两条轴线：生成的世界有多丰富，回应得有多快、多广。
works.method: Conceptual paper that classifies media technologies along the vividness and interactivity dimensions.
works.method_zh: 概念性论文，按生动性与交互性两个维度对媒介技术进行分类。

paper.title: Defining Virtual Reality: Dimensions Determining Telepresence

works.title_zh: 定义虚拟现实：决定远程临场感的维度

works.title: Representative design and probabilistic theory in a functional psychology
works.description: Classic Psychological Review paper arguing that psychology should sample stimulus situations from the environments people actually live in, as carefully as it samples participants, instead of isolating single variables in artificial set-ups.
works.description_zh: 发表于 Psychological Review 的经典论文，主张心理学应像抽样被试那样，认真地从人们真实生活的环境中抽样刺激情境，而不是在人为布置中孤立单一变量。
works.idea_en: Representative design is the methodological case for generative situations: produce many ecologically sampled variants of a scene instead of one hand-built version.
works.idea_zh: 代表性设计为生成式情境提供了方法论依据：与其手工搭建一个场景，不如生成大量按生态学原则抽样的变体。
works.method: Theoretical argument within Brunswik's probabilistic functionalism (the lens model), contrasting systematic and representative experimental designs.
works.method_zh: 在 Brunswik 的概率功能主义（透镜模型）框架内的理论论证，对比系统设计与代表性设计两种实验思路。

paper.title: Representative design and probabilistic theory in a functional psychology

works.title_zh: 功能心理学中的代表性设计与概率理论

orgs.name: 3D Arena
orgs.description: Hugging Face arena where people vote between pairs of generated 3D models to rank image-to-3D generators.
orgs.description_zh: Hugging Face 上的竞技场，用户在成对的生成三维模型之间投票，为图生三维模型排名。

orgs.name: 80 Level
orgs.description: Industry site for game and 3D artists that tracks generative 3D, splatting and real-time tools as they enter production.
orgs.description_zh: 面向游戏与三维美术从业者的行业网站，追踪生成式三维、高斯泼溅与实时工具进入生产流程的进展。

orgs.name: ACM CHI
orgs.description: The ACM Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems, the largest HCI venue, where generative XR systems, LLM agent studies and VR user studies are published.
orgs.description_zh: ACM 人机交互大会，规模最大的人机交互会议，生成式 XR 系统、大模型智能体研究与 VR 用户研究在此发表。

orgs.name: ACM IVA (Intelligent Virtual Agents)
orgs.description: ACM conference on intelligent virtual agents: embodied conversational characters, nonverbal behavior generation and their use in training, health and research.
orgs.description_zh: ACM 智能虚拟智能体会议：关注具身对话角色、非语言行为生成，以及它们在训练、健康与研究中的应用。

orgs.name: ACM SIGGRAPH & SIGGRAPH Asia
orgs.description: The main computer graphics conferences, where NeRF-era rendering, 3D Gaussian Splatting, avatar and motion-generation papers appear, along with an Immersive Pavilion and Real-Time Live demos.
orgs.description_zh: 最重要的计算机图形学会议，NeRF 时代的渲染、3D 高斯泼溅、虚拟人与动作生成论文在此发表，并设有沉浸式展区与 Real-Time Live 实时演示。

orgs.name: ACM Transactions on Graphics (TOG)
orgs.description: The leading graphics journal, which publishes SIGGRAPH and SIGGRAPH Asia technical papers, among them 3D Gaussian Splatting and instant-ngp.
orgs.description_zh: 最重要的图形学期刊，刊载 SIGGRAPH 与 SIGGRAPH Asia 的技术论文，包括 3D 高斯泼溅与 instant-ngp。

orgs.name: ACM UIST
orgs.description: ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology, where Generative Agents won a best paper in 2023 and many AR authoring and AI-in-the-loop systems debut.
orgs.description_zh: ACM 用户界面软件与技术研讨会，《Generative Agents》于 2023 年在此获最佳论文，许多 AR 创作与人机协同 AI 系统在此首次发表。

orgs.name: AI at Meta (FAIR & Superintelligence Labs)
orgs.description: Meta's AI research groups, which released V-JEPA 2 world models, the Seamless Interaction dataset and models of two-person face-to-face behavior, and SAM 3D; the research page now leads with its 2026 Muse models.
orgs.description_zh: Meta 的人工智能研究部门，发布了 V-JEPA 2 世界模型、刻画双人面对面行为的 Seamless Interaction 数据集与模型，以及 SAM 3D；其研究主页现以 2026 年的 Muse 系列模型为首。

orgs.name: AIF (Runway AI Festival)
orgs.description: Runway's annual festival, started in 2023 as the AI Film Festival, that screens short films made with generative video tools.
orgs.description_zh: Runway 主办的年度节展，2023 年以“AI 电影节”名义创办，放映使用生成式视频工具制作的短片。

orgs.name: Albert "Skip" Rizzo
orgs.description: Director for Medical Virtual Reality at the USC Institute for Creative Technologies, behind the Bravemind VR exposure therapy for PTSD and virtual standardized patients for clinical training.
orgs.description_zh: 南加州大学创意技术研究所（ICT）医疗虚拟现实主任，主导了用于创伤后应激障碍的 Bravemind VR 暴露疗法，以及用于临床培训的虚拟标准化病人。

orgs.name: Aleksander Holynski
orgs.description: Professor at Columbia University who also leads a Google DeepMind team on generative 3D and world models; co-author of InstructPix2Pix, CAT3D and CAT4D, which turn a few images into 3D and 4D scenes with multi-view diffusion.
orgs.description_zh: 哥伦比亚大学教授，同时在 Google DeepMind 领导生成式三维与世界模型团队；InstructPix2Pix、CAT3D 与 CAT4D 的共同作者，这些方法用多视角扩散把少量图像变成三维与四维场景。

orgs.name: Alexandre Défossez
orgs.description: Founding member and Chief Exploration Officer of Kyutai; lead author of Moshi and, earlier at Meta, of the EnCodec audio codec, the Demucs source separator and MusicGen.
orgs.description_zh: Kyutai 创始成员、首席探索官（Chief Exploration Officer）；Moshi 的主要作者，此前在 Meta 主导了 EnCodec 音频编解码器、Demucs 音源分离与 MusicGen。

orgs.name: Alibaba Tongyi Wan
orgs.description: Alibaba's Tongyi Lab video family; Wan 2.1 and 2.2 were released as open weights and became a common base for open video research and fine-tunes.
orgs.description_zh: 阿里巴巴通义实验室的视频模型系列；Wan 2.1 与 2.2 以开源权重发布，成为开源视频研究与微调的常用底座。

orgs.name: Amit Jain
orgs.description: Co-founder and CEO of Luma AI, which moved from NeRF capture apps to the Dream Machine and Ray video models and now describes its mission as general physical AI.
orgs.description_zh: Luma AI 联合创始人兼首席执行官；Luma 从 NeRF 拍摄应用起步，推出 Dream Machine 与 Ray 系列视频模型，如今把使命描述为“通用物理 AI”。

orgs.name: Angjoo Kanazawa
orgs.description: Associate professor at UC Berkeley who leads the Kanazawa AI Research (KAIR) lab; her group builds the open tools many splatting projects run on (Nerfstudio, gsplat) and methods for 4D reconstruction of people and scenes from casual video. She has advised Luma AI and Wonder Dynamics.
orgs.description_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校副教授，领导 Kanazawa AI Research（KAIR）实验室；其团队开发了众多高斯泼溅项目所依赖的开源工具（Nerfstudio、gsplat），以及从随手拍视频中进行人物与场景 4D 重建的方法。她曾担任 Luma AI 与 Wonder Dynamics 的顾问。

orgs.name: Antonia Hamilton
orgs.description: Professor of social neuroscience at UCL's Institute of Cognitive Neuroscience who studies imitation, gaze and nonverbal coordination in face-to-face interaction, using motion capture and virtual characters.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦大学学院认知神经科学研究所社会神经科学教授，借助动作捕捉与虚拟角色研究面对面互动中的模仿、注视与非语言协调。
known_for: Why and how to use virtual reality to study human social interaction (with Pan, 2018)

orgs.name: Arena (formerly LMArena)
orgs.description: The crowd-voted model ranking site that grew out of Chatbot Arena and LMArena; besides text it ranks text-to-video, image-to-video and image models.
orgs.description_zh: 从 Chatbot Arena 与 LMArena 发展而来的众包投票模型排名网站；除文本模型外，也对文生视频、图生视频与图像模型排名。

orgs.name: Artificial Analysis Speech Arena
orgs.description: Blind human-preference arena ranking text-to-speech models and voices, with price and latency comparisons.
orgs.description_zh: 盲测人类偏好竞技场，对文本转语音模型与声音进行排名，并比较价格与延迟。

orgs.name: Artificial Analysis Video Arena
orgs.description: Blind pairwise human-preference arena with Elo rankings for text-to-video and image-to-video models, with and without audio, alongside price and speed data.
orgs.description_zh: 盲测两两比较的人类偏好竞技场，为文生视频与图生视频模型（含声音与不含声音）给出 Elo 排名，并附价格与速度数据。

orgs.name: Ashley Edwards
orgs.description: Senior research scientist at Google DeepMind working on reinforcement learning and foundation world models. Her earlier work on learning latent actions from observation alone underlies Genie's latent action model, which lets a world model be trained on unlabelled video.
orgs.description_zh: Google DeepMind 高级研究科学家，研究强化学习与基础世界模型。她早期关于仅从观察中学习潜在动作的工作，是 Genie 潜在动作模型的基础，使世界模型可以用无标注视频训练。

orgs.name: Awesome 3D Gaussian Splatting
orgs.description: MrNeRF's curated, regularly updated list of Gaussian splatting papers, code and tools, sorted by topic from compression to avatars and 4D.
orgs.description_zh: MrNeRF 维护、持续更新的高斯泼溅论文、代码与工具清单，按主题分类，从压缩到虚拟人与 4D。

orgs.name: Awesome Talking Head Generation
orgs.description: Curated GitHub list of talking-head and audio-driven portrait generation papers, datasets and code.
orgs.description_zh: GitHub 上的说话人像与音频驱动人像生成论文、数据集与代码精选清单。

orgs.name: Awesome Video Diffusion
orgs.description: Show Lab (NUS)'s curated list of video diffusion papers and code, from text-to-video to editing, control and long video.
orgs.description_zh: 新加坡国立大学 Show Lab 维护的视频扩散论文与代码清单，从文生视频到编辑、控制与长视频。

orgs.name: Awesome World Models
orgs.description: Curated GitHub list of world-model papers across games, embodied AI, autonomous driving and video generation.
orgs.description_zh: GitHub 上的世界模型论文精选清单，涵盖游戏、具身智能、自动驾驶与视频生成。

orgs.name: Ben Mildenhall
orgs.description: Co-founder of World Labs and first author of NeRF, the 2020 paper that started the neural radiance field era of view synthesis. He was a research scientist at Google Research from 2021 to 2023.
orgs.description_zh: World Labs 联合创始人，NeRF 第一作者；这篇 2020 年的论文开启了神经辐射场视角合成的时代。2021 至 2023 年他在 Google Research 任研究科学家。

orgs.name: Bernhard Kerbl
orgs.description: First author of 3D Gaussian Splatting, which made photoreal radiance fields render in real time and set off the splatting boom. He is now a tenure-track assistant professor at the University of Copenhagen and a principal investigator associated with TU Wien.
orgs.description_zh: 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）第一作者：该方法让照片级辐射场可以实时渲染，引发了高斯泼溅热潮。他现任哥本哈根大学终身轨助理教授，并在维也纳工业大学担任项目首席研究员。
known_for: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering (SIGGRAPH 2023 Best Paper)
A Hierarchical 3D Gaussian Representation for Real-Time Rendering of Very Large Datasets (SIGGRAPH 2024)

orgs.name: Bilawal Sidhu
orgs.description: Creator and former Google Maps / AR product manager whose YouTube and social channels demo and explain 3D capture, splatting and generative video.
orgs.description_zh: 内容创作者，曾任 Google 地图 / AR 产品经理；其 YouTube 与社交账号演示并讲解三维捕捉、高斯泼溅与生成视频。

orgs.name: Bill Peebles
orgs.description: Research scientist and Head of Sora at OpenAI and co-author of the Diffusion Transformer (DiT), the architecture behind most current video models. OpenAI closed the Sora app in April 2026 and its API in September 2026, keeping Sora as a world-simulation research effort.
orgs.description_zh: OpenAI 研究科学家、Sora 负责人，扩散 Transformer（DiT）的共同作者；DiT 是当今多数视频模型采用的架构。OpenAI 于 2026 年 4 月关闭 Sora 应用、9 月关闭其 API，Sora 转为面向世界模拟的研究项目。
known_for: Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers (DiT, ICCV 2023)

orgs.name: Botao 'Amber' Hu
orgs.description: Designer and researcher who directs Reality Design Lab and teaches mixed reality design at the China Academy of Art; maker of the open HoloKit headset and of this gallery.
orgs.description_zh: 设计师与研究者，主持现实设计实验室（Reality Design Lab），在中国美术学院教授混合现实设计；开源 HoloKit 头显及本图库的创作者。

orgs.name: Brendan Iribe
orgs.description: Oculus co-founder who co-founded Sesame, the voice-companion company whose Conversational Speech Model (2025) made AI voices pause, laugh and interrupt like people; Sesame is also building smart glasses.
orgs.description_zh: Oculus 联合创始人，后又联合创办语音伴侣公司 Sesame；其对话语音模型（CSM，2025）让 AI 声音能像人一样停顿、发笑和打断。Sesame 也在开发智能眼镜。

orgs.name: ByteDance Seed
orgs.description: ByteDance's foundation-model team, formed in 2023, behind the Seedance video models, OmniHuman audio-driven human animation and Seed3D.
orgs.description_zh: 字节跳动 2023 年成立的基础模型团队，推出了 Seedance 视频模型、音频驱动人体动画 OmniHuman 以及 Seed3D。

orgs.name: C2PA (Content Credentials)
orgs.description: The Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity, which maintains the open Content Credentials standard that several video and image generators attach to their output to mark it as AI-made.
orgs.description_zh: 内容来源与真实性联盟（C2PA），维护开放的“内容凭证”（Content Credentials）标准；多家视频与图像生成服务会在输出中附加该凭证，标明内容由 AI 生成。

orgs.name: Christoph Lassner
orgs.description: Co-founder of World Labs who previously led research teams at Epic Games and Meta Reality Labs Research on interactive radiance-field reconstruction and rendering, and on 3D body models.
orgs.description_zh: World Labs 联合创始人，此前在 Epic Games 与 Meta Reality Labs Research 领导研究团队，研究可交互的辐射场重建与渲染以及三维人体模型。

orgs.name: Computers in Human Behavior
orgs.description: Elsevier journal on the psychology of computer use, a frequent outlet for studies of virtual humans, avatars and VR effects on behavior.
orgs.description_zh: 爱思唯尔出版的计算机使用心理学期刊，常发表关于虚拟人、化身以及 VR 对行为影响的研究。

orgs.name: Cristóbal Valenzuela
orgs.description: Co-founder and CEO of Runway, which took video generation from research to filmmaking tools (Gen-1 to Gen-4.5) and in 2025 moved into general world models.
orgs.description_zh: Runway 联合创始人兼首席执行官；Runway 把视频生成从研究带进电影制作工具（Gen-1 至 Gen-4.5），并在 2025 年转向通用世界模型。

orgs.name: CVPR
orgs.description: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition, the largest vision venue and the usual home of video generation, 3D/4D reconstruction and world-generation papers and workshops.
orgs.description_zh: IEEE/CVF 计算机视觉与模式识别会议，规模最大的视觉会议，视频生成、三维 / 四维重建与世界生成论文和研讨会的主要阵地。

orgs.name: Daniel Freeman
orgs.description: Professor of clinical psychology at the University of Oxford who uses VR to study and treat paranoia; his gameChange trial tested automated VR therapy with a virtual coach for people with psychosis.
orgs.description_zh: 牛津大学临床心理学教授，用 VR 研究和治疗偏执；他的 gameChange 试验检验了由虚拟教练引导的自动化 VR 疗法对精神病患者的效果。
known_for: gameChange automated VR therapy trial (Lancet Psychiatry, 2022)
Automated VR treatment for fear of heights (Lancet Psychiatry, 2018)

orgs.name: Dean Leitersdorf
orgs.description: Co-founder and CEO of Decart, which builds real-time generative video: Oasis, a playable Minecraft-like world model (with Etched), and MirageLSD, live video-to-video restyling.
orgs.description_zh: Decart 联合创始人兼首席执行官，公司开发实时生成视频：与 Etched 合作的可玩类 Minecraft 世界模型 Oasis，以及实时视频风格转换 MirageLSD。
orgs.based: San Francisco, US / Tel Aviv, IL
orgs.based_zh: 美国旧金山 / 以色列特拉维夫

orgs.name: Decart
orgs.description: Real-time generative video lab: Oasis (2024) was a playable world model of a Minecraft-like game, and MirageLSD (2025) restyles live camera video in real time.
orgs.description_zh: 实时生成视频实验室：Oasis（2024）是一款类 Minecraft 游戏的可玩世界模型，MirageLSD（2025）能对实时摄像头画面进行实时风格转换。
orgs.based: San Francisco, US / Tel Aviv, IL
orgs.based_zh: 美国旧金山 / 以色列特拉维夫

orgs.name: ElevenLabs
orgs.description: Voice AI company whose text-to-speech, voice cloning, sound effects, music and conversational agent platform supply the voices of many generated characters and virtual humans.
orgs.description_zh: 语音 AI 公司，其文本转语音、声音克隆、音效、音乐与对话智能体平台，为许多生成角色与虚拟人提供声音。
orgs.based_zh: 英国伦敦 / 美国纽约

orgs.name: Eloi Alonso
orgs.description: Co-founder of General Intuition and first author of DIAMOND, an open diffusion world model trained an Atari agent entirely in imagination and then generated a playable Counter-Strike map. He did his PhD with François Fleuret at the University of Geneva.
orgs.description_zh: General Intuition 联合创始人，DIAMOND 第一作者：这个开源扩散世界模型完全在“想象”中训练 Atari 智能体，并生成了可玩的 Counter-Strike 地图。他在日内瓦大学 François Fleuret 组完成博士学业。
known_for: DIAMOND: Diffusion for World Modeling (NeurIPS 2024 Spotlight)
IRIS: Transformers are Sample-Efficient World Models (ICLR 2023)

orgs.name: Ethan (Yuanming) Hu
orgs.description: Founder and CEO of Meshy, the text- and image-to-3D asset generator; before that he created the Taichi programming language for graphics during his MIT PhD.
orgs.description_zh: Meshy 创始人兼首席执行官，Meshy 是文本 / 图像生成三维资产的工具；此前他在 MIT 读博期间创造了面向图形学的 Taichi 编程语言。

orgs.name: Event Lab (Universitat de Barcelona)
orgs.description: Mel Slater's Barcelona lab for virtual environments in neuroscience and technology, known for studies of body ownership, embodiment and people's responses to virtual others.
orgs.description_zh: Mel Slater 在巴塞罗那领导的“神经科学与技术中的虚拟环境”实验室，以身体拥有感、具身以及人们对虚拟他人反应的研究著称。

orgs.name: Fei-Fei Li
orgs.description: Stanford professor who created ImageNet and is co-founder and CEO of World Labs, the spatial-intelligence company behind Marble; she argues that the next step after language models is models that generate and reason about 3D worlds.
orgs.description_zh: 斯坦福大学教授，ImageNet 的创建者，空间智能公司 World Labs 的联合创始人兼首席执行官（推出 Marble）；她主张语言模型之后的下一步是能生成并推理三维世界的模型。
known_for: From Words to Worlds: Spatial Intelligence (essay, 2025)
orgs.based_zh: 美国斯坦福 / 旧金山

orgs.name: Frontiers in Virtual Reality
orgs.description: Open-access journal founded in 2020 covering VR/AR technology and its use in psychology, health and training.
orgs.description_zh: 2020 年创刊的开放获取期刊，涵盖 VR / AR 技术及其在心理学、健康与训练中的应用。

orgs.name: General Intuition
orgs.description: World-model lab co-founded by DIAMOND author Eloi Alonso that trains agents and world models on large archives of game play, describing itself as 'the frontier lab for acting in space and time'.
orgs.description_zh: 由 DIAMOND 作者 Eloi Alonso 联合创立的世界模型实验室，利用大量游戏录像训练智能体与世界模型，自称“在空间与时间中行动的前沿实验室”。

orgs.name: George Drettakis
orgs.description: Senior researcher who leads the GraphDeco group at Inria Sophia Antipolis and senior author of 3D Gaussian Splatting; decades of work on image-based rendering made the method possible.
orgs.description_zh: 法国国家信息与自动化研究院（Inria）索菲亚-安提波利斯中心 GraphDeco 组负责人，3D 高斯泼溅的通讯作者；他数十年的基于图像的渲染研究为该方法奠定了基础。
known_for: Deep Blending for Free-Viewpoint Image-Based Rendering (SIGGRAPH Asia 2018)
orgs.based_zh: 法国索菲亚-安提波利斯

orgs.name: Google DeepMind
orgs.description: Google's AI lab and the single largest source of landmarks in this gallery: the Genie world models (Genie 1 to 3), the Veo video models with native audio, CAT3D and the SIMA game agents.
orgs.description_zh: Google 的人工智能实验室，也是本图库中里程碑作品最多的来源：Genie 世界模型（Genie 1 至 3）、能原生生成声音的 Veo 视频模型、CAT3D 以及 SIMA 游戏智能体。

orgs.name: Gordon Wetzstein
orgs.description: Professor at Stanford who leads the Computational Imaging Lab, working across 3D-aware generative models, neural rendering and holographic near-eye displays for AR and VR.
orgs.description_zh: 斯坦福大学教授，领导计算成像实验室，研究横跨三维感知生成模型、神经渲染以及面向 AR / VR 的全息近眼显示。

orgs.name: Gradium
orgs.description: Paris voice-AI company spun out of Kyutai in December 2025 and led by Neil Zeghidour; it turns the Moshi line of research into a real-time voice API for agents (low-latency speech synthesis, transcription, live translation and voice cloning).
orgs.description_zh: 2025 年 12 月从 Kyutai 分拆出的巴黎语音 AI 公司，由 Neil Zeghidour 领导；它把 Moshi 一脉的研究转化为面向智能体的实时语音 API（低延迟语音合成、转写、实时翻译与声音克隆）。

orgs.name: Guido Makransky
orgs.description: Professor of educational psychology at the University of Copenhagen whose CAMIL model explains when immersive VR helps learning, and whose experiments found that more presence can mean less learning.
orgs.description_zh: 哥本哈根大学教育心理学教授；他提出的 CAMIL 模型解释了沉浸式 VR 何时有助于学习，他的实验还发现临场感更强有时反而学得更少。
known_for: CAMIL: Cognitive Affective Model of Immersive Learning (Educational Psychology Review, 2021)
Adding immersive VR to a science lab simulation causes more presence but less learning (2019)

orgs.name: Hao Li
orgs.description: Co-founder and CEO of Pinscreen and professor of computer vision at MBZUAI, where he directs the Metaverse Center; he builds instant photoreal avatars and speaks often on deepfakes.
orgs.description_zh: Pinscreen 联合创始人兼首席执行官、穆罕默德·本·扎耶德人工智能大学（MBZUAI）计算机视觉教授并主持元宇宙中心；他开发即时照片级虚拟形象，也经常就深度伪造问题发声。
known_for: Realistic Dynamic Facial Textures from a Single Image using GANs (ICCV 2017)
orgs.based: Abu Dhabi, AE / Los Angeles, US
orgs.based_zh: 阿联酋阿布扎比 / 美国洛杉矶

orgs.name: Hassaan Raza
orgs.description: Co-founder and CEO of Tavus, whose conversational video interface pairs perception, turn-taking and face models; in October 2026 Tavus launched Griffin, which it calls a human interaction model.
orgs.description_zh: Tavus 联合创始人兼首席执行官；Tavus 的对话式视频接口把感知、轮流发言与人脸模型组合在一起，并于 2026 年 10 月推出被其称为“人类交互模型”的 Griffin。

orgs.name: Hsin-Chien Huang
orgs.description: Taiwanese new-media artist whose VR works, including To the Moon with Laurie Anderson and Bodyless, are landmarks of immersive storytelling at Venice and other festivals.
orgs.description_zh: 台湾新媒体艺术家，其 VR 作品（包括与 Laurie Anderson 合作的《To the Moon》以及《Bodyless》）是威尼斯等影展上沉浸式叙事的代表作。
known_for: La Camera Insabbiata / Chalkroom (with Laurie Anderson, Venice 2017)

orgs.name: Hugging Face Daily Papers
orgs.description: Daily, upvoted feed of new arXiv papers on Hugging Face, started by AK (@_akhaliq), with linked models, datasets and demo Spaces; the fastest way to catch new generative video, 3D and world-model releases.
orgs.description_zh: Hugging Face 上每日更新、按投票排序的 arXiv 新论文列表，由 AK（@_akhaliq）发起，并关联模型、数据集与演示 Space；追踪生成视频、三维与世界模型新发布最快的途径。

orgs.name: Hugging Face Spaces
orgs.description: Hosted demos for open models, where many video, 3D, avatar and speech models can be tried in the browser on release day.
orgs.description_zh: 开源模型的在线演示平台，许多视频、三维、虚拟人与语音模型在发布当天即可在浏览器中试用。

orgs.name: Hume AI
orgs.description: Voice AI company grounded in emotion science, maker of the EVI empathic voice interface and Octave TTS; it now also sells expression measurement (600+ dimensions) for evaluating voice agents, which is useful for coding affect in studies.
orgs.description_zh: 以情绪科学为基础的语音 AI 公司，推出共情语音接口 EVI 与 Octave 语音合成；现在也提供 600 多个维度的表情测量，用于评估语音智能体，也可用于研究中的情感编码。

orgs.name: I/ITSEC
orgs.description: The Interservice/Industry Training, Simulation and Education Conference in Orlando, the largest venue for military and industrial simulation training, where ICT's virtual-human trainers were presented.
orgs.description_zh: 奥兰多举办的跨军种 / 产业训练、模拟与教育会议，军事与工业模拟训练领域规模最大的会议，ICT 的虚拟人训练系统曾在此发表。

orgs.name: Ian Cheng
orgs.description: Artist who makes live simulations: open-ended virtual ecosystems whose agents keep acting and changing without a script, the art-world counterpart of generative agent worlds.
orgs.description_zh: 创作“实时模拟”的艺术家：开放式的虚拟生态，其中的智能体无剧本地持续行动和变化，是生成式智能体世界在艺术领域的对应物。

orgs.name: ICCV & ECCV
orgs.description: The International and European Conferences on Computer Vision, held in alternate years (ICCV odd, ECCV even); NeRF appeared at ECCV 2020 and DiT at ICCV 2023.
orgs.description_zh: 国际计算机视觉大会与欧洲计算机视觉会议，隔年交替举办（ICCV 奇数年，ECCV 偶数年）；NeRF 发表于 ECCV 2020，DiT 发表于 ICCV 2023。

orgs.name: ICLR
orgs.description: International Conference on Learning Representations, with open review on OpenReview; GameNGen and many video and world-model papers appeared here.
orgs.description_zh: 国际学习表征会议，采用 OpenReview 公开评审；GameNGen 以及许多视频与世界模型论文发表于此。

orgs.name: IEEE ISMAR
orgs.description: IEEE International Symposium on Mixed and Augmented Reality, the main AR/MR research venue, increasingly with generative and LLM-driven XR papers.
orgs.description_zh: IEEE 混合与增强现实国际研讨会，AR / MR 研究的主要会议，生成式与大模型驱动的 XR 论文日益增多。

orgs.name: IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics (TVCG)
orgs.description: IEEE journal that publishes the IEEE VR and ISMAR journal papers, the main archival outlet for VR systems and perception research.
orgs.description_zh: IEEE 期刊，刊载 IEEE VR 与 ISMAR 的期刊论文，是 VR 系统与感知研究的主要存档渠道。

orgs.name: IEEE VR
orgs.description: IEEE Conference on Virtual Reality and 3D User Interfaces, the main venue for VR systems, presence and embodiment studies; its papers are published in IEEE TVCG.
orgs.description_zh: IEEE 虚拟现实与三维用户界面会议，VR 系统、临场感与具身研究的主要会议；其论文发表于 IEEE TVCG。

orgs.name: Inria GraphDeco
orgs.description: George Drettakis's graphics group at Inria Sophia Antipolis, where 3D Gaussian Splatting was invented (SIGGRAPH 2023 best paper) and released with open code.
orgs.description_zh: George Drettakis 在 Inria 索菲亚-安提波利斯中心的图形学研究组，3D 高斯泼溅在此诞生（SIGGRAPH 2023 最佳论文）并开源发布。
orgs.based_zh: 法国索菲亚-安提波利斯

orgs.name: Ioannis Patras
orgs.description: Professor of Computer Vision and Human Sensing at Queen Mary University of London and Head of Research at Tavus, where he co-authored Griffin (2026), a real-time 'human interaction model' that Tavus reports 48% of study participants took for a real person.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦玛丽女王大学计算机视觉与人体感知教授、Tavus 研究负责人；他是 Griffin（2026）的共同作者，这是一个实时“人类交互模型”，Tavus 报告称 48% 的研究参与者把它当成了真人。

orgs.name: Jack Parker-Holder
orgs.description: Research Director at Google DeepMind who scales world models; he co-led Genie, Genie 2 and Genie 3, models that turn a prompt into an environment you can act in. He is also an honorary lecturer at UCL DARK.
orgs.description_zh: Google DeepMind 研究总监，负责扩展世界模型；共同主导了 Genie、Genie 2 与 Genie 3，这些模型能把一段提示变成可以在其中行动的环境。他同时是 UCL DARK 的荣誉讲师。

orgs.name: Jake Bruce
orgs.description: Research scientist at Google DeepMind in London and first author of Genie, the 11B-parameter model that learned playable 2D worlds from internet gameplay videos without action labels; he also contributed to Genie 3.
orgs.description_zh: Google DeepMind 伦敦研究科学家，Genie 第一作者。这个 110 亿参数的模型在没有动作标注的情况下，从互联网游戏视频中学会了生成可玩的 2D 世界；他也参与了 Genie 3。
known_for: Genie: Generative Interactive Environments (ICML 2024 Best Paper)

orgs.name: Jaron Lanier
orgs.description: VR pioneer who founded VPL Research in 1985, the first company to sell VR goggles and data gloves, and who works at Microsoft; his books argue for data dignity and against using people as fuel for AI.
orgs.description_zh: 虚拟现实先驱，1985 年创立首家销售 VR 头显与数据手套的公司 VPL Research，现任职于微软；他在著作中倡导“数据尊严”，反对把人当作 AI 的燃料。

orgs.name: Jean-Louis van Gelder
orgs.description: Director at the Max Planck Institute for the Study of Crime, Security and Law in Freiburg who brought VR into criminology, most famously by having burglars walk through a virtual neighbourhood.
orgs.description_zh: 弗莱堡马克斯·普朗克犯罪、安全与法律研究所所长，把 VR 引入犯罪学研究，最著名的是让入室盗窃者在虚拟街区中行走的研究。
known_for: Virtual Burglary (Journal of Research in Crime and Delinquency, 2017)
Virtual Reality for Criminologists (Crime and Justice, 2023)

orgs.name: Jeremy Bailenson
orgs.description: Founding director of Stanford's Virtual Human Interaction Lab; his Proteus effect and transformed social interaction studies showed how avatars change the people who wear them.
orgs.description_zh: 斯坦福大学虚拟人交互实验室（VHIL）创始主任；他关于“普罗透斯效应”与“变换的社会互动”的研究揭示了化身如何改变使用它的人。

orgs.name: Jim Blascovich
orgs.description: Distinguished Professor Emeritus of psychology at UC Santa Barbara whose 2002 paper made immersive virtual environments a methodological tool for social psychology, trading off experimental control against mundane realism.
orgs.description_zh: 加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校心理学杰出荣休教授；他 2002 年的论文把沉浸式虚拟环境确立为社会心理学的方法工具，在实验控制与日常真实性之间取得平衡。
known_for: Immersive virtual environment technology as a methodological tool for social psychology (Psychological Inquiry, 2002)

orgs.name: Jon Barron
orgs.description: Principal research scientist at Google DeepMind in San Francisco who leads a small team working mostly on NeRF; co-author of NeRF and of the Mip-NeRF and Zip-NeRF line, and of generative 3D work such as DreamFusion and CAT3D.
orgs.description_zh: Google DeepMind 旧金山首席研究科学家，带领一个主要研究 NeRF 的小团队；NeRF 及 Mip-NeRF、Zip-NeRF 系列的共同作者，也参与了 DreamFusion、CAT3D 等生成式三维工作。

orgs.name: Jonathan Gratch
orgs.description: Professor at the USC Institute for Creative Technologies who directs its Affective Computing Group; he builds computational models of emotion for virtual humans and studies why people disclose more to them.
orgs.description_zh: 南加州大学创意技术研究所教授，主持情感计算组；他为虚拟人构建情绪计算模型，并研究人们为何更愿意向虚拟人吐露心声。
known_for: EMA: a process model of appraisal dynamics (2009)
It's only a computer: virtual humans increase willingness to disclose (2014)

orgs.name: Joon Sung Park
orgs.description: Computer scientist who introduced generative agents (the Smallville town of 25 LLM characters) and later simulated 1,052 real people from interviews; he now runs Simile, a Palo Alto company that sells population-scale behavioral simulations.
orgs.description_zh: 提出“生成式智能体”（由 25 个大模型角色组成的 Smallville 小镇）的计算机科学家，后又根据访谈模拟了 1,052 位真实个体；他现在经营 Simile，一家在帕洛阿尔托提供群体规模行为模拟的公司。

orgs.name: Joshua Xu
orgs.description: Co-founder and CEO of HeyGen, the avatar video platform whose interactive avatars bring talking-head generation into real-time conversation.
orgs.description_zh: HeyGen 联合创始人兼首席执行官；HeyGen 是虚拟人视频平台，其交互式虚拟人把说话人像生成带入实时对话。

orgs.name: Justin Johnson
orgs.description: Co-founder of World Labs and faculty member at the University of Michigan; known for perceptual losses for style transfer, the CLEVR reasoning benchmark and image generation from scene graphs.
orgs.description_zh: World Labs 联合创始人、密歇根大学教员；以风格迁移的感知损失、CLEVR 推理基准和由场景图生成图像等工作著称。
known_for: Perceptual Losses for Real-Time Style Transfer (ECCV 2016)

orgs.name: Keiichi Matsuda
orgs.description: Designer and filmmaker whose short film Hyper-Reality pictured a city saturated with augmented-reality ads and assistant agents; his later work designs AI agents for everyday mixed reality.
orgs.description_zh: 设计师与电影人，短片《Hyper-Reality》描绘了一座被增强现实广告与助手智能体淹没的城市；他之后的工作为日常混合现实设计 AI 智能体。

orgs.name: Kling AI (Kuaishou)
orgs.description: Kuaishou's video-generation product, launched in June 2024 and updated through a fast series of Kling versions that have often ranked at or near the top of public video arenas.
orgs.description_zh: 快手的视频生成产品，于 2024 年 6 月上线，此后快速迭代多个可灵版本，多次位居公开视频竞技场榜首或前列。

orgs.name: Kyutai
orgs.description: Non-profit open-science AI lab in Paris that released Moshi, the first open full-duplex speech model, plus Hibiki live speech translation and the Unmute voice stack; its voice work was spun out as Gradium in 2025.
orgs.description_zh: 巴黎的非营利开放科学 AI 实验室，发布了首个开源全双工语音模型 Moshi，以及实时语音翻译 Hibiki 与语音系统 Unmute；其语音技术于 2025 年分拆为 Gradium 公司。

orgs.name: Linxi "Jim" Fan
orgs.description: Senior research scientist and lead of AI agents at NVIDIA (GEAR lab); his Minecraft agents MineDojo and Voyager showed LLM-driven agents learning open-ended skills in a game world.
orgs.description_zh: NVIDIA 高级研究科学家、AI 智能体负责人（GEAR 实验室）；他的 Minecraft 智能体 MineDojo 与 Voyager 展示了大模型驱动的智能体在游戏世界里学习开放式技能。

orgs.name: Louis-Philippe Morency
orgs.description: Leonardo Associate Professor at Carnegie Mellon who directs the MultiComp Lab; he co-built SimSensei, the virtual interviewer that read nonverbal cues to screen for distress, and works on multimodal models of social behavior.
orgs.description_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学 Leonardo 副教授，主持 MultiComp 实验室；他参与打造了 SimSensei——一个通过读取非语言线索筛查心理困扰的虚拟访谈者，并研究社会行为的多模态模型。
known_for: Multimodal Machine Learning: A Survey and Taxonomy (TPAMI 2019)

orgs.name: Luma AI
orgs.description: Started with NeRF and splat capture on phones, then released the Dream Machine and Ray video models; its site now presents AI agents for creative work.
orgs.description_zh: 从手机上的 NeRF 与高斯泼溅捕捉起步，之后发布 Dream Machine 与 Ray 系列视频模型；其网站现在主推面向创意工作的 AI 智能体。

orgs.name: Mar Gonzalez-Franco
orgs.description: Neuroscientist and computer scientist who manages a Google organization on human-AI interaction and intelligent eyewear that shaped input and interaction for Android XR; at Microsoft Research she led avatar embodiment work and the open Rocketbox avatar library.
orgs.description_zh: 神经科学家与计算机科学家，在 Google 管理人机交互与智能眼镜方向的团队，主导了 Android XR 的输入与交互体验；此前在微软研究院主持化身具身研究，并开放了 Rocketbox 虚拟人库。

orgs.name: Maria V. Sanchez-Vives
orgs.description: ICREA research professor at IDIBAPS in Barcelona who leads its Systems Neuroscience group and is a long-time collaborator of Mel Slater at the Event Lab; she studies presence, body ownership and how virtual bodies change behavior.
orgs.description_zh: 巴塞罗那 IDIBAPS 研究所的 ICREA 研究教授，领导系统神经科学组，长期与 Event Lab 的 Mel Slater 合作；她研究临场感、身体拥有感，以及虚拟身体如何改变行为。
known_for: From presence to consciousness through virtual reality (Nat. Rev. Neurosci., 2005)
Enhancing Our Lives with Immersive Virtual Reality (Frontiers in Robotics and AI, 2016)

orgs.name: Mati Staniszewski
orgs.description: Co-founder and CEO of ElevenLabs, whose expressive text-to-speech, voice cloning and agent platform became the default voice layer for many generated characters.
orgs.description_zh: ElevenLabs 联合创始人兼首席执行官；其富有表现力的文本转语音、声音克隆与智能体平台，成为许多生成角色默认的声音层。

orgs.name: Matthias Nießner
orgs.description: Professor at TU Munich who leads the Visual Computing & AI lab and co-founded Synthesia; his group's face reenactment and Gaussian avatar work feeds both deepfake detection and drivable 3D heads.
orgs.description_zh: 慕尼黑工业大学教授，领导视觉计算与人工智能实验室，Synthesia 联合创始人；其团队在人脸重演与高斯化身方面的工作，同时推动了深度伪造检测与可驱动三维头像。

orgs.name: Max Planck Institute for the Study of Crime, Security and Law
orgs.name_zh: 马克斯·普朗克犯罪、安全与法律研究所
orgs.description: Freiburg institute whose criminology department, led by Jean-Louis van Gelder, uses virtual reality to study offending, victimization and decision-making under realistic conditions.
orgs.description_zh: 位于弗莱堡的研究所，其犯罪学部门由 Jean-Louis van Gelder 领导，用虚拟现实在接近真实的条件下研究犯罪、受害与决策。

orgs.name: Mel Slater
orgs.description: Virtual reality researcher who leads the Event Lab at the University of Barcelona; his place illusion and plausibility account defines presence, and his virtual Milgram and bystander studies show that people respond realistically to virtual others.
orgs.description_zh: 在巴塞罗那大学领导 Event Lab 的虚拟现实研究者；他提出的“位置错觉与合理性错觉”定义了临场感，他的虚拟米尔格拉姆实验与旁观者研究表明，人们会对虚拟他人做出真实反应。
known_for: Place illusion and plausibility (Phil. Trans. R. Soc. B, 2009)
A Virtual Reprise of the Stanley Milgram Obedience Experiments (PLoS ONE, 2006)
Bystander responses to a violent incident in an immersive virtual environment (PLoS ONE, 2013)

orgs.name: Meta Reality Labs Research
orgs.description: Meta's research arm for AR and VR, home of Codec Avatars (photoreal telepresence), Hyperscape room capture with Gaussian splatting, and the Aria research glasses.
orgs.description_zh: Meta 的 AR / VR 研究部门，Codec Avatars（照片级远程临场化身）、基于高斯泼溅的 Hyperscape 房间捕捉以及 Aria 科研眼镜都出自这里。
orgs.based_zh: 美国雷德蒙德 / 匹兹堡

orgs.name: Michael Bernstein
orgs.description: Professor of computer science at Stanford (HCI group) and senior author of Generative Agents and Social Simulacra; he studies how simulated people can be used, and misused, to prototype social systems.
orgs.description_zh: 斯坦福大学计算机科学教授（人机交互组），《Generative Agents》与《Social Simulacra》的通讯作者；他研究如何使用（以及如何误用）模拟的人来为社会系统做原型。

orgs.name: Michael J. Black
orgs.description: Founding director of the Perceiving Systems department at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and co-founder of Meshcapade; his SMPL body model is the common skeleton of most 3D human generation and motion research.
orgs.description_zh: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所感知系统部门创始所长、Meshcapade 联合创始人；他的 SMPL 人体模型是大多数三维人体生成与动作研究的通用骨架。

orgs.name: Microsoft Research
orgs.description: Microsoft's research organization, which produced VASA-1 lifelike talking faces from one photo, the Muse (WHAM) game world model with Xbox, and the open Rocketbox avatar library used across VR studies.
orgs.description_zh: 微软的研究机构，推出了由一张照片生成逼真说话人脸的 VASA-1、与 Xbox 合作的 Muse（WHAM）游戏世界模型，以及被大量 VR 研究使用的开源 Rocketbox 虚拟人库。

orgs.name: MiniMax
orgs.description: Shanghai AI company whose Hailuo video models and Speech text-to-speech models have ranked near the top of public video and speech arenas.
orgs.description_zh: 上海人工智能公司，旗下海螺（Hailuo）视频模型与 Speech 语音合成模型在公开视频与语音竞技场中名列前茅。

orgs.name: MMLab@NTU / S-Lab
orgs.description: Nanyang Technological University's multimedia lab (Chen Change Loy, Ziwei Liu), a major source of open video, 3D and avatar generators and of the VBench benchmark.
orgs.description_zh: 南洋理工大学多媒体实验室（吕健勤、刘子纬），大量开源视频、三维与虚拟人生成模型以及 VBench 评测基准的来源。

orgs.name: Mursion
orgs.description: Immersive simulation company where employees practice difficult conversations with avatars that push back; it began with human simulation specialists voicing the avatars and now markets an AI-powered upskilling platform.
orgs.description_zh: 沉浸式模拟公司，员工可以与会“顶嘴”的虚拟人练习棘手对话；它起初由真人模拟专家为虚拟人配音和操控，如今主推 AI 驱动的技能提升平台。

orgs.name: Neil Zeghidour
orgs.description: Co-founder of the Paris lab Kyutai and CEO of its voice spin-off Gradium (December 2025); co-author of SoundStream, AudioLM and Moshi, the first open full-duplex speech model that listens while it talks.
orgs.description_zh: 巴黎实验室 Kyutai 联合创始人、其语音衍生公司 Gradium（2025 年 12 月成立）的首席执行官；SoundStream、AudioLM 与 Moshi 的共同作者，Moshi 是首个开源的全双工语音模型，可以边听边说。

orgs.name: NeurIPS
orgs.description: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems, where much world-model, diffusion and agent research is published, along with datasets and benchmarks tracks.
orgs.description_zh: 神经信息处理系统大会，大量世界模型、扩散模型与智能体研究在此发表，并设有数据集与基准赛道。

orgs.name: Noah Snavely
orgs.description: Professor at Cornell Tech and researcher at Google DeepMind whose work runs from Photo Tourism (2006) to the RealEstate10K camera-path dataset and 4D reconstruction of casual videos, data that most camera-controlled video and scene models now train on.
orgs.description_zh: 康奈尔科技校区教授、Google DeepMind 研究员，研究从 Photo Tourism（2006）一直到 RealEstate10K 相机轨迹数据集与随手视频的 4D 重建；如今多数相机可控视频与场景模型都用这些数据训练。

orgs.name: Nonny de la Peña
orgs.description: Journalist and filmmaker credited with creating immersive journalism; founder of Emblematic Group, whose VR pieces such as Hunger in Los Angeles put viewers bodily inside reconstructed real events.
orgs.description_zh: 记者与电影人，被誉为“沉浸式新闻”的开创者；Emblematic Group 创始人，其 VR 作品如《Hunger in Los Angeles》让观众亲身置于重建的真实事件之中。

orgs.name: NVIDIA Spatial Intelligence Lab
